articles.title: Fix Auto Avondale Showcases $200K Custom Build at SEMA Show
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Fix Auto USA has recognized Fix Auto Avondale and owner Troy Buck for two recent initiatives highlighting the team’s craftsmanship and community involvement.
paras.zh: Fix Auto USA 认可了 Fix Auto Avondale 和所有者 Troy Buck 最近的两项举措，突显了该团队的精湛工艺和社区参与。

paras.en: At the 2026 SEMA Show, Fix Auto Avondale presented a custom vehicle completed through a frame-off restoration. The project was finished in 60 days, with four employees contributing approximately 4,000 hours. The build is valued at more than $200,000.
paras.zh: 在 2026 年 SEMA 展会上，Fix Auto Avondale 展示了一辆通过框架修复完成的定制车辆。该项目在 60 天内完成，四名员工贡献了约 4,000 小时。该建筑价值超过20万美元。

paras.en: The vehicle featured custom modifications, including a shaved firewall, shaved cowl panel, sectioned fenders, molded-in spoiler and custom Kandy paint. The vehicle received a strong response at SEMA.
paras.zh: 该车辆进行了定制改装，包括剃光防火墙、剃光前围板、分段挡泥板、模制扰流板和定制康提油漆。该车在SEMA展会上获得了强烈反响。

paras.en: “Seeing the response to the car at SEMA was incredibly rewarding for all of us,” said Buck. “Our team put an unbelievable amount of time and effort into this build, and completing something of this scale in only 60 days took everyone working together. I’m extremely proud of what our team accomplished and the craftsmanship they brought to every detail.”
paras.zh: “看到这款车在 SEMA 上得到的反响对我们所有人来说都是令人难以置信的回报，”巴克说。 “我们的团队在这个构建中投入了令人难以置信的时间和精力，在短短 60 天内完成了如此规模的工作，需要每个人的共同努力。我对我们团队所取得的成就以及他们对每个细节的精湛工艺感到非常自豪。”

paras.en: Ahead of Alice Cooper’s annual charitable concert on Dec. 12, Buck also created an original Alice Cooper painting to raise funds for Alice Cooper’s Solid Rock Teen Centers. The piece continues Buck’s involvement with the organization.
paras.zh: 在 12 月 12 日爱丽丝·库珀 (Alice Cooper) 年度慈善音乐会之前，巴克还创作了一幅爱丽丝·库珀 (Alice Cooper) 原创画作，为爱丽丝·库珀 (Alice Cooper) 的 Solid Rock 青少年中心筹集资金。这篇文章继续了巴克对该组织的参与。

paras.en: Earlier this year, Buck collaborated with teen artists from the center to create the 10th and final installation in the City of Goodyear’s “HeART of Goodyear” public art project. The sculpture is displayed outside the Solid Rock Teen Center.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，巴克与该中心的青少年艺术家合作，创作了固特异市“固特异之心”公共艺术项目中的第十件也是最后一件装置作品。 The sculpture is displayed outside the Solid Rock Teen Center.

paras.en: Fix Auto Avondale made a $1,500 cash donation to Alice Cooper’s Solid Rock Teen Centers and a $1,500 cash donation to Your Heart Our Hands, which supports youth who have aged out of the foster care system. Over the past three years, Fix Auto Avondale has provided more than $80,000 in charitable donations.
paras.zh: Fix Auto Avondale 向 Alice Cooper 的 Solid Rock Teen Centers 捐赠了 1,500 美元现金，并向 Your Heart Our Hands 捐赠了 1,500 美元现金，该组织为已经脱离寄养系统的青少年提供支持。过去三年来，Fix Auto Avondale 已提供超过 80,000 美元的慈善捐款。

paras.en: “Solid Rock is an organization I’ve been fortunate to support year after year, and it’s something that means a lot to me personally,” said Buck. “Creating these paintings gives me a chance to combine my love of art with an opportunity to give back and support young people in our community. Whether it’s through the annual concert, working alongside the teens or finding other ways to contribute, I’m grateful to be involved. Our team believes strongly in giving back to the communities that support us, and I’m proud of what we’ve been able to accomplish.”
paras.zh: “Solid Rock 是一个我有幸年复一年支持的组织，这对我个人来说意义重大，”巴克说。 “创作这些画作让我有机会将对艺术的热爱与回馈和支持社区年轻人的机会结合起来。无论是通过年度音乐会、与青少年一起工作还是寻找其他方式做出贡献，我都很感激能参与其中。我们的团队坚信回馈支持我们的社区，我为我们所取得的成就感到自豪。”

paras.en: “Troy and the Fix Auto Avondale team represent so much of what makes the Fix Auto USA network special,” said Damien Reyna, COO, Driven Brands Collision Group. “The craftsmanship and dedication behind their SEMA build is remarkable, and Troy’s longstanding commitment to giving back makes this story even more meaningful. His support of Solid Rock and other organizations demonstrates the impact our franchisees can make well beyond the walls of their shops.”
paras.zh: “Troy 和 Fix Auto Avondale 团队代表了 Fix Auto USA 网络的独特之处，”Driven Brands Collision Group 首席运营官 Damien Reyna 说道。 “SEMA 建设背后的工艺和奉献精神是非凡的，而 Troy 长期以来对回馈社会的承诺使这个故事变得更加有意义。他对 Solid Rock 和其他组织的支持表明了我们的特许经营商可以远远超越他们的商店的范围。”

paras.en: For more information on Fix Auto USA, visit FixAutoUSA.com.
paras.zh: 有关 Fix Auto USA 的更多信息，请访问 FixAutoUSA.com。

articles.title: Study: Thanksgiving Drivers Add 510 Crashes Due to Distraction
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Thanksgiving motorists face increased risks from distracted driving, speeding and hard braking, with new research estimating that higher levels of driver distraction during the holiday contribute to approximately 510 additional crashes and 290 injuries nationwide in a typical year.
paras.zh: 感恩节驾车者面临的分心驾驶、超速和急刹车的风险增加，新的研究估计，节日期间驾驶员分心程度较高，导致全国范围内每年约增加 510 起车祸和 290 人受伤。

paras.en: The findings come from Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT), whose new U.S. Fall & Winter Holiday Road Risk Report examined more than 312 million vehicle trips across five holiday seasons to identify changes in driver behavior during major holidays.
paras.zh: 该研究结果来自 Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT)，其新的美国秋冬假期道路风险报告检查了五个假期期间超过 3.12 亿次的车辆出行，以确定重大假期期间驾驶员行为的变化。

paras.en: According to the report, Thanksgiving produces the sharpest single-day increase in speeding and distracted driving among the seven holidays examined, raising concerns as millions of Americans prepare to travel for family gatherings.
paras.zh: 报告称，感恩节是所调查的七个假期中超速和分心驾驶单日增幅最大的节日，这在数百万美国人准备出行参加家庭聚会之际引起了人们的担忧。

paras.en: The findings are particularly relevant as the collision repair industry continues to monitor changes in accident frequency and insurance claims volume. Although repairable claims have declined over the past two years, the study highlights how seasonal driving patterns and risky behavior can influence collision frequency.
paras.zh: 随着碰撞修复行业继续监测事故频率和保险索赔量的变化，这些发现尤其重要。尽管可修复索赔在过去两年有所下降，但该研究强调了季节性驾驶模式和危险行为如何影响碰撞频率。

paras.en: Thanksgiving Day Presents Elevated Risks
paras.zh: 感恩节带来的风险较高

paras.en: CMT’s research identified two particularly hazardous travel periods surrounding Thanksgiving: the early morning hours following Thanksgiving Eve and the late-morning to early-afternoon rush to holiday gatherings.
paras.zh: CMT 的研究确定了感恩节前后两个特别危险的旅行时段：感恩节前夕后的清晨以及上午晚些时候到下午早些时候的假日聚会高峰期。

paras.en: Between 9 a.m. and 2 p.m. on Thanksgiving Day, drivers’ phone screen time increases 22.7% compared to the same hours on a typical Thursday.
paras.zh: 上午 9 点至下午 2 点之间感恩节当天，司机看手机的时间比一般周四的同一时间增加了 22.7%。

paras.en: Researchers attributed the increased distraction to drivers managing navigation, communicating estimated arrival times and handling holiday-related calls and messages while traveling.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这种分心的现象归因于驾驶员在旅行时管理导航、传达预计到达时间以及处理与假期相关的电话和消息。

paras.en: The findings suggest that the pressure to arrive at holiday gatherings on time can contribute to behaviors that increase crash risks.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，按时参加假日聚会的压力可能会导致增加车祸风险的行为。

paras.en: Another particularly concerning period occurs between midnight and 4 a.m. on Thanksgiving Day, following Thanksgiving Eve celebrations.
paras.zh: 另一个特别令人担忧的时期发生在感恩节午夜到凌晨 4 点之间，即感恩节前夕庆祝活动之后。

paras.en: During those hours, CMT identified overlapping increases in phone use, speeding and hard braking. Hard-braking incidents increased 25.5% compared to typical driving conditions during the same period, even though hard braking declined across the Thanksgiving holiday overall.
paras.zh: 在那段时间里，CMT 发现手机使用、超速和紧急制动的情况重叠增加。与同期典型驾驶条件相比，紧急制动事故增加了 25.5%，尽管感恩节假期期间紧急制动事故总体有所下降。

paras.en: Thanksgiving Eve has traditionally been associated with concerns about impaired driving, but the CMT findings suggest that distraction and aggressive driving behaviors create additional hazards during the overnight hours.
paras.zh: 传统上，感恩节前夕与不清醒驾驶有关，但 CMT 的调查结果表明，分心和攻击性驾驶行为在夜间会产生额外的危险。

paras.en: Holiday Travel Adds to Driving Pressures
paras.zh: 假日旅行增加了驾驶压力

paras.en: The report comes as higher travel costs and changing transportation preferences may influence how Americans reach their Thanksgiving destinations.
paras.zh: 该报告发布之际，更高的旅行成本和不断变化的交通偏好可能会影响美国人到达感恩节目的地的方式。

paras.en: For families choosing to drive rather than fly, long-distance travel can introduce additional challenges, including congestion, fatigue, unfamiliar routes and pressure to maintain tight schedules.
paras.zh: 对于选择开车而不是乘坐飞机的家庭来说，长途旅行可能会带来额外的挑战，包括拥堵、疲劳、不熟悉的路线以及维持紧张日程的压力。

paras.en: Those factors can contribute to distracted driving and speeding, particularly when motorists attempt to coordinate travel plans or communicate with family members while behind the wheel.
paras.zh: 这些因素可能会导致分心驾驶和超速，特别是当驾车者试图在驾驶时协调旅行计划或与家人沟通时。

paras.en: The research also highlights the broader dangers associated with Thanksgiving travel. According to statistics cited in the study’s promotional materials, fatal crashes on Thanksgiving are nearly 10% higher than average.
paras.zh: 该研究还强调了与感恩节旅行相关的更广泛的危险。根据该研究宣传材料中引用的统计数据，感恩节期间致命车祸比平均水平高出近 10%。

paras.en: While the CMT findings identify significant increases in risky driving behaviors, the company’s estimate of 510 additional crashes and 290 injuries represents a modeled assessment of the impact of increased distraction, rather than a count of crashes directly observed during the study.
paras.zh: 虽然 CMT 的调查结果表明危险驾驶行为显着增加，但该公司对 510 起额外碰撞事故和 290 起伤害的估计代表了对分心增加影响的模型评估，而不是研究期间直接观察到的碰撞事故计数。

paras.en: For collision repair businesses, the research provides additional insight into how changes in driver behavior can affect accident frequency and repair demand.
paras.zh: 对于碰撞维修业务来说，该研究提供了关于驾驶员行为变化如何影响事故频率和维修需求的更多见解。

paras.en: Although the industry has experienced declining insurance claims volumes in recent years, seasonal increases in speeding and distracted driving remain important factors influencing collision risk.
paras.zh: 尽管近年来该行业的保险索赔量有所下降，但超速和分心驾驶的季节性增加仍然是影响碰撞风险的重要因素。

paras.en: The findings also reinforce the importance of distinguishing between overall vehicle travel, collision frequency and repairable insurance claims. An increase in risky driving behavior does not necessarily translate into a proportional increase in collision repair volume, particularly as vehicle repair costs and total-loss rates continue to influence which damaged vehicles are repaired.
paras.zh: 研究结果还强调了区分车辆整体行驶、碰撞频率和可修复保险索赔的重要性。危险驾驶行为的增加并不一定会转化为碰撞维修量的成比例增加，特别是因为车辆维修成本和全损率继续影响修复哪些受损车辆。

paras.en: CMT’s research suggests that reducing distractions, avoiding unnecessary speeding and planning travel to minimize fatigue and time pressures could help motorists lower their risk of a crash during the Thanksgiving holiday.
paras.zh: CMT 的研究表明，减少分心、避免不必要的超速并计划出行以最大程度地减少疲劳和时间压力，可以帮助驾车者降低感恩节假期期间发生车祸的风险。

paras.en: The complete findings are available in Cambridge Mobile Telematics’ U.S. Fall & Winter Holiday Road Risk Report.
paras.zh: 完整的调查结果可在 Cambridge Mobile Telematics 的美国秋冬假期道路风险报告中找到。

articles.title: Waymo banned from California freeways following recent traffic incidents
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Multiple news outlets report that recent traffic accidents involving Waymo robotaxis have led the California Department of Motor Vehicles to ban them from state freeways.
paras.zh: 多家新闻媒体报道称，最近发生的涉及 Waymo 机器人出租车的交通事故导致加州机动车辆管理局禁止其在州高速公路上行驶。

paras.en: Waymo has temporarily stopped all driverless freeway service, according to the Associated Press. The rides had been offered in the San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles, as well as in Phoenix, Arizona; Miami, Florida; and Austin, Texas.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，Waymo 已暂时停止所有无人驾驶高速公路服务。这些游乐设施已在旧金山湾区、洛杉矶以及亚利桑那州凤凰城提供。佛罗里达州迈阿密；和德克萨斯州奥斯汀。

paras.en: A Waymo spokesperson told the AP that the company would be “continuing freeway testing with trained autonomous specialists behind the wheel.”
paras.zh: Waymo 发言人告诉美联社，该公司将“在训练有素的自动驾驶专家的指导下继续进行高速公路测试”。

paras.en: “The suspension was implemented last Wednesday, according to the spokesperson, but they didn’t say how long it would last,” the article states.
paras.zh: 文章称，“发言人表示，暂停是上周三实施的，但他们没有说明会持续多久。”

paras.en: According to CBS News, the DMV said on Tuesday it issued restrictions on Nov. 11 because the vehicles “pose an imminent hazard to public safety due to recurring incursions by its vehicles into active construction zones where construction workers, vehicles and equipment are present.”
paras.zh: 据哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，DMV 周二表示，它于 11 月 11 日发布了限制措施，因为这些车辆“由于其车辆反复侵入有建筑工人、车辆和设备存在的活跃施工区域，对公共安全构成迫在眉睫的危险。”

paras.en: DMV spokesperson Jonathan Groveman said the ban followed two incidents, one in which three Waymo driverless vehicles drove into a construction zone on Nov. 5, according to the AP. He added that “similar incidents” occurred on May 18.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，DMV 发言人乔纳森·格罗夫曼 (Jonathan Groveman) 表示，该禁令是在发生两起事件后发布的，其中一起事件是 11 月 5 日三辆 Waymo 无人驾驶汽车驶入建筑工地。他补充说，5月18日也发生过“类似事件”。

paras.en: On Nov. 6, a Waymo vehicle reportedly tried to bypass California Highway Patrol vehicles conducting a traffic break, the AP reports.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，11 月 6 日，一辆 Waymo 车辆试图绕过正在进行交通堵塞的加州公路巡逻队车辆。

paras.en: Earlier this week, The Guardian shared footage of the Nov. 6 incident:
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，《卫报》分享了 11 月 6 日事件的片段：

paras.en: “Waymo in June because of multiple instances in April and May of their self-driving software failing to recognize ramp closures and construction zones in Arizona and California,” CBS News reports. “The move followed the company’s pause on freeway rides in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Phoenix and Miami, Florida to improve its vehicles’ performance and response in freeway construction zones.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 新闻报道称，“Waymo 之所以在 6 月份这么做，是因为其自动驾驶软件在 4 月和 5 月多次未能识别亚利桑那州和加利福尼亚州的匝道关闭和施工区域。” “在此之前，该公司暂停了旧金山、洛杉矶、菲尼克斯和佛罗里达州迈阿密的高速公路行驶，以提高车辆在高速公路施工区的性能和响应。

paras.en: “In addition, the Mountain View, California-based company in May paused service in Georgia and Texas because its . In December 2025, Waymo recalled about 3,000 vehicles after when its red lights were flashing and stop arm extended. In San Francisco, Waymo’s self-driving software struggles also include and .”
paras.zh: “此外，这家总部位于加利福尼亚州山景城的公司于 5 月暂停了在佐治亚州和德克萨斯州的服务，原因是……。2025 年 12 月，Waymo 在红灯闪烁和制动臂伸出后召回了约 3,000 辆汽车。在旧金山，Waymo 的自动驾驶软件困境还包括……。”

paras.en: On Tuesday, USA Today shared video of an incident involving a Waymo robotaxi at a San Diego railroad crossing.
paras.zh: 周二，《今日美国》分享了有关 Waymo 机器人出租车在圣地亚哥铁路道口发生事故的视频。

paras.en: “Witness Holly Hudson said the self-driving car initially stalled while the way was clear and only moved through the crossing as the barriers came down,” reports USA Today.
paras.zh: 据《今日美国》报道，“目击者霍莉·哈德森表示，自动驾驶汽车最初在道路畅通时熄火，直到路障拆除后才通过十字路口。”

paras.en: Waymo’s homepage includes videos that show how its vehicles have responded to certain scenarios. Among them are a Waymo vehicle avoiding a police vehicle with its lights on, a vehicle running a red light, and a skateboarder running into the road. The site doesn’t mention the freeway ban.
paras.zh: Waymo 的主页包含展示其车辆如何响应某些场景的视频。其中包括一辆 Waymo 车辆避开开着灯的警车、一辆闯红灯的车辆以及一名滑板手冲进道路。该网站没有提及高速公路禁令。

paras.en: In September, Waymo said at least 841 people have avoided injuries in traffic crashes across 270 million autonomous miles through the end of June.
paras.zh: 9 月，Waymo 表示，截至 6 月底，在 2.7 亿英里的自动驾驶里程中，至少 841 人避免了交通事故中的伤害。

paras.en: A report on the safety performance of Waymo’s self-driving car technology, Waymo Driver, analyzes five major metropolitan service areas: Atlanta, Georgia; Austin, Texas; Los Angeles, California; Phoenix, Arizona; and San Francisco, California.
paras.zh: 一份关于 Waymo 自动驾驶汽车技术安全性能的报告 Waymo Driver 分析了五个主要大都市服务区域：亚特兰大、佐治亚州；德克萨斯州奥斯汀；加利福尼亚州洛杉矶；亚利桑那州菲尼克斯；和加利福尼亚州旧金山。

paras.en: “Across these cities, the Waymo Driver continues to outperform human benchmarks,” a Waymo press release states. “Regardless of fault, it was involved in 841 fewer injury-causing crashes — an 82% reduction compared to human drivers.”
paras.zh: Waymo 新闻稿称：“在这些城市中，Waymo Driver 的表现继续优于人类基准。” “无论发生什么错误，它所造成的伤害事故都减少了 841 起，与人类驾驶员相比减少了 82%。”

paras.en: It adds that in more severe collisions, the Waymo Driver was involved in 95%, or 19 times fewer, serious injury or worse crashes than humans.
paras.zh: 它还补充说，在更严重的碰撞中，Waymo 驾驶员发生的严重伤害或更严重的碰撞事故占人类的 95%，即少 19 倍。

paras.en: Featured image: Two Waymo robotaxis in Belmont, California, on Oct. 30, 2025. (Credit: MattGush/iStock)
paras.zh: 特色图片：2025 年 10 月 30 日，加利福尼亚州贝尔蒙特的两辆 Waymo 机器人出租车。（图片来源：MattGush/iStock）

articles.title: LexisNexis: Auto policy shopping continues but also decelerating
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: U.S. auto policy shopping and new business growth were positive but continued to decelerate in the third quarter, according to LexisNexis Insurance Demand Meter.
paras.zh: 根据 LexisNexis Insurance Demand Meter 的数据，美国汽车保单购买和新业务增长积极，但在第三季度继续放缓。

paras.en: Quarterly year-over-year shopping growth clocked in at 0.7%, down from 1.4% in Q2. New business growth was 3.2%, down slightly from last quarter’s 3.3%, the report states.
paras.zh: 季度购物同比增长率为 0.7%，低于第二季度的 1.4%。报告称，新业务增长率为 3.2%，略低于上季度的 3.3%。

paras.en: “While shopping activity remained strong, new business growth outpaced it for the fourth consecutive quarter,” the report states. “This highlights consumer commitment to securing new, more favorable policies in a competitive and price-sensitive market.”
paras.zh: 报告指出：“虽然购物活动依然强劲，但新业务增长连续第四个季度超过购物活动。” “这凸显了消费者对在竞争激烈且对价格敏感的市场中获得新的、更优惠的政策的承诺。”

paras.en: Forty-seven percent of policies-in-force had been shopped at least once in the previous 12 months at the end of Q3. This matched Q2 and is slightly down from Q1.
paras.zh: 截至第三季度末，47% 的有效保单在过去 12 个月内至少购买过一次。这与第二季度相当，但比第一季度略有下降。

paras.en: “Consistency in the annual shop rate may reflect a broader shift in how policyholders approach shopping,” the report adds. “Sustained, elevated shopping levels suggest that some consumers are evaluating their policy options on a more regular basis, particularly if the opportunity for more favorable premiums arises.”
paras.zh: 报告补充道：“年度购物率的一致性可能反映出保单持有人购物方式的更广泛转变。” “购物水平持续上升表明，一些消费者正在更定期地评估他们的保单选择，特别是在有机会获得更优惠保费的情况下。”

paras.en: The exclusive distribution channel saw higher growth than the direct and independent channels, the report finds. Exclusive channel growth was up 4.5%, down from 6.8% in the previous quarter. Direct channel growth dropped to 1.8% from 4.6%. The independent channel grew 1.5%, up from -6.4% last quarter.
paras.zh: 报告发现，独家分销渠道的增长高于直接和独立渠道。独家渠道增长 4.5%，低于上一季度的 6.8%。直接渠道增长率从 4.6% 下降至 1.8%。独立频道增长 1.5%，高于上季度的-6.4%。

paras.en: “Non-standard shopping surged ahead of standard shopping and posted positive growth for the first time in 2026,” the report states.
paras.zh: 报告指出：“非标准购物大幅领先于标准购物，并在 2026 年首次实现正增长。”

paras.en: It adds that non-standard shoppers grew 5.4%, up from -9% in Q2. Standard shopping grew at 1.3%, a dip from 2.6% in Q2.
paras.zh: 它补充说，非标准购物者增长了 5.4%，高于第二季度的-9%。标准购物增长 1.3%，低于第二季度的 2.6%。

paras.en: Policyholders aged 66 and older continued to be the strongest shopping growth among all ages for the 15th consecutive quarter. The 36 to 45 age group was the only other policyholder group to see positive gains quarter over quarter, increasing by 0.4% to 0.6%.
paras.zh: 66 岁及以上的保单持有人连续第 15 个季度成为所有年龄段中购物增长最强劲的群体。 36 至 45 岁年龄段是唯一一个季度环比增长的保单持有人群体，增幅为 0.4% 至 0.6%。

paras.en: Twenty-eight states witnessed positive growth in Q3, compared to 42 states in the second and 37 states in the first. Fourteen states recorded a decline.
paras.zh: 第三季度有 28 个州出现正增长，而第二季度有 42 个州，第一季度有 37 个州。十四个州出现下降。

paras.en: “The wider range of growth rates coincides with a mix of positive, negative, and rate-neutral filings across the market,” the report states.
paras.zh: 报告指出：“更广泛的增长率与整个市场上积极、消极和利率中性的申请混合在一起。”

paras.en: Michigan led all states in Q3 with 7% shopping growth, followed by New Jersey (6.8%), Connecticut (6.6%), Georgia (6.6%), and Nevada (6.2%).
paras.zh: 密歇根州在第三季度以 7% 的购物增长领先所有州，其次是新泽西州 (6.8%)、康涅狄格州 (6.6%)、佐治亚州 (6.6%) 和内华达州 (6.2%)。

paras.en: Lost policies account for 18% of active policies annually, according to the report. It adds that nearly 30% of the lost policies exit the market and about 70% remain active.
paras.zh: 报告称，每年丢失的保单占有效保单的 18%。报告补充称，近 30% 的丢失保单退出市场，约 70% 的保单仍然有效。

paras.en: “The active cohort either switches carriers, returns to the original carrier or moves from having dual coverage to a single insurer,” according to the report.
paras.zh: 报告称，“活跃人群要么更换承保商，要么返回原来的承保商，要么从双重承保转向单一承保。”

paras.en: Overall, switching rose from 49% in 2024 to 53% in 2026, and market exits declined from 32% to 39%, the report states.
paras.zh: 报告指出，总体而言，转换率从 2024 年的 49% 上升到 2026 年的 53%，市场退出率从 32% 下降到 39%。

paras.en: “First-year policyholders are a particularly vulnerable segment,” the report states. “They represent 40% of lost policies and more than 50% of market exits. Among these policyholders, switching increased from 35% to 42%, and exits fell from 44% to 38%.”
paras.zh: 报告指出：“第一年保单持有人是特别脆弱的群体。” “他们占丢失保单的 40%，占市场退出的 50% 以上。在这些投保人中，转换保单的比例从 35% 增加到 42%，退出比例从 44% 下降到 38%。”

paras.en: It adds that this could point to a retention cliff at first renewal or a lack of policyholder loyalty, consumer price sensitivity, or continued active engagement in shopping.
paras.zh: 它补充说，这可能会导致首次续保时出现保留悬崖，或缺乏保单持有人忠诚度、消费者价格敏感性或持续积极参与购物。

paras.en: “Third quarter trends remained consistent with what the market experienced in the first half of the year,” the report states. “Shopping and switching remain at record highs, and while growth in each has slowed, volumes continue to reach higher levels. The fourth quarter typically experiences a shopping lull; however, against a backdrop of consumer affordability pressures, the prevalence of AI and the onset of agentic shopping, the market may once again buck that trend.”
paras.zh: 报告指出：“第三季度的趋势与上半年市场的情况保持一致。” “购物和转换仍保持在创纪录的高位，虽然两者的增长都在放缓，但交易量继续达到更高的水平。第四季度通常会经历购物平静期；然而，在消费者承受能力压力、人工智能盛行和代理购物兴起的背景下，市场可能会再次逆转这一趋势。”

paras.en: Feature and embedded graphs courtesy of LexisNexis.
paras.zh: 特征和嵌入图表由 LexisNexis 提供。

articles.title: Shops raise concerns over Allstate ADAS calibration pricing practices
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Collision repair shops have raised concerns that Allstate and National General are limiting ADAS calibration payments based on information from Kinetic, a software and robotics company.
paras.zh: 碰撞维修店担心 Allstate 和 National General 根据软件和机器人公司 Kinetic 的信息限制 ADAS 校准费用。

paras.en: A shop owner and Repairer Driven News reader who preferred not to use their name told RDN that after posting their thoughts on the subject on an online forum, several other shops shared similar experiences. The reader said they personally questioned Allstate, in part, on behalf of a body shop they sublet for.
paras.zh: 一位不愿透露姓名的店主兼《维修驱动新闻》读者告诉 RDN，在在线论坛上发表了他们对此主题的想法后，其他几家商店也分享了类似的经历。该读者表示，他们亲自向好事达提出质疑，部分是代表他们转租的一家车身维修店。

paras.en: RDN attempted to reach Allstate several times with questions, but the company didn’t respond.
paras.zh: RDN 多次尝试联系 Allstate 提出问题，但该公司没有回应。

paras.en: “Allstate basically said, ‘We’re not paying the calibration prices,’ and then they updated the RO with the pricing,” the anonymous reader said. “I’m like, ‘Wow, that looks kind of low, not terrible, but it’s lower than what I typically see.'”
paras.zh: “好事达基本上说，‘我们不支付校准价格’，然后他们用定价更新了 RO，”这位匿名读者说。 “我想，‘哇，这看起来有点低，并不可怕，但它比我通常看到的要低。’”

paras.en: They added that after providing Allstate with documentation to support the operations, the insurer continued pushing the reimbursement prices they wanted to pay, then mentioned Kinetic.
paras.zh: 他们补充说，在向好事达提供了支持运营的文件后，保险公司继续提高他们想要支付的报销价格，然后提到了 Kinetic。

paras.en: They provided an Oct. 12 email from an Allstate Claims Division representative:
paras.zh: 他们提供了 Allstate 索赔部门代表 10 月 12 日发送的一封电子邮件：

paras.en: The reader likened Allstate’s pricing with Kinetic to following direct repair program terms without actually being in a DRP. They said: “They’re not just dictating what calibrations need to be done. They shouldn’t do that. Now, they’re dictating pricing.”
paras.zh: 读者将好事达与 Kinetic 的定价比作遵循直接维修计划条款，而实际上并未纳入 DRP。他们说：“他们不仅规定了需要进行哪些校准。他们不应该这样做。现在，他们规定了定价。”

paras.en: Emails provided by other RDN readers also show similar instances occurring:
paras.zh: 其他 RDN 读者提供的电子邮件也显示类似的情况正在发生：

paras.en: Documents shared with RDN from repair facilities show that reports Allstate provided to them list Allstate Insurance Company as the customer.
paras.zh: 维修机构与 RDN 共享的文件显示，Allstate 提供给他们的报告将 Allstate 保险公司列为客户。

paras.en: RDN spoke to Kinetic CEO and co-founder Nikhil Naikal. While he wouldn’t share specific information related to Kinetic’s relationship with Allstate, Naikal wanted to emphasize Kinetic doesn’t set insurer calibration pricing, and said Kinetic ID, his company’s ADAS calibration identification software, “is intended to support and not replace the repair professional’s evaluation of that vehicle and any applicable OEM procedures.”
paras.zh: RDN 采访了 Kinetic 首席执行官兼联合创始人 Nikhil Naikal。虽然 Naikal 不愿透露与 Kinetic 与 Allstate 关系相关的具体信息，但他想强调 Kinetic 并不设定保险公司校准定价，并表示其公司的 ADAS 校准识别软件 Kinetic ID“旨在支持而不是取代维修专业人员对该车辆的评估以及任何适用的 OEM 程序。”

paras.en: “We follow OEM procedures, so what we help the user that is using the software do is to interpret the OEM calibration requirements, not override them, but to interpret them based on the repair estimate that they’ve already written,” he said. “Our data comes from technical resources like OEM documentation and I-CAR and places like that. Our software is a tool to help repair professionals identify the necessary procedures. It is not a substitute for OEM repair documentation or any professional judgment of the repairer or the repair facility.”
paras.zh: “我们遵循 OEM 程序，因此我们帮助使用该软件的用户所做的就是解释 OEM 校准要求，而不是推翻它们，而是根据他们已经编写的维修估算来解释它们，”他说。 “我们的数据来自 OEM 文档和 I-CAR 等技术资源。我们的软件是帮助维修专业人员确定必要程序的工具。它不能替代 OEM 维修文档或维修人员或维修机构的任何专业判断。”

paras.en: Naikal added that insurance carriers set their own pricing.
paras.zh: 奈卡尔补充说，保险公司自行定价。

paras.en: “When we receive that specific insurance pricing, we program that into our system, so it’s not our pricing,” he said. “We are not setting insurance pricing. We are a tiny company that has no say in pricing decisions. We are just following the pricing that the carriers are determining themselves if they choose to disclose it to us.”
paras.zh: “当我们收到特定的保险定价时，我们会将其编程到我们的系统中，所以这不是我们的定价，”他说。 “我们不会制定保险定价。我们是一家小公司，在定价决策方面没有发言权。如果运营商选择向我们披露的话，我们只是遵循他们自行确定的定价。”

paras.en: Naikal explained that Kinetic ID provides a technical assessment based on vehicle information and repair operations that are available at the time of the analysis.
paras.zh: Naikal 解释说，Kinetic ID 根据分析时可用的车辆信息和维修操作提供技术评估。

paras.en: “If a repair facility identifies additional requirements supported by OEM documentation, those findings should be considered as part of the repair assessment,” he said. “Kinetic’s technical conclusion can be reviewed when additional repair information becomes available. The decisions regarding any sort of reimbursement, be it from an insurer or charging a customer who’s paying out of pocket, they’re made by the payer, not by Kinetic. The applicable payer determines the process for reviewing and disputing any payment decisions. That has nothing to do with Kinetic.”
paras.zh: “如果维修机构确定了 OEM 文件支持的额外要求，这些发现应被视为维修评估的一部分，”他说。 “当获得更多维修信息时，可以审查 Kinetic 的技术结论。有关任何形式的报销的决定，无论是来自保险公司还是向自付费用的客户收费，都是由付款人做出的，而不是由 Kinetic 做出的。适用的付款人决定审查和质疑任何付款决定的流程。这与 Kinetic 无关。”

paras.en: He added that the software produces the same output, regardless of who the user is, whether that’s a repairer, an insurer, or a consumer.
paras.zh: 他补充说，无论用户是谁，无论是修理工、保险公司还是消费者，该软件都会产生相同的输出。

paras.en: “We are not implementing different hierarchies or decision profiles on what the software produces and then output based on who the user is; it’s one uniform user,” Naikal said. “We are not in cahoots with anyone. We are an independent company that’s trying to do our best to make repairs safer.”
paras.zh: “我们不会对软件生成的内容实施不同的层次结构或决策配置文件，然后根据用户是谁进行输出；这是一个统一的用户，”奈卡尔说。 “我们不与任何人勾结。我们是一家独立的公司，正在尽力让维修变得更安全。”

paras.en: If the software deviates from what shops are seeing, Naikal said context can be added to explain why repairers think the software is wrong, and the software will consider it and reevaluate.
paras.zh: 奈卡尔表示，如果软件与商店所看到的有所不同，可以添加上下文来解释为什么维修人员认为软件是错误的，软件会考虑并重新评估。

paras.en: When asked, Naikal did confirm that Allstate Strategic Ventures has invested in Kinetic.
paras.zh: 当被问及时，奈卡尔确实证实好事达战略风险投资公司已经投资了 Kinetic。

paras.en: In June 2024, Kinetic said in a press release that it was “pleased to have received strategic investments from the venture arms of Liberty Mutual Insurance and Allstate Insurance.” The release says Kinetic received $21 million in Series B funding, but doesn’t share how much came from Allstate and Liberty Mutual.
paras.zh: 2024 年 6 月，Kinetic 在一份新闻稿中表示，“很高兴获得 Liberty Mutual Insurance 和 Allstate Insurance 风险投资部门的战略投资。”新闻稿称 Kinetic 获得了 2100 万美元的 B 轮融资，但没有透露来自 Allstate 和 Liberty Mutual 的资金数额。

paras.en: There is also a website with an Allstate-specific Kinetic login. Naikal wouldn’t confirm to RDN that Allstate has a unique Kinetic profile.
paras.zh: 还有一个网站提供 Allstate 特定的 Kinetic 登录信息。 Naikal 没有向 RDN 证实 Allstate 拥有独特的 Kinetic 配置文件。

paras.en: “I cannot talk about individual commercial relationships between Kinetic and any customer at this time,” he said.
paras.zh: “目前我无法谈论 Kinetic 与任何客户之间的个人商业关系，”他说。

paras.en: RDN readers have also told us about a separate industry issue involving Allstate, and the company hasn’t returned our request for information.
paras.zh: RDN 读者还告诉我们涉及好事达的一个单独的行业问题，该公司尚未回复我们的信息请求。

paras.en: In September, an Allstate Good Hands Repair Network (GHRN) senior damage consultant emailed a group of repair facilities directing them to bill 0.5 mechanical hours for pre- and post-scans:
paras.zh: 9 月，Allstate Good Hands Repair Network (GHRN) 高级损坏顾问向一组维修机构发送了电子邮件，指示他们针对扫描前和扫描后收取 0.5 个机械小时的费用：

paras.en: A document attached to the email establishes the payment methodology but also states GHRN facilities should determine the need for scanning on a case-by-case basis, considering vehicle age, damage, ADAS equipment, restraint deployment, and vehicle-specific OEM procedures.
paras.zh: 电子邮件附带的文件规定了付款方法，但也指出 GHRN 设施应根据具体情况确定是否需要扫描，并考虑车龄、损坏情况、ADAS 设备、约束装置部署和特定于车辆的 OEM 程序。

paras.en: The document also states, “Allstate expects our Good Hands Repair Network facilities to maintain up-to-date vehicle scanning equipment capable of scanning most vehicles, including those requiring OE licensed data across multiple vehicle brands.”
paras.zh: 该文件还指出，“好事达希望我们的 Good Hands Repair Network 设施能够维护最新的车辆扫描设备，能够扫描大多数车辆，包括那些需要跨多个车辆品牌的原厂许可数据的车辆。”

paras.en: Allstate’s basis for specifying a set limit on mechanical hours is unclear. RDN’s several attempts to reach Allstate were unreturned.
paras.zh: 好事达规定机械工作时间限制的依据尚不清楚。 RDN 多次尝试联系 Allstate，但均未得到回复。

paras.en: Featured image credit: Brett_Hondow/iStock
paras.zh: 特色图片来源：Brett_Hondow/iStock

articles.title: Mitchell 1 Adds QuickSpecs Feature for Faster Repair Lookup
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Mitchell 1 has added a “QuickSpecs” feature in its ProDemand repair information, aimed at helping technicians look things up faster.
paras.zh: Mitchell 1 在其 ProDemand 维修信息中添加了“QuickSpecs”功能，旨在帮助技术人员更快地查找问题。

paras.en: “When technicians need specification information, they need it immediately,” said Cami Hermann, marketing director for Mitchell 1. “QuickSpecs helps eliminate unnecessary scrolling and table hunting so users can get directly to the information they need and keep repairs moving. The enhancement is part of Mitchell 1’s broader effort to streamline technician workflow and improve efficiency throughout the repair process.”
paras.zh: Mitchell 1 营销总监 Cami Hermann 表示：“当技术人员需要规格信息时，他们会立即需要。QuickSpecs 有助于消除不必要的滚动和表格搜索，因此用户可以直接获取所需信息并保持维修进度。这项增强功能是 Mitchell 1 简化技术人员工作流程并提高整个维修过程效率的更广泛努力的一部分。”

paras.en: With added integration with 1Search Plus navigation, QuickSpecs now displays only the information directly related to the search entered by the user. For example, if a technician searches for “lug nut torque,” the system immediately surfaces the matching torque specifications instead of requiring users to scroll through large tables or unrelated information, the company said.
paras.zh: 通过与 1Search Plus 导航的集成，QuickSpecs 现在仅显示与用户输入的搜索直接相关的信息。该公司表示，例如，如果技术人员搜索“凸耳螺母扭矩”，系统会立即显示匹配的扭矩规格，而不需要用户滚动浏览大表格或不相关的信息。

paras.en: Mitchell 1 says it also redesigned the Common Specs Quick Link experience with a cleaner accordion-style layout Instead of searching through one long table, users can jump directly to the section they need.
paras.zh: Mitchell 1 表示，它还重新设计了 Common Specs Quick Link 体验，采用了更简洁的手风琴式布局，用户可以直接跳转到他们需要的部分，而不是在一张长表格中搜索。

paras.en: QuickSpecs currently supports 2015-2026 vehicles at launch, and Mitchell 1 says it expects to add coverage for 1995-2014 vehicles by the end of 2026.
paras.zh: QuickSpecs 目前在发布时支持 2015-2026 年生产的车辆，Mitchell 1 表示预计到 2026 年底将增加对 1995-2014 年生产车辆的覆盖范围。

articles.title: Autel Expands Nissan Diagnostic and ADAS Access
articles.author: ImportCar Staff Writers

paras.en: Autel U.S. has released diagnostic and ADAS software updates for Nissan vehicles using the Consult 4 platform. The updates expand bidirectional control and ADAS calibration access across supported North American vehicles.
paras.zh: Autel U.S. 已使用 Consult 4 平台为日产汽车发布了诊断和 ADAS 软件更新。这些更新扩展了受支持的北美车辆的双向控制和 ADAS 校准访问。

paras.en: The Nissan diagnostic software is available on supported MaxiSYS Ultra and Ultra S2 tablets. ADAS calibration capability is available on these tablets with ADAS calibration software installed.
paras.zh: Nissan 诊断软件可在受支持的 MaxiSYS Ultra 和 Ultra S2 平板电脑上使用。这些安装了 ADAS 校准软件的平板电脑上提供 ADAS 校准功能。

paras.en: Available functions depend on the vehicle and system. They include ECU information, code reading and clearing, live data, Active Tests and ADAS calibration procedures.
paras.zh: 可用功能取决于车辆和系统。其中包括 ECU 信息、代码读取和清除、实时数据、主动测试和 ADAS 校准程序。

paras.en: Supported Autel tablets access protected vehicle functions through AutoAuth. The independent service works with manufacturers and aftermarket tool providers to verify shops, technicians and tools for secure vehicle access.
paras.zh: 支持的 Autel 平板电脑通过 AutoAuth 访问受保护的车辆功能。该独立服务与制造商和售后工具提供商合作，验证商店、技术人员和工具以确保车辆安全访问。

paras.en: Authenticated Access for Newer Nissan Platforms
paras.zh: 对较新 Nissan 平台进行身份验证的访问

paras.en: Nissan began incorporating security-gateway protections into select North American vehicles with the 2020 model year. These protections restrict designated bidirectional functions unless the technician, shop and diagnostic tool receive proper authentication.
paras.zh: 日产开始将安全网关保护纳入 2020 年款的精选北美车辆中。这些保护措施限制指定的双向功能，除非技术人员、车间和诊断工具得到适当的认证。

paras.en: Autel has offered AutoAuth-based Nissan security-gateway access for several years. The access applies to vehicles supported by Nissan’s Consult-III plus diagnostic platform.
paras.zh: Autel 多年来一直提供基于 AutoAuth 的 Nissan 安全网关访问。该访问权限适用于日产 Consult-III plus 诊断平台支持的车辆。

paras.en: Nissan introduced its newer web-based Consult 4 diagnostic software for the 2023 Nissan Ariya. The automaker now uses the software on a growing number of newer vehicle platforms.
paras.zh: Nissan 为 2023 款 Nissan Ariya 推出了更新的基于网络的 Consult 4 诊断软件。该汽车制造商现在在越来越多的新型车辆平台上使用该软件。

paras.en: Supporting protected functions required Autel to develop and validate a compatible authorization process. The process works with the vehicles’ newer electronic architectures.
paras.zh: 支持受保护的功能需要 Autel 开发并验证兼容的授权流程。该过程适用于车辆更新的电子架构。

paras.en: Autel’s new capability expands diagnostic and ADAS calibration access across supported Nissan vehicles using Consult 4.
paras.zh: Autel 的新功能使用 Consult 4 扩展了支持的 Nissan 车辆的诊断和 ADAS 校准访问。

paras.en: Available functions depend on the vehicle and system. They include ECU information, code reading and clearing, live data, Active Tests and ADAS calibration procedures.
paras.zh: 可用功能取决于车辆和系统。其中包括 ECU 信息、代码读取和清除、实时数据、主动测试和 ADAS 校准程序。

paras.en: North American Nissan vehicles using Consult 4 include:
paras.zh: 使用 Consult 4 的北美 Nissan 车辆包括：

paras.en: - 2025 and newer Nissan Kicks, Murano, Pathfinder and Armada
paras.zh: - 2025 年及更新款 Nissan Kicks、Murano、Pathfinder 和 Armada

paras.en: Autel issued the expanded capabilities through the Nissan_V7.40 diagnostic software and Nissan_ADAS V5.20 software released on Sept. 9.
paras.zh: Autel通过9月9日发布的Nissan_V7.40诊断软件和Nissan_ADAS V5.20软件发布了扩展功能。

paras.en: Access requires an active Autel software subscription and an active AutoAuth account for Nissan access. ADAS calibration also requires applicable Autel software, equipment, targets and accessories.
paras.zh: 访问需要有效的 Autel 软件订阅和有效的 AutoAuth 帐户才能进行 Nissan 访问。 ADAS 校准还需要适用的 Autel 软件、设备、目标和配件。

paras.en: Supported Consult 4 vehicle coverage does not require a separate AutoAuth service tier. Eligible users can obtain the software releases through the standard update process on their Autel tablet.
paras.zh: 支持的 Consult 4 车辆覆盖范围不需要单独的 AutoAuth 服务层。符合条件的用户可以通过 Autel 平板电脑上的标准更新流程获取软件版本。

articles.title: What Makes the Perfect ADAS Technician?
articles.author: Mitch Becker

paras.en: I was recently asked, “What makes the perfect technician?” Before I could answer, I had to think about whether we were talking about a forward-facing camera specialist in the glass industry, an ADAS technician or a diagnostic technician for vehicle electronics.
paras.zh: 最近有人问我：“什么才是完美的技术人员？”在回答之前，我必须思考我们谈论的是玻璃行业的前置摄像头专家、ADAS 技术人员还是车辆电子诊断技术人员。

paras.en: Was the person who asked me that question seeking a wish list of skills or a description of what I would want in that person? It really is two trains of thought with a list of variables and bunny trails of conversation to go down no matter who you ask. My answer might be totally different than someone else based on the needs of that person.
paras.zh: 问我这个问题的人是在寻求一份我想要的技能清单，还是我想要那个人具备什么素质的描述？这实际上是两条思路，包含一系列变量和兔子对话轨迹，无论你问谁。根据那个人的需求，我的答案可能与其他人完全不同。

paras.en: I can describe the “unicorn” technician who knows everything, or I can describe the work ethic of someone who will be a diamond in the rough. The factor I personally look at is what’s ahead for the automotive repair industry, not where the industry is today. The perfect technician in my mind will adapt to change as it happens.
paras.zh: 我可以描述一个无所不知的“独角兽”技术人员，或者我可以描述一个将成为未经加工的钻石的人的职业道德。我个人关注的是汽车维修行业的未来，而不是行业的现状。我心目中完美的技术人员会适应发生的变化。

paras.en: As I started writing this article, I started thinking of the things a technician needs to be successful and how to “build” or develop that technician’s abilities — a key factor. Do you find an already-built model technician, or do you build your own and develop him or her to be the best technician? Then you must address whether or not you hire experience or if you have the time and commitment to develop that person into a technician or team and dedicate resources to keep training them and keep moving with new technology? It’s a dilemma that many shops and companies face in the repair industry today. If hiring experience is the course you take, then I hope you remember the one thing that will be a constant throughout all of the industry: change. Also, no one knows it all.
paras.zh: 当我开始写这篇文章时，我开始思考技术人员要成功需要具备哪些条件，以及如何“构建”或发展技术人员的能力——这是一个关键因素。您是找到一个已经建立的模型技术人员，还是建立自己的模型技术人员并将其培养成最好的技术人员？然后，您必须解决是否雇用有经验的人，或者您是否有时间和承诺将该人发展为技术人员或团队并投入资源来继续培训他们并继续采用新技术？这是当今维修行业许多商店和公司面临的困境。如果您学习的是招聘经验，那么我希望您记住整个行业中不变的一件事：变化。而且，没有人知道这一切。

paras.en: The first thing I observe when I see a technician who’s successful or a technician who wants to be successful is the ability or desire to constantly learn. As the changes continue in vehicle electronics, a technician will need to adapt to all the changes we’ve experienced, plus the change we’ll be dealing with in the future. This will require constant learning through reading, training and research. The minute you stop learning and adapting, you start falling behind. This goes hand-in-hand with the ability to solve problems through challenges. The learning constantly being gained gives a solid base of knowledge to draw from when challenges and “situations” arise that complicate repairs and/or calibrations.
paras.zh: 当我看到一个成功的技术人员或一个想要成功的技术人员时，我观察到的第一件事就是不断学习的能力或愿望。随着汽车电子设备的不断变化，技术人员将需要适应我们经历过的所有变化，以及我们未来将要处理的变化。这需要通过阅读、培训和研究不断学习。一旦你停止学习和适应，你就开始落后。这与通过挑战解决问题的能力密切相关。当出现使维修和/或校准复杂化的挑战和“情况”时，不断获得的学习提供了坚实的知识基础。

paras.en: The technician who’s constantly learning also follows all the processes correctly without taking shortcuts or cutting corners. Recognizing the importance of doing all the steps and processes every time not only provides consistent results but improves diagnostic capabilities and speed in parsing through the multiple causes of, say, a failed calibration to determine the root cause. Those technicians who are not following all the processes and steps will find themselves in quicksand very easily trying to find out why repairs or calibrations are failing to complete.
paras.zh: 不断学习的技术人员也能正确遵循所有流程，不走捷径或偷工减料。认识到每次执行所有步骤和过程的重要性，不仅可以提供一致的结果，还可以提高诊断能力和解析多种原因（例如校准失败）以确定根本原因的速度。那些没有遵循所有流程和步骤的技术人员会很容易发现自己陷入流沙，试图找出维修或校准无法完成的原因。

paras.en: Being a good partner versus merely providing a service to a customer helps a technician actually build a career and grow opportunities within the company. A technician can have all the talent in the world, but if he or she does not understand the customers’ needs, that potential will be limited — and the customers’ business will be negatively affected.
paras.zh: 作为一个好的合作伙伴，而不是仅仅为客户提供服务，可以帮助技术人员在公司内真正建立职业生涯并增加机会。一个技术人员可以拥有世界上所有的才能，但如果他或她不了解客户的需求，那么他或她的潜力就会受到限制，客户的业务也会受到负面影响。

paras.en: This is also where work ethic comes into play. Being on time and keeping commitments means a great deal to a customer and builds trust that serves both the technician and customer well. This is the start of both the technician and the company establishing a good reputation. If you’re the best technician but not dependable, this creates a counterproductive situation for all. Having the right mindset and also understanding the customer provides a foundation for the technician that’s priceless in the repair industry; the rest is skills and experience needed to do the job.
paras.zh: 这也是职业道德发挥作用的地方。准时和信守承诺对客户来说意义重大，并建立信任，为技术人员和客户提供良好的服务。这是技术人员和公司建立良好声誉的开始。如果您是最好的技术人员但不可靠，这会给所有人带来适得其反的情况。拥有正确的心态并了解客户为技术人员奠定了基础，这在维修行业中是无价的；剩下的就是完成这项工作所需的技能和经验。

paras.en: I already mentioned that following the OEM procedures is a key factor for all successful technicians. But there are other pieces of knowledge that all level of vehicle electronics technicians must have to do the tasks required. For example, an understanding of:
paras.zh: 我已经提到过，遵循 OEM 程序是所有成功技术人员的关键因素。但各级车辆电子技术人员还必须具备其他知识才能完成所需的任务。例如，了解：

paras.en: Add to this a variety of competencies needed depending on the level of technician needed. These competencies can be broken down into a multitude of skills for a technician:
paras.zh: 根据所需技术人员的水平，添加所需的各种能力。对于技术人员来说，这些能力可以细分为多种技能：

paras.en: - Navigating aftermarket and OE software
paras.zh: - 导航售后市场和原厂软件

paras.en: - Establishing and measuring geometric angles
paras.zh: - 建立和测量几何角度

paras.en: When you add all this together, you get a technician who will perform at an optimum level and grow him- or herself and your business. This technician will be dependable and will be appreciated by employer and customer alike.
paras.zh: 当您将所有这些加在一起时，您将获得一名能够以最佳水平工作并发展自己和您的业务的技术人员。该技术人员将是可靠的，并将受到雇主和客户的赞赏。

paras.en: This is a hard business, given that you have to keep up with all the changes in every make and model of vehicle out there. The diagnostic technician position is not for everyone. We’ve all seen companies and individuals who talk a big game but fall short when called upon to perform.
paras.zh: 这是一项艰巨的任务，因为您必须跟上每种品牌和型号的车辆的所有变化。诊断技术员职位并不适合所有人。我们都见过一些公司和个人口口声声说得很大，但在实际行动中却表现不佳。

paras.en: Without the kind of foundation I mentioned that a technician needs, you end up with an interesting situation.
paras.zh: 如果没有我提到的技术人员所需的基础，您最终会遇到有趣的情况。

paras.en: I see all the new equipment being produced that makes it easier and somewhat faster to perform operations such as calibrations with consistency and accuracy. I think that is great, to a point. But what happens when the vehicle fails to calibrate with this equipment? Who will be the one figuring out what’s wrong or doing the diagnostics on the situation? For the work being done, do you need a diagnostic technician or, if you’re in the glass industry, do you need a forward-facing camera specialist? The difference would be in the competencies and skills needed for the position. Collision-industry level of skills would be different than for the auto glass or mechanical industry. Mechanical-industry level would be different than the collision industry, depending on shop services provided.
paras.zh: 我看到所有正在生产的新设备使执行诸如校准之类的操作变得更加容易和更快，并且具有一致性和准确性。我认为这在某种程度上很棒。但是，当车辆无法使用该设备进行校准时会发生什么情况呢？谁将是找出问题所在或对情况进行诊断的人？对于正在进行的工作，您是否需要一名诊断技术人员，或者，如果您从事玻璃行业，您是否需要一名前置摄像头专家？区别在于该职位所需的能力和技能。碰撞行业的技能水平与汽车玻璃或机械行业不同。机械行业的水平与碰撞行业不同，具体取决于所提供的商店服务。

paras.en: These different levels of technician are interesting angles on what a technician needs in terms of competencies but also in the level of training and experience required to do the tasks and/or job required. I’ve seen where ASE is addressing this with different levels of certification for technicians, which I fully support. ASE is breaking down the levels to a certification for the glass industry for forward-facing cameras, ADAS calibration technicians and diagnostic technicians. This to me shows a career path for potential technicians in all aspects of the repair industry, be it collision or mechanical (either light-duty or heavy-duty).
paras.zh: 这些不同级别的技术人员从有趣的角度来了解技术人员在能力方面的需求，以及完成所需任务和/或工作所需的培训和经验水平。我看到 ASE 正在通过为技术人员提供不同级别的认证来解决这个问题，我完全支持。 ASE 正在将前向摄像头、ADAS 校准技术人员和诊断技术人员的认证级别分解为玻璃行业认证。对我来说，这展示了维修行业各个方面的潜在技术人员的职业道路，无论是碰撞还是机械（轻型或重型）。

paras.en: The Auto Glass Safety Council (AGSC) is offering a certification for forward-facing calibration technicians in the auto glass industry. This is exciting, as a new career path is definitely growing in the auto glass repair industry, bringing in new people and a whole new interest. I also want to give SkillsUSA a shout-out, as there is talk of creating a competition at its state-level and national events for diagnostic technicians.
paras.zh: 汽车玻璃安全委员会 (AGSC) 正在为汽车玻璃行业的前向校准技术人员提供认证。这是令人兴奋的，因为汽车玻璃维修行业肯定会出现一条新的职业道路，带来新的人才和全新的兴趣。我还想对 SkillsUSA 表示赞扬，因为有人讨论在其州级和全国性活动中为诊断技术人员举办一场竞赛。

paras.en: This diagnostic technician repair path, no matter what level, is a mentally and physically challenging career. Having the correct mindset and developing the knowledge foundation will certainly help a technician build his or her skills and develop all the competencies required for a solid career. This will also develop good problem-solving skills, which will be highly respected and coveted by all as experience is gained.
paras.zh: 诊断技术人员的维修之路，无论处于何种水平，都是一项对精神和身体都具有挑战性的职业。拥有正确的心态和发展知识基础肯定会帮助技术人员培养自己的技能并发展扎实的职业所需的所有能力。这也将培养良好的解决问题的能力，随着经验的积累，这种能力将受到所有人的高度尊重和垂涎。

paras.en: A technician can be taught a lot of the skills needed and will become what you teach; a technician who has the right mindset and desire to learn will be more than what you taught. As a shop manager or owner, it’s wise to listen to your technicians and encourage them to learn — and pay attention to what they tell you they want to learn. You know what they need for training and to grow their knowledge and skills, but be careful not to dismiss requests you may feel are not relevant to position. Keeping technicians interested in learning and encouraging technicians on what they want to learn helps create the mindset you want.
paras.zh: 技术人员可以学到很多所需的技能，并且会成为你所教的人；一个拥有正确心态和学习欲望的技术人员将比你所教的更多。作为商店经理或业主，明智的做法是倾听技术人员的意见并鼓励他们学习，并注意他们告诉您他们想学习的内容。您知道他们需要什么培训以及增长知识和技能，但请注意不要拒绝您可能认为与职位无关的请求。让技术人员保持学习兴趣并鼓励技术人员学习他们想要学习的内容有助于形成您想要的心态。

articles.title: Giti Tire Names Michael Markoff Chief Operating Officer
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: Giti Tire USA has promoted Michael Markoff to chief operating officer, effective Nov. 1. The appointment comes as the company launches the Giti brand in the U.S. and builds on momentum for its GT Radial brand. Markoff previously served as executive vice president of sales and marketing. He reports to Dr. Enki Tan, executive chairman of Giti Tire.
paras.zh: 佳通轮胎美国公司已晋升迈克尔·马科夫为首席运营官，自 11 月 1 日起生效。此次任命正值该公司在美国推出佳通品牌并巩固其 GT Radial 品牌的势头。马科夫此前曾担任销售和营销执行副总裁。他向佳通轮胎执行主席 Enki Tan 博士汇报工作。

paras.en: In his expanded role, Markoff oversees sales, marketing, logistics, supply chain, technical service, industry relations and product development.
paras.zh: 在其扩大的职责范围内，马科夫负责监督销售、营销、物流、供应链、技术服务、行业关系和产品开发。

paras.en: “I am honored to take on this role and build on the strong foundation our team has established,” said Markoff. “I look forward to working with our employees, customers, and partners to strengthen our operations, enhance customer service, and support Giti Tire USA’s continued growth.
paras.zh: “我很荣幸能够担任这一职务，并在我们团队已建立的坚实基础上继续发展，”马科夫说。 “我期待与我们的员工、客户和合作伙伴合作，加强我们的运营，提高客户服务，并支持佳通轮胎美国公司的持续增长。

paras.en: During an exclusive interview at the SEMA Show, Markoff discussed his 29 years in the tire industry, including 26 with Goodyear in R&D, marketing and sales roles in the U.S. and Europe. He has also spent more than two years with Giti Tire.
paras.zh: 在 SEMA 展会上接受独家采访时，马科夫谈到了他在轮胎行业的 29 年经历，其中 26 年在固特异公司担任美国和欧洲的研发、营销和销售职务。他还在佳通轮胎工作了两年多。

paras.en: “Moving from head of sales and marketing into chief operating officer [has] been an exciting opportunity,” he said. “We have a very strong team and we’re excited about the future.”
paras.zh: “从销售和营销主管调任首席运营官是一个令人兴奋的机会，”他说。 “我们拥有一支非常强大的团队，我们对未来感到兴奋。”

paras.en: The promotion is part of a planned leadership transition. Phang Wai Yeen, formerly chief executive officer of Giti Tire’s North American operations, will now lead global research and development activities.
paras.zh: 此次晋升是计划中的领导层过渡的一部分。佳通轮胎北美业务前首席执行官 Phang Wai Yeen 现在将领导全球研发活动。

paras.en: Read the full article on tirereview.com.
paras.zh: 请在tirereview.com 上阅读完整文章。

articles.title: SEMA Names Ryan Mascoli Chief Operations Officer
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Specialty Equipment Market Association (SEMA) has named Ryan Mascoli chief operations officer (COO), effective Nov. 16. Mascoli brings more than 15 years of experience in operational strategy, business transformation and growth within manufacturing and supply chain organizations.
paras.zh: 特种设备市场协会 (SEMA) 任命 Ryan Mascoli 为首席运营官 (COO)，该任命于 11 月 16 日生效。Mascoli 在制造和供应链组织的运营战略、业务转型和增长方面拥有超过 15 年的经验。

paras.en: Reporting to SEMA CEO Mike Spagnola, he will oversee day-to-day operations and advance strategic initiatives. He also will align teams and resources with the association’s long-term priorities.
paras.zh: 他向 SEMA 首席执行官 Mike Spagnola 汇报，负责监督日常运营并推进战略计划。他还将根据协会的长期优先事项调整团队和资源。

paras.en: “Ryan is a proven operational leader who understands how to translate strategy into measurable results,” said Spagnola. “His experience will strengthen our executive team and help SEMA operate with greater alignment, accountability and effectiveness. By improving how we work across the organization, we will be better positioned to deliver meaningful value to our members and foster the success of the automotive aftermarket.”
paras.zh: “瑞安是一位久经考验的运营领导者，他了解如何将战略转化为可衡量的结果，”斯帕尼奥拉说。 “他的经验将增强我们的管理团队，并帮助 SEMA 以更好的协调性、责任感和效率来运作。通过改进我们整个组织的工作方式，我们将能够更好地为我们的会员提供有意义的价值，并促进汽车售后市场的成功。”

paras.en: SEMA Appointee Brings Manufacturing and Operations Experience
paras.zh: SEMA 任命者带来制造和运营经验

paras.en: Mascoli most recently served as vice president of operations for Advanced Charging Technologies, leading enterprise operations across manufacturing, supply chain and production. During his tenure, the company grew revenue from $25 million to $60 million while maintaining a 99.6% on-time delivery rate.
paras.zh: 马斯科利最近担任先进充电技术公司的运营副总裁，领导制造、供应链和生产领域的企业运营。在他任职期间，公司收入从 2500 万美元增长到 6000 万美元，同时保持了 99.6% 的准时交货率。

paras.en: He also increased daily production output by 25% and reduced order dwell time from 21 days to two days. Additionally, he led a companywide enterprise resource planning implementation that took three months to complete.
paras.zh: 他还将日产量提高了 25%，并将订单停留时间从 21 天减少到两天。此外，他还领导了全公司范围内的企业资源规划实施工作，历时三个月才完成。

paras.en: Previously, Mascoli served as general manager and COO at ICE Cable Systems. He oversaw finance, sales, supply chain, marketing, information technology and human resources.
paras.zh: 此前，Mascoli 曾担任 ICE Cable Systems 的总经理兼首席运营官。他负责监督财务、销售、供应链、营销、信息技术和人力资源。

paras.en: From 2019 to 2021, the company grew revenue from $10 million to $22 million. It also increased profit from $200,000 to $3.7 million.
paras.zh: 从 2019 年到 2021 年，该公司的收入从 1000 万美元增长到 2200 万美元。利润也从 20 万美元增加到 370 万美元。

paras.en: Earlier in his career, he held supply chain and inventory leadership positions at ICE Cable Systems and Toshiba.
paras.zh: 在其职业生涯早期，他曾在 ICE Cable Systems 和东芝担任供应链和库存领导职务。

paras.en: Mascoli to Oversee Strategic Initiatives
paras.zh: 马斯科利将监督战略举措

paras.en: “SEMA plays a vital role in creating the conditions for aftermarket businesses and professionals to succeed,” said Mascoli. “I look forward to working with SEMA’s leadership, staff, board and members to strengthen operations, execute strategic priorities and deliver greater value to the industry.”
paras.zh: Mascoli 表示：“SEMA 在为售后市场企业和专业人士的成功创造条件方面发挥着至关重要的作用。” “我期待与 SEMA 的领导层、员工、董事会和成员合作，加强运营、执行战略重点并为行业创造更大价值。”

paras.en: As COO, Mascoli will establish performance measures, support annual planning and budgeting, improve organizational processes and help manage operational risks.
paras.zh: 作为首席运营官，Mascoli 将制定绩效衡量标准、支持年度规划和预算、改进组织流程并帮助管理运营风险。

paras.en: He also will work with department leaders to support employee development. Additionally, he will align organizational priorities with SEMA’s mission to foster the success of the automotive aftermarket.
paras.zh: 他还将与部门领导合作支持员工发展。此外，他还将根据 SEMA 的使命调整组织优先事项，以促进汽车售后市场的成功。

paras.en: Mascoli studied business administration with an emphasis in management at California State University, Fullerton.
paras.zh: 马斯科利在加州州立大学富勒顿分校学习工商管理，主修管理学。

articles.title: YANG Launches 2027 Mentorship Program
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Young Auto Care Network Group (YANG), a community of the Auto Care Association, recently launched its 2027 YANG Mentorship Program. Now in its fifth year, the program averages 125 mentees and 24 volunteer mentors annually. Anyone under age 40 who joins the YANG community can participate for free.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会下属的青年汽车护理网络集团 (YANG) 最近启动了 2027 年 YANG 指导计划。该项目现已进入第五个年头，平均每年有 125 名学员和 24 名志愿者导师。任何 40 岁以下加入 YANG 社区的人都可以免费参与。

paras.en: “One of the most valuable aspects of my involvement with YANG has been the relationships I’ve built with individuals who genuinely challenge me to grow, both personally and professionally,” said Brandon Crenshaw, chair, YANG. “The Mentorship Program creates an opportunity to go beyond networking, by building meaningful connections, challenging your own perspectives, and developing the confidence and perspective to lead in new ways. It’s an experience I encourage every young professional in our industry to embrace.”
paras.zh: YANG 主席布兰登·克伦肖 (Brandon Crenshaw) 表示：“我参与 YANG 的最有价值的方面之一是我与那些真正挑战我成长的人建立了关系，无论是个人还是职业。” “导师计划通过建立有意义的联系、挑战自己的观点以及培养以新方式领导的信心和视角，创造了一个超越网络的机会。我鼓励我们行业的每一位年轻专业人士接受这种经历。”

paras.en: Each YANG mentee will rank industry-specific topics by preference to form mentorship circles. Examples of topics include:
paras.zh: 每个 YANG 学员都会根据偏好对特定行业主题进行排序，形成导师圈。主题示例包括：

paras.en: - Navigating change, building influence and earning your seat at the table
paras.zh: - 驾驭变革、建立影响力并赢得席位

paras.en: - Standing out and the importance of networking
paras.zh: - 脱颖而出和网络的重要性

paras.en: Each mentorship circle consists of approximately five mentees and one mentor focused on a unique topic.
paras.zh: 每个导师圈由大约五名学员和一名专注于某个独特主题的导师组成。

paras.en: Organizers will assign groups after registration closes Nov. 30. Participants will then join the YANG Mentorship Program kickoff meeting in January 2027. Each mentorship circle will meet once per quarter throughout 2027. The program runs from January through December 2027.
paras.zh: 组织者将在 11 月 30 日报名截止后分配小组。参与者随后将参加 2027 年 1 月举行的 YANG 导师计划启动会议。每个导师圈将在 2027 年每季度举行一次会议。该计划从 2027 年 1 月持续到 2027 年 12 月。

paras.en: The YANG Mentorship Program aims to help mentees experience all three YANG pillars: networking, professional development and giving back. Through this small-group mentorship program, mentees will benefit from the experience of automotive aftermarket veterans.
paras.zh: YANG 导师计划旨在帮助受训者体验 YANG 的所有三个支柱：网络、专业发展和回馈。通过这个小组辅导计划，学员将受益于汽车售后市场资深人士的经验。

paras.en: The program targets young automotive aftermarket professionals who want to advance their careers. It provides opportunities for members to focus on individual professional goals while developing the skills to become future leaders.
paras.zh: 该计划针对希望提升职业生涯的年轻汽车售后专业人士。它为会员提供了专注于个人职业目标的机会，同时培养成为未来领导者的技能。

articles.title: NAPA Opens First Highly Automated Reverse Logistics Center
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: NAPA recently celebrated the grand opening of its York Reverse Logistics Center (RLC), marking the debut of the first highly automated facility of its kind within the NAPA network and an important milestone in the company’s ongoing supply chain transformation.
paras.zh: NAPA 最近庆祝其约克逆向物流中心 (RLC) 盛大开业，标志着 NAPA 网络内首个此类高度自动化设施的首次亮相，也是该公司持续供应链转型的重要里程碑。

paras.en: The 400,000-square-foot center combines more than 100 robots and advanced automation technology with a skilled local workforce to process returns, cores and inventory for redistribution across the NAPA Northeast distribution network.
paras.zh: 该中心占地 400,000 平方英尺，将 100 多个机器人和先进的自动化技术与熟练的当地劳动力相结合，处理退货、核心和库存，以便在 NAPA 东北部分销网络中重新分配。

paras.en: The center began operations earlier this year and is designed to accelerate returns processing, helping get parts back into inventory faster and improving availability for NAPA stores, repair professionals and their customers, the company said. The new facility, which can support 250,000 unique SKUs, is expected to reduce the time needed to prepare inventory for redistribution by 43% and support inventory accuracy up to 99.5%.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，该中心于今年早些时候开始运营，旨在加快退货处理速度，帮助更快地将零件重新纳入库存，并提高 NAPA 商店、维修专业人员及其客户的可用性。新设施可支持 250,000 个独特的 SKU，预计将准备重新分配库存所需的时间减少 43%，并支持高达 99.5% 的库存准确性。

paras.en: Leaders from NAPA and corporate parent Genuine Parts Company (GPC) were joined by York Mayor Sandie Walker, state and local elected officials, the York County Economic Alliance, community partners and teammates for a ribbon-cutting ceremony and tours of the facility at 500 Willow Springs Lane.
paras.zh: NAPA 和母公司 Genuine Parts Company (GPC) 的领导与约克市长桑迪·沃克 (Sandie Walker)、州和地方民选官员、约克县经济联盟、社区合作伙伴和队友一起参加了剪彩仪式，并参观了位于柳泉巷 500 号的工厂。

paras.en: “York is the first step in a broader modernization of the NAPA supply chain,” said Justin Ducharme, executive vice president, supply chain, NAPA. “By combining innovative technology with the expertise of our teammates, we’re creating a more efficient operation that helps keep parts moving to the customers and repair professionals who rely on us every day.”
paras.zh: NAPA 供应链执行副总裁 Justin Ducharme 表示：“约克是 NAPA 供应链更广泛现代化的第一步。” “通过将创新技术与团队成员的专业知识相结合，我们正在创建更高效​​的运营方式，有助于将零件运送给每天依赖我们的客户和维修专业人员。”

paras.en: During the ceremony, the GPC Foundation presented a $2,500 Good Neighbor grant to United Way of York County. The grant supports the foundation’s mobility priority and reflects a shared belief that reliable transportation opens access to jobs, health care and stronger family life.
paras.zh: 仪式期间，GPC 基金会向约克县联合之路捐赠了 2,500 美元的好邻居赠款。这笔赠款支持基金会的交通优先事项，并反映了一种共同信念，即可靠的交通可以提供就业、医疗保健和更美好的家庭生活。

paras.en: As the first highly automated reverse logistics center within the NAPA network, RLC represents an important milestone in the company’s efforts to enhance operational capabilities and support the growing needs of customers across the Northeast, the company said.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，作为 NAPA 网络内第一个高度自动化的逆向物流中心，RLC 代表了该公司在增强运营能力和支持东北地区客户不断增长的需求方面的一个重要里程碑。

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Foundation Awards 24 Scholarships
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Advance Auto Parts Foundation today announced the recipients of its 2026 scholarship program, awarding 24 scholarships to students pursuing higher education. The annual program helps family members of Advance Auto Parts team members continue their education and work toward earning degrees.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts Foundation 今天宣布了 2026 年奖学金计划的获得者，向接受高等教育的学生颁发了 24 份奖学金。该年度计划帮助 Advance Auto Parts 团队成员的家庭成员继续接受教育并努力获得学位。

paras.en: This year’s recipients stood out for their academic achievement, leadership, community involvement, personal accomplishments and future goals. Each student will receive a one-time scholarship of $3,500 to support their education.
paras.zh: 今年的获奖者在学术成就、领导力、社区参与、个人成就和未来目标方面脱颖而出。每位学生将获得 3,500 美元的一次性奖学金，以支持他们的学业。

paras.en: “Supporting our team members also means supporting their families, and we’re proud to recognize these students and their achievements,” said Anthony Sarlanis, president of the Advance Auto Parts Foundation and senior vice president, professional at Advance Auto Parts. “Their hard work and dedication have earned this recognition, and we’re proud to help them take the next step in their education. We congratulate each recipient and look forward to seeing all they accomplish in the years ahead.”
paras.zh: “支持我们的团队成员也意味着支持他们的家庭，我们很自豪能够认可这些学生和他们的成就，”Advance Auto Parts 基金会主席兼 Advance Auto Parts 专业高级副总裁 Anthony Sarlanis 说道。 “他们的辛勤工作和奉献精神赢得了这一认可，我们很自豪能够帮助他们在教育上迈出下一步。我们祝贺每位获奖者，并期待看到他们在未来几年取得的成就。”

articles.title: Which came first: black holes or galaxies?
articles.author: Olivia Maule

paras.en: Nearly every large galaxy is thought to have a supermassive black hole at its center. The Milky Way's black hole, known as Sagittarius A*, is enormous, weighing over 4 million times as much as the sun. But which came first: the black holes or the galaxies around them?
paras.zh: 人们认为几乎每个大星系的中心都有一个超大质量黑洞。银河系的黑洞被称为人马座 A*，非常巨大，重量超过太阳的 400 万倍。但哪个先出现：黑洞还是它们周围的星系？

paras.en: Astronomers told Live Science that they thought they knew, but new observations mean they're no longer sure.
paras.zh: 天文学家告诉《生活科学》杂志，他们以为自己知道，但新的观察结果意味着他们不再确定。

paras.en: For decades, the prevailing idea was that galaxies came first: Dying massive stars leave behind black holes that can merge and feed until they swell to millions of times the sun's mass, said Joseph Silk, an astrophysicist and professor at Johns Hopkins University.
paras.zh: 约翰·霍普金斯大学天体物理学家兼教授约瑟夫·西尔克（Joseph Silk）表示，几十年来，普遍的观点是星系先出现：垂死的大质量恒星会留下黑洞，这些黑洞可以合并和吞噬，直到膨胀到太阳质量的数百万倍。

paras.en: Then, in recent years, the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) began peering back at the early universe. "Recent observations are challenging this picture, or at least showing us that it cannot be the whole story," Roberto Maiolino, a professor of astrophysics at the University of Cambridge, told Live Science in an email. "We are finding extremely massive black holes just a few hundred million years after the Big Bang."
paras.zh: 近年来，詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜 (JWST) 开始回望早期宇宙。剑桥大学天体物理学教授罗伯托·麦奥利诺（Roberto Maiolino）在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志：“最近的观察对这一情况提出了挑战，或者至少向我们表明，这不可能是故事的全部。” “我们在大爆炸后几亿年就发现了极其巨大的黑洞。”

paras.en: Stranger still, some of these black holes look too big for their hosts. In nearby galaxies, a central black hole is typically about a thousand times less massive than its galaxy, Maiolino said, but some early ones "appear to be almost as massive as the stars in their host galaxies." In a study in the journal Nature, Maiolino and colleagues measured one such black hole's mass directly in an object called Abell2744-QSO1 and found that it holds most of the object's mass.
paras.zh: 更奇怪的是，其中一些黑洞对于它们的宿主来说看起来太大了。麦奥利诺说，在附近的星系中，中心黑洞的质量通常比其星系小一千倍左右，但一些早期的黑洞“似乎几乎与宿主星系中的恒星一样大”。在《自然》杂志上的一项研究中，Maiolino 和同事直接测量了一个名为 Abell2744-QSO1 的物体中的一个此类黑洞的质量，发现它拥有该物体的大部分质量。

paras.en: So where could such giants come from? Maiolino outlined several possibilities, and more than one may be correct. Some supermassive black holes may be ordinary stellar remnants that grew much faster than usual. Others may have been "born big," forming from the direct collapses of enormous gas clouds, which "would give the black hole a head start in its growth," Maiolino explained. Another idea is that these monsters were seeded by primordial black holes that formed "shortly after the Big Bang, before the first stars and galaxies existed."
paras.zh: 那么这样的巨人从何而来呢？马伊利诺概述了几种可能性，而且可能不止一种是正确的。一些超大质量黑洞可能是普通的恒星残骸，其生长速度比平常快得多。其他黑洞可能“生来就很大”，是由巨大气体云的直接塌缩形成的，这“将使黑洞在其生长过程中抢占先机”，麦奥利诺解释道。另一个想法是，这些怪物是由“大爆炸后不久，第一批恒星和星系存在之前”形成的原始黑洞播下的种子。

paras.en: Further complicating the question is that black holes and galaxies also push and pull on each other. A growing black hole can release an enormous amount of energy that heats or expels gas, which, in turn, curbs or shuts down star formation, Maiolino said.
paras.zh: 使问题进一步复杂化的是，黑洞和星系也会相互推拉。马伊利诺说，不断增长的黑洞可以释放大量能量，加热或排出气体，从而抑制或阻止恒星形成。

paras.en: Feed your curiosity with an exclusive mystery every week, solved with science and delivered direct to your inbox before it's seen anywhere else.
paras.zh: 每周都会有一个独家谜题来满足您的好奇心，这些谜题将通过科学解决，并在其他地方看到之前直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: However, it can also compress gas and potentially trigger new stars. "Black holes and galaxies influence one another throughout their evolution, and neither can be understood entirely in isolation," he said.
paras.zh: 然而，它也可以压缩气体并有可能引发新的恒星。 “黑洞和星系在整个演化过程中相互影响，两者都不能完全孤立地理解，”他说。

paras.en: Silk said the balance varies. In giant, elliptical galaxies, black holes weighing billions of suns can have "histories of extreme violence" that helped limit their hosts' growth, while in spirals like the Milky Way, feedback from stars tends to dominate.
paras.zh: Silk表示，平衡情况各不相同。在巨大的椭圆星系中，重量达数十亿个太阳的黑洞可能有“极端暴力的历史”，这有助于限制其宿主的生长，而在像银河系这样的螺旋星系中，来自恒星的反馈往往占主导地位。

paras.en: So which came first? Answering that question will take far more data from JWST. Right now, "we have samples of tens of objects, maybe 20, 30, 40," Silk said, and astronomers need far more data to tell whether oversize black holes are typical.
paras.zh: 那么哪个先出现呢？回答这个问题需要 JWST 提供更多的数据。现在，“我们有数十个物体的样本，也许是 20、30、40 个，”Silk 说，天文学家需要更多的数据来判断超大黑洞是否是典型的。

paras.en: If black holes outweigh their galaxies the farther back astronomers look, that would strongly suggest black holes formed first, Silk said; if stars dominate, it would point the other way.
paras.zh: 西尔克说，如果天文学家在更远的地方观察到黑洞比星系还要重，那就强烈表明黑洞首先形成。如果明星占主导地位，它就会指向相反的方向。

paras.en: Maiolino suggested the question itself may need rethinking. "Asking which came first may be too simplistic," he said. "The more interesting question may be how black holes and galaxies formed, grew and influenced one another at different stages of cosmic history."
paras.zh: Maiolino 表示，这个问题本身可能需要重新思考。 “问哪个先出现可能太简单化了，”他说。 “更有趣的问题可能是黑洞和星系在宇宙历史的不同阶段是如何形成、生长和相互影响的。”

paras.en: There may be no single sequence. "Different black holes, in different environments and at different cosmic epochs, may have formed and evolved through different pathways," Maiolino added.
paras.zh: 可能不存在单一序列。 “不同的黑洞，在不同的环境和不同的宇宙时代，可能是通过不同的途径形成和演化的，”麦奥利诺补充道。

paras.en: For now, the cosmic chicken-and-egg puzzle remains open. As Maiolino put it, astronomers are "beginning to explore a period of cosmic history for which we still have many unanswered questions."
paras.zh: 目前，宇宙先有鸡还是先有蛋的谜题仍然悬而未决。正如麦奥利诺所说，天文学家“开始探索一段宇宙历史，对此我们仍有许多未解之谜。”

paras.en: Is your knowledge of the universe supermassive? Find out with our black hole quiz!
paras.zh: 你对宇宙的了解是海量的吗？通过我们的黑洞测验找出答案！

paras.en: Olivia Maule is a former Live Science intern and science journalist whose beats include space, biotechnology and the environment. She holds a B.A. in biology and a B.S. in anthropology from the University of Florida and completed a master's degree in science communication at U.C. Santa Cruz. A 2025 AAAS Mass Media Fellow, she wrote stories and produced videos during a summer at El Nuevo Día, Puerto Rico's largest newspaper, and has written for Eos, Mongabay, Science magazine and Stanford Report. Olivia is a native Spanish and English speaker.
paras.zh: 奥利维亚·莫尔 (Olivia Maule) 是《Live Science》前实习生和科学记者，关注领域包括太空、生物技术和环境。她拥有学士学位。生物学学士学位和学士学位获得佛罗里达大学人类学博士学位，并在加州大学获得科学传播硕士学位。圣克鲁斯。作为 2025 年 AAAS 大众媒体研究员，她在一个夏天为波多黎各最大的报纸 El Nuevo Día 撰写故事并制作视频，并为《Eos》、《Mongabay》、《科学》杂志和《斯坦福报告》撰稿。奥利维亚的母语是西班牙语和英语。

articles.title: Scientists investigate 2 'peculiar' galaxies pulling each other apart
articles.author: Jamie Carter

paras.en: What it is: NGC 7253 (also called Arp 278), a pair of interacting spiral galaxies
paras.zh: 它是什么：NGC 7253（也称为 Arp 278），一对相互作用的螺旋星系

paras.en: Where it is: 200 million light-years away, in the constellation Pegasus
paras.zh: 它在哪里：2亿光年外，位于飞马座

paras.en: Picture a spiral galaxy, and you'll probably imagine a swirl of stars. But some galaxies appear to be the complete opposite. One is NGC 7253, which looks more like a bizarre balloon animal than a cosmic coil. In reality, it's two spiral galaxies caught in each other's gravity. As shown in this recent image from the Gemini North telescope on Mauna Kea in Hawaii, the galaxies' once-ordered shapes are being disturbed and disrupted as their mutual gravitational pull stretches and distorts their spiral arms into a tangled arrangement of stars, gas and dust. It sounds and looks chaotic and destructive, but encounters between galaxies don't mean stars are physically colliding; the distances between individual stars are too great. Instead, something extraordinarily productive can happen.
paras.zh: 想象一个螺旋星系，你可能会想象一个恒星漩涡。但有些星系似乎完全相反。其中之一是NGC 7253，它看起来更像是一种奇怪的气球动物，而不是宇宙线圈。事实上，它是两个相互引力的螺旋星系。正如这张来自夏威夷莫纳克亚山双子座望远镜的最新图像所示，星系曾经有序的形状正在被扰乱和破坏，因为它们相互的引力拉伸并扭曲它们的旋臂，形成恒星、气体和尘埃的纠缠排列。听起来、看起来都很混乱且具有破坏性，但星系之间的相遇并不意味着恒星之间发生物理碰撞；而是意味着星系之间的碰撞。个别恒星之间的距离太大。相反，一些非常富有成效的事情可能会发生。

paras.en: Spiral galaxies contain huge clouds of cold gas and dust, particularly within their arms. When galaxies interact, gravitational forces can disturb and compress those clouds. If enough material is squeezed together and becomes dense enough to collapse under its own gravity, it can produce bursts of new star formation.
paras.zh: 螺旋星系含有巨大的冷气体和尘埃云，尤其是在旋臂内。当星系相互作用时，引力会扰乱并压缩这些云。如果足够多的物质被挤压在一起并变得足够稠密，足以在自身重力作用下塌陷，它就可以产生新恒星的爆发。

paras.en: Evidence of just that can be seen in this image. Scattered through the galaxies are concentrations of bright pink light. These are H II regions — enormous clouds of hydrogen gas energized by intense ultraviolet radiation from hot, young stars.
paras.zh: 从这张图片中可以看出这一点的证据。明亮的粉红色光散布在星系中。这些是 H II 区域——巨大的氢气云，由炽热的年轻恒星发出的强烈紫外线辐射提供能量。

paras.en: The gravitational encounter is rearranging two structures containing billions of stars while simultaneously helping to create new ones. These interactions radically alter the shapes of the galaxies involved and, in time, can ultimately cause them to merge into a single galaxy. For now, NGC 7253 is listed as Arp 278 in the Atlas of Peculiar Galaxies, a catalog of galaxies that are neither perfectly symmetrical spirals nor smooth, spherical ellipticals.
paras.zh: 引力相遇正在重新排列两个包含数十亿颗恒星的结构，同时帮助创建新的结构。这些相互作用从根本上改变了所涉及星系的形状，并最终导致它们合并成一个星系。目前，NGC 7253 在《奇特星系图集》中被列为 Arp 278，这是一份既不是完全对称的螺旋星系也不是光滑的椭圆形星系的目录。

paras.en: - The Milky Way is one galaxy — but it used to be thousands, new simulations reveal
paras.zh: - 新的模拟显示，银河系是一个星系，但它曾经有数千个

paras.en: - James Webb telescope discovers ultra-rare ring galaxy just 2 billion years after the Big Bang
paras.zh: - 詹姆斯·韦伯望远镜在大爆炸后仅 20 亿年就发现了极其罕见的环形星系

paras.en: - 'Far more than beautiful pictures': Euclid space telescope images 900 million galaxies on its quest to make the largest 3D map of the universe
paras.zh: -“不仅仅是美丽的图片”：欧几里得太空望远镜拍摄了 9 亿个星系的图像，以绘制最大的宇宙 3D 地图

paras.en: The new image has another story much closer to Earth. It's just been given the Hawaiian name Nā 'Uhane Māhoe Huki Pū i ke Ola, meaning "The Twin Spirits Pulling Together Creating Life." Hawaii high school students participating in the 2026 Project Hōkūlani internship program chose the name. One reason was its position within Ka Lupe o Kawelo, the Hawaiian constellation corresponding to Pegasus.
paras.zh: 新图像有另一个更接近地球的故事。它刚刚被命名为 Nā 'Uhane Māhoe Huki Pū i ke Ola，意思是“双生灵魂齐心协力创造生命”。参加 2026 年 Project Hōkūlani 实习计划的夏威夷高中生选择了这个名字。原因之一是它在夏威夷星座 Ka Lupe o Kawelo 中的位置，与飞马座相对应。

paras.en: The "twin spirits" represent both the two galaxies and the twin telescopes of the Gemini Observatory — one in Hawaii and the other in Chile.
paras.zh: “双胞胎灵魂”代表两个星系和双子座天文台的双望远镜——一台位于夏威夷，另一台位于智利。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Jamie Carter is a Cardiff, U.K.-based freelance science journalist and a regular contributor to Live Science. He is the author of A Stargazing Program For Beginners and co-author of The Eclipse Effect, and leads international stargazing and eclipse-chasing tours. His work appears regularly in Space.com, Forbes, New Scientist, BBC Sky at Night, Sky & Telescope, and other major science and astronomy publications. He is also the editor of WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com.
paras.zh: 杰米·卡特 (Jamie Carter) 是英国卡迪夫的一名自由科学记者，也是《Live Science》的定期撰稿人。他是《初学者观星计划》一书的作者，也是《日食效应》一书的合著者，并领导国际观星和日食追逐之旅。他的作品经常出现在 Space.com、福布斯、新科学家、BBC 夜间天空、天空与望远镜以及其他主要科学和天文学出版物上。他还是 WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com 的编辑。
