The trench is the scene of a slo-mo tectonic collision called a subduction zone: The Pacific plate is diving beneath the Mariana plate, bending downward as it sinks into the mantle, forming a steep trench on the ocean floor.
paras.zh: 挑战者深渊位于马里亚纳海沟内，马里亚纳海沟是菲律宾东部太平洋海底的一个新月形凿痕。海沟是慢速构造碰撞的场景，称为俯冲带：太平洋板块潜入马里亚纳板块下方，在沉入地幔时向下弯曲，在海底形成陡峭的海沟。

paras.en: All subduction zones are deep, but “it’s interesting why this is the deepest spot in the Earth’s ocean,” says geoscientist Robert Stern, an emeritus professor at the University of Texas at Dallas and a visiting researcher at the University of California, Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 所有俯冲带都很深，但“有趣的是，为什么这里是地球海洋最深的地方”，德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校名誉教授、加州大学洛杉矶分校客座研究员地球科学家罗伯特·斯特恩说。

paras.en: He and colleagues employed a remotely operated robot called ROV Jason/Medea to descend to more than 6,000 meters and explore the Mariana Trench seafloor around the edges of Challenger Deep. The rocks turned out to contain pyroclastic deposits, evidence of an erstwhile explosive volcanic eruption. Those deposits included platelike blocks that could indicate eruption pulses, and lobe-shaped rocks where the volcanic flows ended and quickly cooled.
paras.zh: 他和同事使用名为 ROV Jason/Medea 的远程操作机器人下降到 6,000 多米深处，探索挑战者深渊边缘的马里亚纳海沟海底。事实证明，这些岩石中含有火山碎屑沉积物，这是昔日火山喷发的证据。这些沉积物包括可以指示喷发脉冲的板状块体，以及火山流结束并迅速冷却的叶状岩石。

paras.en: These are the deepest pyroclastic deposits found on Earth, the scientists report November 23 in Frontiers in Earth Science.
paras.zh: 科学家们于 11 月 23 日在《地球科学前沿》上报告称，这些是地球上发现的最深的火山碎屑沉积物。

paras.en: How explosive an eruption is at Earth’s surface depends on the chemical makeup of the magma. When the molten rock contains a high proportion of volatile gases, including water vapor, those gases suddenly expand when the magma reaches the surface, producing a violent explosion.
paras.zh: 地球表面喷发的爆炸性取决于岩浆的化学成分。当熔岩含有高比例的挥发性气体（包括水蒸气）时，当岩浆到达地表时，这些气体会突然膨胀，产生剧烈的爆炸。

paras.en: Such explosive volcanism shouldn’t be possible in the deep sea; the pressure is too high for any escaping gases to expand, Stern says. Along with that mystery, the volcanic deposits were found unusually close to the trench, compared with what would be expected for a subduction zone.
paras.zh: 这种爆发性的火山活动在深海中是不可能发生的；斯特恩说，压力太高，任何逸出的气体都无法膨胀。除了这个谜团之外，与预期的俯冲带相比，火山沉积物的发现异常靠近海沟。

paras.en: Stern and his colleagues developed a hypothesis that incorporates these disparate pieces of evidence: The extreme depth of Challenger Deep, they say, may be at least partially due to an especially sharp bend in the Pacific Plate as it sinks into the mantle.
paras.zh: 斯特恩和他的同事提出了一个包含这些不同证据的假设：他们说，挑战者深渊的极端深度可能至少部分归因于太平洋板块在沉入地幔时发生的特别急剧的弯曲。

paras.en: That tighter bend would explain why volcanism is happening closer to the subduction zone than usual. The classic subduction zone scenario is that the sinking plate heats up and melts partially as it descends; the magma rises through the overhanging plate and erupts, forming volcanic island arcs several hundred kilometers from the collision zone. Here, the volcanic deposits were just a hundred kilometers or so from the trench — which makes sense if the plate is dipping more steeply.
paras.zh: 这种更紧的弯曲可以解释为什么火山活动发生在比平常更靠近俯冲带的地方。典型的俯冲带情景是下沉板块在下降时升温并部分熔化；岩浆穿过悬垂的板块上升并喷发，形成距碰撞区数百公里的火山岛弧。这里的火山沉积物距离海沟仅一百公里左右——如果板块倾斜得更陡的话，这是有道理的。

paras.en: As for the pyroclastics, “we can’t answer if the eruptions were really explosive,” Stern says. But at those pressures, any gases such as water vapor contained in the magma wouldn’t be able to explosively expand as they would at the surface.
paras.zh: 至于火山碎屑，“我们无法回答火山喷发是否真的具有爆炸性，”斯特恩说。但在这些压力下，岩浆中含有的任何气体（例如水蒸气）都无法像在地表那样爆炸性膨胀。

paras.en: Instead, the pyroclastic rocks might have formed through a new version of deep-sea eruption, one in which water emerging from the magma is initially in a supercritical fluid state. That would minimize any explosive expansion during the eruption and could also produce fragmented, dense deposits like those seen by Jason/Medea.
paras.zh: 相反，火山碎屑岩可能是通过一种新的深海喷发形成的，其中从岩浆中喷出的水最初处于超临界流体状态。这将最大限度地减少火山喷发期间的爆炸性扩张，并且还可能产生像杰森/美狄亚所看到的那样碎片化、致密的沉积物。

paras.en: The discovery of deep-sea pyroclastics is “surprising and unprecedented,” says William Chadwick, a geologist at Oregon State University in Newport. Challenger Deep may be the only place on Earth “with the ingredients to produce explosive volcanism in the super-deep ocean,” he says. “Imagining this happening is … pretty mind-boggling.”
paras.zh: 俄勒冈州立大学纽波特分校的地质学家威廉·查德威克表示，深海火山碎屑岩的发现“令人惊讶且前所未有”。他说，挑战者深渊可能是地球上唯一一个“拥有在超深海中产生爆炸性火山活动的成分”的地方。 “想象这种情况发生……真是令人难以置信。”

paras.en: A lot more work remains to be done to evaluate all of these new ideas, Stern says. “But a lot of things are now coming together.”
paras.zh: 斯特恩说，评估所有这些新想法还有很多工作要做。 “但现在很多事情都融合在一起了。”

articles.title: After 60 Years, Chemists Finally Isolate Elusive Molecules Thought Too Unstable to Survive
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: Chemists have been on the lookout for molecules called oxoboranes for more than 60 years.
paras.zh: 60 多年来，化学家一直在寻找称为氧硼烷的分子。

paras.en: Made up of boron-oxygen triple bonds, oxoboranes were thought to be too unstable and reactive to exist long enough to be observed outside of very extreme conditions.
paras.zh: 氧硼烷由硼-氧三键组成，被认为太不稳定且反应性太强，无法在非常极端的条件下存在足够长的时间来观察。

paras.en: Now researchers from the Julius Maximilian University of Würzburg in Germany and Tezpur University in India have made a major breakthrough, synthesizing three oxoborane compounds as crystals at room temperature.
paras.zh: 现在，来自德国维尔茨堡朱利叶斯·马克西米利安大学和印度特斯普尔大学的研究人员取得了重大突破，在室温下合成了三种晶体氧硼烷化合物。

paras.en: Publishing their results in Nature Chemistry, the team discovered them while experimenting with diboracumulene, a highly reactive compound containing boron, after mixing it with several standard chemical reagents.
paras.zh: 研究小组在《自然化学》上发表了他们的研究结果，他们在将二硼累积烯（一种含硼的高活性化合物）与几种标准化学试剂混合后进行实验时发现了这些结果。

paras.en: That's when the elusive molecules were unexpectedly formed: A little serendipity had helped the chemists find the solution to a 60-year-old problem.
paras.zh: 就在那时，难以捉摸的分子意外地形成了：一点点的偶然性帮助化学家找到了解决 60 年来问题的方法。

paras.en: "Nearly everybody in the field had given up on oxoboranes, as they were thought to be just too unstable to be isolated," says chemist Holger Braunschweig, from the Julius Maximilian University of Würzburg.
paras.zh: “几乎该领域的每个人都放弃了氧硼烷，因为人们认为它们太不稳定而无法分离，”维尔茨堡朱利叶斯·马克西米利安大学的化学家 Holger Braunschweig 说。

paras.en: "So we were stunned to see them spontaneously form in these reactions and stick around long enough that we could study them."
paras.zh: “因此，我们惊讶地发现它们在这些反应中自发形成，并停留了足够长的时间，以便我们可以研究它们。”

paras.en: The reactions produced solid crystals, colored orange and yellow, which the researchers analyzed using techniques including X-ray crystallography (which checks the atomic arrangement) and spectroscopy (which studies the molecular structure).
paras.zh: 这些反应产生了橙色和黄色的固体晶体，研究人员使用 X 射线晶体学（检查原子排列）和光谱学（研究分子结构）等技术对其进行了分析。

paras.en: Computer simulations were also used to help understand why the molecules had emerged and remained stable. Altogether, the analysis showed that boron-oxygen triple bonds had been created, and with exceptional strength.
paras.zh: 计算机模拟也被用来帮助理解为什么分子会出现并保持稳定。总而言之，分析表明硼-氧三键已经形成，并且具有非凡的强度。

paras.en: "The discovery was a pleasant surprise," says chemist Lukas Lubczyk, from the Julius Maximilian University of Würzburg.
paras.zh: “这一发现令人惊喜，”维尔茨堡朱利叶斯·马克西米利安大学的化学家卢卡斯·卢布奇克 (Lukas Lubczyk) 说。

paras.en: "I never thought the diboracumulene would react the way it did, let alone with multiple different, simple substrates. And when [colleague Christian Markl] came to me with his compound, I knew we were on to something."
paras.zh: “我从来没有想过二硼碳烯会发生这样的反应，更不用说与多种不同的简单底物发生反应了。当[同事克里斯蒂安·马克尔]带着他的化合物来找我时，我知道我们正在做一些事情。”

paras.en: Braunschweig and his colleagues have been on the trail of boron triple bonds for years, including stabilizing boron-oxygen triple bonds with the help of platinum, for example.
paras.zh: 布伦瑞克和他的同事多年来一直在研究硼三键，包括在铂的帮助下稳定硼-氧三键。

paras.en: Here, the stable molecules were also getting some extra help, but in a slightly different way.
paras.zh: 在这里，稳定的分子也得到了一些额外的帮助，但方式略有不同。

paras.en: The stability of the molecules was due in part to their connections to what's called a borylenyl group, a small group of atoms containing another boron atom.
paras.zh: 这些分子的稳定性部分归因于它们与所谓的硼烯基的连接，硼烯基是一小群含有另一个硼原子的原子。

paras.en: As that extra group is rich in electrons, it's able to share some of the electron density, reducing the imbalance of electrical charge that usually means oxoboranes are gone almost before they've arrived.
paras.zh: 由于该额外的基团富含电子，因此它能够共享一些电子密度，从而减少电荷的不平衡，这通常意味着氧硼烷几乎在到达之前就消失了。

paras.en: Unlike the platinum stabilization, no additional metals were required, and the extra stability came from the intrinsic properties of the molecules themselves.
paras.zh: 与铂稳定不同，不需要额外的金属，额外的稳定性来自分子本身的固有特性。

paras.en: "Here we present a remarkably simple synthesis of three oxoboranes that are stable as crystalline solids at room temperature," write the researchers in their published paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在他们发表的论文中写道：“在这里，我们提出了三种氧硼烷的非常简单的合成方法，它们在室温下作为结晶固体稳定。”

paras.en: "Their properties are elucidated by both experimental and computational methods, and an explanation for their unusual stability is provided."
paras.zh: “它们的特性通过实验和计算方法得到了阐明，并解释了它们异常的稳定性。”

paras.en: It's a true rewriting-the-textbooks moment for chemists, even if those textbooks are mostly in digital form nowadays.
paras.zh: 对于化学家来说，这是一个真正重写教科书的时刻，即使这些教科书现在大多是数字形式的。

paras.en: Now work can begin to try and produce more oxoboranes besides the three produced so far, and understand more about the creation process.
paras.zh: 现在，除了目前已经生产的三种氧硼烷之外，我们还可以开始尝试生产更多的氧硼烷，并更多地了解创造过程。

paras.en: The researchers suggest that the extra borylenyl group stability trick could be used with other molecules that have so far been difficult to catch, once scientists have fully figured out how it works.
paras.zh: 研究人员建议，一旦科学家们完全弄清楚了额外的硼烯基稳定性技巧，就可以将其用于迄今为止难以捕获的其他分子。

paras.en: It could be especially useful for molecules with fewer atomic bonds than usual, like oxoboranes (the technical term is "hypocoordinate main-group fragments").
paras.zh: 它对于原子键比平常少的分子特别有用，例如氧硼烷（技术术语是“次配位主族片段”）。

paras.en: From there, there's plenty to test in terms of how these newly stabilized and crystallized oxoboranes can affect chemical reactions and molecular production.
paras.zh: 从这里开始，关于这些新稳定和结晶的氧硼烷如何影响化学反应和分子生产，还有很多需要测试的地方。

paras.en: There's no specific advance that we can point to yet, in terms of drugs or materials, for example, but the experts are just getting started.
paras.zh: 例如，在药物或材料方面，我们还没有可以指出的具体进展，但专家们才刚刚开始。

paras.en: "This work opens the door to the full exploration of the chemistry of oxoboranes – previously limited by their synthetic inaccessibility," write the researchers
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“这项工作为全面探索氧硼烷的化学特性打开了大门，而此前它们因合成困难而受到限制。”

paras.en: "As well as the exploitation of electron-rich borylenyl groups as stabilizing substituents for a wider palette of hypocoordinate main-group fragments."
paras.zh: “以及利用富电子的硼烯基作为稳定取代基，以获得更广泛的低配位主族片段。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Nature Chemistry.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《自然化学》杂志上。

articles.title: Common Sweetener May Damage The Brain's Critical Barrier, Risking Stroke
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: An organic compound commonly used as a sugar substitute, called erythritol, may have insidious effects on the human body.
paras.zh: 一种通常用作糖替代品的有机化合物，称为赤藓糖醇，可能对人体产生潜在的影响。

paras.en: Emerging research suggests that people with higher levels of this circulating compound in their blood face a higher risk of stroke.
paras.zh: 最新研究表明，血液中这种循环化合物含量较高的人患中风的风险较高。

paras.en: Erythritol is almost as sweet as table sugar, and yet it delivers barely any calories and doesn't spike insulin. The compound occurs naturally in some fruits, like pears and grapes, and the human body makes erythritol in small amounts from glucose.
paras.zh: 赤藓糖醇的甜度几乎与食糖一样，但它几乎不提供任何热量，并且不会导致胰岛素升高。这种化合物天然存在于一些水果中，如梨和葡萄，人体会从葡萄糖中产生少量的赤藓糖醇。

paras.en: Just because this compound naturally occurs in the human body, however, does not mean it is safe to consume without restraint.
paras.zh: 然而，仅仅因为这种化合物天然存在于人体内，并不意味着可以安全地无限制地食用。

paras.en: Since the 1990s, erythritol has become a popular and widespread low-calorie sweetener, but little is known about the long-term health effects.
paras.zh: 自 20 世纪 90 年代以来，赤藓糖醇已成为一种流行且广泛使用的低热量甜味剂，但对其长期健康影响却知之甚少。

paras.en: Recently, researchers have found elevated concentrations of this sweet compound in the blood of patients with obesity, diabetes, and cardiovascular diseases.
paras.zh: 最近，研究人员发现肥胖、糖尿病和心血管疾病患者的血液中这种甜味化合物的浓度升高。

paras.en: Researchers in China have now identified a possible genetic link between erythritol levels in the blood and the risk of stroke.
paras.zh: 中国的研究人员现已发现血液中的赤藓糖醇水平与中风风险之间可能存在遗传联系。

paras.en: Their findings are published in The International Journal of Molecular Sciences.
paras.zh: 他们的研究结果发表在《国际分子科学杂志》上。

paras.en: "Although these compounds are often promoted for weight management and glycemic control, their long-term cerebrovascular and inflammatory effects remain insufficiently defined," endocrinologist Ao Zhong from Huazhong University of Science and Technology and colleagues write.
paras.zh: 华中科技大学内分泌学家敖中及其同事写道：“尽管这些化合物经常被宣传用于体重管理和血糖控制，但它们对脑血管和炎症的长期影响仍未得到充分明确。”

paras.en: That is concerning, the team adds, because the populations with the highest consumption of these sugar substitutes are disproportionately burdened by cardiovascular issues already.
paras.zh: 研究小组补充说，这是令人担忧的，因为这些糖替代品消费量最高的人群已经承受着不成比例的心血管问题的负担。

paras.en: "This gap raises a clinically urgent question," the authors explain.
paras.zh: “这一差距提出了一个临床上紧迫的问题，”作者解释道。

paras.en: "Do ubiquitous artificial sweeteners constitute novel, independent exposures that accelerate [disease] progression in this vulnerable population?"
paras.zh: “无处不在的人工甜味剂是否会构成新的、独立的暴露，加速这一弱势群体的[疾病]进展？”

paras.en: In 2023, a study of more than 2,000 adults in the US found that those with high circulating levels of erythritol had nearly double the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events, such as a heart attack or stroke, over three years.
paras.zh: 2023 年，一项针对美国 2,000 多名成年人的研究发现，赤藓糖醇循环水平较高的人在三年内发生心脏病或中风等主要不良心血管事件的风险几乎增加了一倍。

paras.en: In a small pilot trial, 8 healthy participants consumed 30 grams of erythritol. It caused their blood levels to increase around 1,000-fold, and this lasted more than two days.
paras.zh: 在一项小型试点试验中，8 名健康参与者摄入了 30 克赤藓糖醇。它导致他们的血液浓度增加了大约1000倍，并且这种情况持续了两天多。

paras.en: A year later, more findings added to the idea that erythritol may have health effects. In 2024, researchers tested the impact of erythritol or glucose consumption on 20 healthy volunteers.
paras.zh: 一年后，更多的发现证实了赤藓糖醇可能对健康有影响。 2024 年，研究人员测试了 20 名健康志愿者摄入赤藓糖醇或葡萄糖的影响。

paras.en: The erythritol group, but not the glucose group, experienced a greater than 1,000-fold increase in erythritol concentrations in their plasma.
paras.zh: 赤藓糖醇组（而非葡萄糖组）的血浆中赤藓糖醇浓度增加了 1,000 倍以上。

paras.en: What's more, this erythritol consumption increased platelet reactivity, potentially making blood more prone to clotting.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，这种赤藓糖醇的消耗增加了血小板的反应性，可能使血液更容易凝固。

paras.en: There may be other mechanisms linking erythritol to stroke, too.
paras.zh: 可能还有其他机制将赤藓糖醇与中风联系起来。

paras.en: In 2025, researchers at the University of Colorado, Boulder, found a possible link between this sugar substitute and the brain's vasculature.
paras.zh: 2025 年，科罗拉多大学博尔德分校的研究人员发现这种糖替代品与大脑脉管系统之间可能存在联系。

paras.en: In the lab, erythritol had damaging effects on the cells that make up the central nervous system's protective blood barrier.
paras.zh: 在实验室中，赤藓糖醇对构成中枢神经系统保护性血液屏障的细胞具有破坏性影响。

paras.en: "Big picture, if your vessels are more constricted and your ability to break down blood clots is lowered, your risk of stroke goes up," said study author and physiologist Auburn Berry at the time.
paras.zh: 研究作者、生理学家奥本·贝里（Auburn Berry）当时表示：“总体而言，如果你的血管更加收缩，分解血栓的能力降低，那么你中风的风险就会上升。”

paras.en: "Our research demonstrates not only that, but how erythritol has the potential to increase stroke risk."
paras.zh: “我们的研究不仅证明了这一点，还证明了赤藓糖醇如何有可能增加中风风险。”

paras.en: Now, in 2026 we have more supporting evidence.
paras.zh: 现在，2026 年我们有了更多支持证据。

paras.en: Zhong and colleagues have identified a possible relationship between circulating erythritol and stroke.
paras.zh: 钟和同事已经确定了循环赤藓糖醇与中风之间可能存在的关系。

paras.en: Using Mendelian Randomization to analyze genome-wide associations (a step up from mere correlation), the team has found that people genetically predisposed to have higher levels of erythritol circulating in their blood face nearly 25 percent higher odds of an ischemic stroke.
paras.zh: 研究小组利用孟德尔随机化分析全基因组关联（从单纯相关性的进步）发现，血液中循环的赤藓糖醇水平较高的人，患缺血性中风的几率要高出近 25%。

paras.en: In further computational analyses, the authors identified inflammation, oxidative stress, hypoxia, and vascular injury as possible biological pathways linking erythritol and stroke.
paras.zh: 在进一步的计算分析中，作者确定炎症、氧化应激、缺氧和血管损伤是连接赤藓糖醇和中风的可能生物途径。

paras.en: What's more, the research team identified three genes (MMP9, TLR4, and HIF1A) that repeatedly emerged in their analyses as potentially important to stroke risk.
paras.zh: 此外，研究小组还发现了在他们的分析中反复出现的三个基因（MMP9、TLR4 和 HIF1A），它们对中风风险具有潜在的重要作用。

paras.en: These outcomes "should not be interpreted as direct evidence that dietary erythritol intake causes stroke," the authors say.
paras.zh: 作者说，这些结果“不应被解释为膳食赤藓糖醇摄入导致中风的直接证据”。

paras.en: But evidence for a relationship between circulating erythritol and stroke is accumulating.
paras.zh: 但关于循环赤藓糖醇与中风之间关系的证据正在积累。

paras.en: The findings are similar to another recent genetic study, published in 2025, which included a genome-wide association of 8,167 European individuals.
paras.zh: 该研究结果与最近于 2025 年发表的另一项基因研究类似，其中包括 8,167 名欧洲个体的全基因组关联。

paras.en: Researchers found that individuals with genes that predict higher erythritol levels had nearly 16 percent higher odds of ischemic stroke and nearly 8 percent higher odds of coronary heart disease.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，具有预测赤藓糖醇水平较高的基因的个体，患缺血性中风的几率高出近 16%，患冠心病的几率高出近 8%。

paras.en: "These findings concern circulating erythritol and do not directly establish that dietary erythritol intake causes stroke, because circulating levels may also reflect endogenous production, metabolism, and renal handling," the authors of the newest study explain.
paras.zh: 最新研究的作者解释说：“这些发现涉及循环赤藓糖醇，并不能直接证明膳食赤藓糖醇摄入会导致中风，因为循环水平也可能反映内源性产生、代谢和肾脏处理。”

paras.en: "Nevertheless, because dietary erythritol can increase circulating concentrations, the observed association raises a potential safety signal… "
paras.zh: “尽管如此，由于膳食赤藓糖醇可以增加循环浓度，观察到的关联提出了潜在的安全信号……”

paras.en: In 2025, physiologist Christopher DeSouza said that "given the epidemiological study that inspired our work, and now our cellular findings, we believe it would be prudent for people to monitor their consumption of non-nutrient sweeteners such as this one."
paras.zh: 2025 年，生理学家 Christopher DeSouza 表示，“鉴于启发我们工作的流行病学研究，以及现在我们的细胞研究结果，我们相信人们应该谨慎地监测他们对非营养甜味剂（例如这种甜味剂）的消费量。”

paras.en: A clinical trial to establish direct evidence is already underway at the University of California, Davis (UCD).
paras.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校 (UCD) 正在进行一项旨在建立直接证据的临床试验。

paras.en: In this randomized crossover design, participants will drink beverages sweetened with erythritol or aspartame for 2 weeks each.
paras.zh: 在这个随机交叉设计中，参与者将饮用赤藓糖醇或阿斯巴甜加糖饮料，每次两周。

paras.en: Then, researchers will measure whether consuming erythritol affects platelet activation and adhesion, as well as markers of vascular inflammation.
paras.zh: 然后，研究人员将测量食用赤藓糖醇是否会影响血小板活化和粘附，以及血管炎症标志物。

paras.en: Unlike previous observational or genetic studies, this new design gets us closer to understanding the true consequences of our 'guilt-free' sugar substitutes.
paras.zh: 与之前的观察或遗传学研究不同，这种新设计让我们更接近于了解“无负罪感”糖替代品的真正后果。

paras.en: The study is published in The International Journal of Molecular Sciences.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《国际分子科学杂志》上。

articles.title: A Famous 174-Year-Old Math Problem Just Got Its Fastest Possible Solution
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: The Four Color Theorem is one of the most famous (and long-standing) puzzles in math: is it possible to use just four colors to shade in all of the regions on any map, with no two neighboring areas sharing the same color?
paras.zh: 四色定理是数学中最著名（也是长期存在）的难题之一：是否可以只使用四种颜色来遮蔽任何地图上的所有区域，而没有两个相邻区域共享相同的颜色？

paras.en: English mathematician Francis Guthrie first suggested it might be possible in 1852, but a full proof wasn't presented until 1976.
paras.zh: 英国数学家 Francis Guthrie 在 1852 年首次提出这可能是可能的，但直到 1976 年才提出完整的证明。

paras.en: A more accessible proof arrived in 1997, less reliant on computer calculations that were difficult to verify, but its algorithms took a long time to compute on larger maps.
paras.zh: 1997 年出现了一个更容易理解的证明，较少依赖于难以验证的计算机计算，但其算法需要很长时间才能在较大的地图上进行计算。

paras.en: Now, an international team of researchers has made a significant further breakthrough in the Four Color Theorem, coming up with algorithms that work much faster when calculating the colors for maps of any size.
paras.zh: 现在，一个国际研究团队在四色定理方面取得了重大突破，提出了在计算任何尺寸地图的颜色时速度更快的算法。

paras.en: More than a century and a half after Guthrie first speculated that four colors might be enough for any map, mathematicians now have an optimized framework to prove it, and the implications extend beyond coloring in map segments too.
paras.zh: 格思里首次推测四种颜色可能足以满足任何地图的一个半世纪后，数学家现在有了一个优化的框架来证明这一点，其含义也超出了地图部分的着色范围。

paras.en: "The previous proofs showed that it is always possible to color a map using four colors, but they are not very good at actually finding the colors for each individual region on a map," says computer scientist Mikkel Thorup, from the University of Copenhagen in Denmark.
paras.zh: 丹麦哥本哈根大学的计算机科学家米克尔·索鲁普 (Mikkel Thorup) 表示：“之前的证明表明，总是可以使用四种颜色为地图着色，但他们并不擅长实际找到地图上每个单独区域的颜色。”

paras.en: "The new algorithm is efficient and provides a much faster way of coloring."
paras.zh: “新算法非常高效，并且提供了更快的着色方式。”

paras.en: At the center of the new approach is a way of finding patterns within a map, patterns that the researchers term reducible configurations.
paras.zh: 新方法的核心是一种在地图中查找模式的方法，研究人员将这些模式称为可简化配置。

paras.en: They work like starting points, locations from which the four-color patterns can be calculated.
paras.zh: 它们的工作原理就像可以计算四色图案的起点和位置。

paras.en: The more starting points there are, the faster the coloring can be calculated. The approach also helps to simplify the map initially, with the rest of the complexity added in later and the colors tweaked to fit.
paras.zh: 起点越多，计算着色的速度就越快。该方法还有助于最初简化地图，随后添加其余的复杂性并调整颜色以适应。

paras.en: "Think of reducible configurations as handles you can grab hold on to start four coloring," says mathematician Carsten Thomassen, from the Technical University of Denmark.
paras.zh: 丹麦技术大学的数学家卡斯滕·托马森 (Carsten Thomassen) 表示：“将可简化配置想象成可以抓住的手柄，开始四种着色。”

paras.en: "We show that graphs do not contain just one handle, but an astonishing number of them. Nobody knew that before."
paras.zh: “我们证明图表不仅仅包含一个句柄，而且包含数量惊人的句柄。以前没有人知道这一点。”

paras.en: While the 1976 and 1997 proofs showed that four colors would work on any map, three decades after the last proof we've got another one that optimizes the problem and tackles it more efficiently – and which scales up much better.
paras.zh: 虽然 1976 年和 1997 年的证明表明四种颜色适用于任何地图，但在上一个证明三十年后，我们又得到了另一个证明，可以优化问题并更有效地解决问题，而且可以更好地扩展。

paras.en: "We have gone from what mathematicians call quadratic time to linear time," says Thomassen.
paras.zh: “我们已经从数学家所说的二次时间变成了线性时间，”托马森说。

paras.en: "This means that if a map contains ten times as many regions, the computation only becomes about ten times slower. With the previous algorithm, it would have become about 100 times slower."
paras.zh: “这意味着，如果地图包含十倍多的区域，计算速度只会慢十倍左右。如果使用以前的算法，计算速度会慢大约 100 倍。”

paras.en: Across two papers, one of which was presented at the IEEE Symposium on Foundations of Computer Science (FOCS), the researchers combined both mathematics and data structures to develop a fresh algorithm for the map problem and a carefully calibrated way of deploying the algorithm.
paras.zh: 在两篇论文中，其中一篇在 IEEE 计算机科学基础研讨会 (FOCS) 上发表，研究人员将数学和数据结构结合起来，为地图问题开发了一种新算法，并精心校准了算法的部署方式。

paras.en: It's testament to the dedication of the researchers (which they describe as a "disease") that we're still seeing innovation around a problem that thousands of mathematicians have worked on over the last 174 years.
paras.zh: 我们仍然看到围绕着过去 174 年来数千名数学家致力于解决的问题的创新，这证明了研究人员的奉献精神（他们将其描述为一种“疾病”）。

paras.en: What's more, because math can be used to turn maps into graphs – represented by points and connections – the same process that's applied here to the Four Color Theorem could also help with other mathematical puzzles, the researchers suggest.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，研究人员表示，由于数学可以用来将地图转化为图形（由点和连接表示），因此应用于四色定理的相同过程也可以帮助解决其他数学难题。

paras.en: We just got a newly optimized calculation method that could also help with tackling other kinds of surfaces
paras.zh: 我们刚刚获得了一种新优化的计算方法，该方法也可以帮助处理其他类型的表面

paras.en: "The remarkable thing is that because there are so many handles, the idea can also be applied to other kinds of surfaces besides a flat map," says Thorup.
paras.zh: “值得注意的是，由于有如此多的手柄，这个想法还可以应用于除平面地图之外的其他类型的表面，”索鲁普说。

paras.en: "For example, surfaces with holes, such as a swim ring or a piece of Emmental cheese."
paras.zh: “例如，有孔的表面，例如游泳圈或一块埃门塔尔奶酪。”

paras.en: "That is why we believe the result could have significance far beyond the Four Color Theorem."
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我们相信这个结果的意义可能远远超出四色定理。”

articles.title: Interstellar solar sails hit a bizarre problem at 75% of light speed

paras.en: Interstellar solar sails hit a bizarre problem at 75% of light speed
paras.zh: 星际太阳帆在75%光速时遇到奇怪问题

paras.en: - Scientists have discovered a surprising obstacle to interstellar travel: at extreme speeds, the light propelling futuristic solar sails could actually begin slowing them down. Once a spacecraft reaches 75% of the speed of light, some scattered light starts producing drag, potentially complicating humanityâs plans to reach distant stars.
paras.zh: - 科学家们发现了星际旅行的一个令人惊讶的障碍：在极限速度下，推动未来太阳帆的光实际上可能开始减慢它们的速度。一旦航天器达到光速的 75%，一些散射光就会开始产生阻力，这可能会使人类到达遥远恒星的计划变得复杂。

paras.en: Reaching another star will require spacecraft capable of traveling far faster than anything humanity has built so far. Conventional rockets powered by chemical fuel simply cannot achieve the enormous speeds needed to cross the distances between stars within a practical amount of time. One promising alternative is the solar sail, a vast, lightweight reflective surface that uses the momentum of light to propel a spacecraft through space.
paras.zh: 到达另一颗恒星需要的航天器的飞行速度比人类迄今为止建造的任何航天器都快得多。由化学燃料驱动的传统火箭根本无法在实际时间内达到穿越恒星之间距离所需的巨大速度。一种有前途的替代方案是太阳帆，这是一种巨大的轻质反射表面，利用光的动量推动航天器穿越太空。

paras.en: Some proposed interstellar missions would take this concept even further by using powerful lasers to push sails to extraordinary speeds, potentially reaching a substantial fraction of the speed of light. However, new research suggests that this approach comes with an unexpected complication. At extreme speeds, some of the very light driving the spacecraft forward could begin acting against it.
paras.zh: 一些拟议的星际任务将进一步采用这一概念，使用强大的激光将帆推到非凡的速度，有可能达到光速的相当一部分。然而，新的研究表明这种方法会带来意想不到的并发症。在极限速度下，一些推动航天器前进的非常轻的光线可能会开始对其产生作用。

paras.en: In a recent paper available on arXiv, Chao Shen and Jiaze Li of the Harbin Institute of Technology investigate how light interacts with a rapidly accelerating solar sail. Their findings reveal a surprising source of resistance that emerges as the spacecraft approaches 75% of the speed of light.
paras.zh: 在 arXiv 上最近发表的一篇论文中，哈尔滨工业大学的 Chao Shen 和 Jiaze Li 研究了光如何与快速加速的太阳帆相互作用。他们的发现揭示了当航天器接近 75% 光速时出现的令人惊讶的阻力来源。

paras.en: How Light Can Push a Spacecraft Through Space
paras.zh: 光如何推动航天器穿越太空

paras.en: Although light has no mass, it carries momentum and can transfer that momentum to objects it strikes. This creates a tiny pushing force known as radiation pressure. Under ordinary conditions, the effect is extremely weak, but in the vacuum of space, a large reflective sail can gradually build up speed as light continues to strike its surface.
paras.zh: 尽管光没有质量，但它带有动量，并且可以将动量传递给它所撞击的物体。这会产生一个微小的推力，称为辐射压力。在正常情况下，这种效应极其微弱，但在太空真空中，随着光线继续照射其表面，大型反射帆可以逐渐加速。

paras.en: For spacecraft traveling between stars, powerful lasers could provide a much more concentrated source of light than the Sun. By directing an intense beam at a sail, engineers hope to accelerate extremely small probes to speeds that conventional propulsion systems cannot approach.
paras.zh: 对于在恒星之间旅行的航天器，强大的激光可以提供比太阳更集中的光源。通过将强光束射向帆，工程师希望将极小的探测器加速到传统推进系统无法达到的速度。

paras.en: The researchers examined three ways that photons, the individual packets of energy that make up light, transfer momentum to a sail. These interactions are incident light (that raw momentum of the photons hitting the sail), specular reflection (momentum imparted when photons bounce perfectly off the sail), and diffuse scattering (momentum from photons that are absorbed by the sail then reemitted in random directions).
paras.zh: 研究人员研究了光子（构成光的单个能量包）将动量传递给帆的三种方式。这些相互作用包括入射光（光子撞击帆的原始动量）、镜面反射（光子从帆上完美弹回时产生的动量）和漫散射（被帆吸收然后以随机方向重新发射的光子产生的动量）。

paras.en: According to the study, these three contributions affect the sail's motion with different levels of efficiency. Incident light provides the strongest contribution in the researchers' breakdown, followed by specular reflection and then diffuse scattering.
paras.zh: 根据研究，这三种贡献以不同程度的效率影响帆的运动。入射光对研究人员的分解贡献最大，其次是镜面反射，然后是漫散射。

paras.en: A Strange Problem Emerges Near the Speed of Light
paras.zh: 接近光速时出现一个奇怪的问题

paras.en: The situation becomes considerably more complicated once a solar sail reaches relativistic speeds, meaning speeds high enough that the effects predicted by Einstein's theory of relativity become important.
paras.zh: 一旦太阳帆达到相对论速度，情况就会变得相当复杂，这意味着速度足够高，以至于爱因斯坦相对论预测的效应变得重要。

paras.en: As the sail accelerates away from its laser source, it experiences an increasingly strong Doppler effect. This is the same basic phenomenon that changes the apparent pitch of a passing ambulance siren, except that light experiences a change in frequency rather than sound.
paras.zh: 当帆加速远离激光源时，它会经历越来越强的多普勒效应。这与改变路过的救护车警报的明显音高的基本现象相同，只是光经历了频率而不是声音的变化。

paras.en: For the accelerating sail, the incoming laser light becomes progressively redshifted, meaning its frequency decreases from the sail's perspective. As a result, the light transfers momentum less effectively, reducing the thrust generated by all three contributions examined in the study.
paras.zh: 对于加速的帆，入射的激光逐渐红移，这意味着从帆的角度来看其频率降低。因此，光传递动量的效率较低，从而减少了研究中检查的所有三个贡献所产生的推力。

paras.en: In other words, the faster the spacecraft travels, the less effective its laser propulsion becomes. Even with a powerful beam continuously striking the sail, gaining additional speed becomes increasingly difficult.
paras.zh: 换句话说，航天器运行得越快，其激光推进的效率就越低。即使有强大的光束持续撞击船帆，获得额外的速度也变得越来越困难。

paras.en: Various concepts for interstellar exploration have been proposed over the years, including Breakthrough Starshot, which envisioned using powerful lasers to accelerate tiny spacecraft toward nearby stars. The new findings highlight another challenge that such ambitious missions would need to consider.
paras.zh: 多年来，人们提出了各种星际探索的概念，其中包括“突破摄星”，它设想使用强大的激光加速微型航天器飞向附近的恒星。新的发现凸显了此类雄心勃勃的任务需要考虑的另一个挑战。

paras.en: At 75% of Light Speed, Light Starts Working Against the Sail
paras.zh: 当光速达到 75% 时，光开始对抗帆

paras.en: The researchers identified an especially unusual effect once the sail reaches approximately 75% of the speed of light.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，一旦帆达到光速约 75%，就会出现一种特别不寻常的效应。

paras.en: At this point, a phenomenon known as relativistic light aberration changes how the scattered light is distributed. Relativistic aberration describes how the apparent directions in which light travels are altered by motion at speeds approaching the speed of light.
paras.zh: 此时，一种称为相对论光像差的现象会改变散射光的分布方式。相对论像差描述了光传播的表观方向如何因接近光速的运动而改变。

paras.en: From the viewpoint of an observer at rest on Earth, the diffusely scattered light becomes increasingly concentrated in the spacecraft's forward direction. Because emitting light carries momentum, the sail experiences a corresponding recoil in the opposite direction.
paras.zh: 从地球上静止的观察者的角度来看，漫散射光越来越集中在航天器的前进方向。由于发射的光带有动量，因此帆会在相反方向上经历相应的反冲。

paras.en: This means that diffuse scattering (admittedly the weakest of the three forces) begins producing drag rather than helping propel the spacecraft forward.
paras.zh: 这意味着漫散射（公认的三种力中最弱的一种）开始产生阻力，而不是帮助推动航天器前进。

paras.en: The result is a striking paradox: some of the light intended to accelerate an interstellar spacecraft actually begins resisting its motion.
paras.zh: 结果是一个惊人的悖论：一些旨在加速星际飞船的光实际上开始抵抗它的运动。

paras.en: Importantly, this does not mean the spacecraft suddenly stops accelerating or that its entire propulsion system begins pushing backward. The laser still generates a positive overall force, allowing the sail to continue gaining speed. However, the additional resistance reduces the efficiency of the system, making further acceleration more challenging.
paras.zh: 重要的是，这并不意味着航天器突然停止加速或其整个推进系统开始向后推。激光仍然会产生正向的整体力，使船帆继续加速。然而，额外的阻力降低了系统的效率，使进一步的加速更具挑战性。

paras.en: Advanced Materials Could Help Overcome the Challenge
paras.zh: 先进材料可以帮助克服挑战

paras.en: The study focuses specifically on the forces produced by light and does not attempt to model every obstacle a spacecraft would encounter during an interstellar journey.
paras.zh: 该研究特别关注光产生的力，并不试图对航天器在星际旅行中遇到的每个障碍进行建模。

paras.en: For example, the researchers do not include resistance from interstellar gas and dust, which could become important at extreme velocities. They also leave out the thermal challenges associated with directing extremely powerful lasers at a thin sail. If the material absorbs too much energy, intense heating could damage or even melt it.
paras.zh: 例如，研究人员没有考虑星际气体和尘埃的阻力，这在极速情况下可能变得很重要。他们还忽略了将极其强大的激光照射在薄帆上所带来的热挑战。如果材料吸收过多的能量，强烈的加热可能会损坏甚至熔化它。

paras.en: Another important simplification is that the calculations treat the sail as an idealized mirror. Real spacecraft would need materials capable of reflecting laser light efficiently while remaining lightweight, durable, and stable under extreme conditions.
paras.zh: 另一个重要的简化是计算将帆视为理想化的镜子。真正的航天器需要能够有效反射激光的材料，同时在极端条件下保持轻质、耐用和稳定。

paras.en: Engineers are already exploring advanced metamaterials and photonic crystals that could help address these demands. These specially engineered materials can be designed to interact with particular wavelengths of light in ways that ordinary reflective surfaces cannot.
paras.zh: 工程师们已经在探索先进的超材料和光子晶体，以帮助满足这些需求。这些经过特殊设计的材料可以设计成与特定波长的光相互作用，而普通反射表面则无法做到这一点。

paras.en: Intriguingly, such materials might even turn some of the relativistic effects identified in the research into an advantage. By carefully controlling how light scatters from the sail, future designs could potentially generate forces that automatically correct its orientation and position, helping it remain aligned with the laser beam throughout acceleration.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，此类材料甚至可能将研究中发现的一些相对论效应转化为优势。通过仔细控制光从帆的散射方式，未来的设计可能会产生自动纠正其方向和位置的力，帮助其在整个加速过程中保持与激光束对齐。

paras.en: Despite the promise of laser propulsion, humanity remains far from building and testing a complete solar sail system capable of reaching another star.
paras.zh: 尽管有激光推进的希望，但人类距离建造和测试能够到达另一颗恒星的完整太阳帆系统还很遥远。

paras.en: The physics becomes increasingly complicated over such enormous distances and at such extraordinary speeds. Additional effects, including the curvature of spacetime, would also need to be considered in a more complete description of an interstellar journey. These effects were simplified out of the new analysis.
paras.zh: 在如此遥远的距离和如此非凡的速度下，物理学变得越来越复杂。在对星际旅行进行更完整的描述时，还需要考虑其他影响，包括时空曲率。新的分析简化了这些影响。

paras.en: Nevertheless, understanding how light behaves when it interacts with a spacecraft traveling at a significant fraction of light speed is an important part of making interstellar exploration possible.
paras.zh: 然而，了解光与以相当大的光速运行的航天器相互作用时的行为方式是使星际探索成为可能的重要组成部分。

paras.en: If humanity eventually sends robotic probes to another star, success will depend on solving countless engineering and physics challenges. Knowing that light itself can become an unexpected source of resistance gives researchers one more piece of the puzzle, and potentially a better understanding of how to design spacecraft capable of making the journey.
paras.zh: 如果人类最终将机器人探测器发送到另一颗恒星，成功将取决于解决无数的工程和物理挑战。知道光本身可能成为一种意想不到的阻力源，这让研究人员又解决了一个难题，并有可能更好地理解如何设计能够完成这一旅程的航天器。

articles.title: Type 2 diabetes linked to 53% higher Alzheimer’s risk, major review finds

paras.en: Type 2 diabetes linked to 53% higher Alzheimerâs risk, major review finds
paras.zh: 重大审查发现 2 型糖尿病与阿尔茨海默病风险增加 53% 相关

paras.en: - People with type 2 diabetes face a 53% higher risk of developing Alzheimerâs disease, according to a major new review of 40 studies. Researchers estimate that nearly five out of every 1,000 people with type 2 diabetes develop Alzheimerâs each year. By focusing specifically on these two conditions, the study offers a clearer understanding of a potentially serious connection between metabolic health and brain health.
paras.zh: - 根据对 40 项研究的最新重大综述，2 型糖尿病患者患阿尔茨海默病的风险要高出 53%。研究人员估计，每年每 1000 名 2 型糖尿病患者中就有近 5 人患有阿尔茨海默病。通过专门关注这两种情况，该研究可以更清楚地了解代谢健康和大脑健康之间潜在的严重联系。

paras.en: A major research review led by Curtin University has found that people with type 2 diabetes face a significantly higher risk of developing Alzheimer's disease. The findings provide a clearer picture of the connection between diabetes and Alzheimer's, including how much the risk increases and how frequently new cases occur.
paras.zh: 科廷大学领导的一项重大研究发现，2 型糖尿病患者患阿尔茨海默病的风险明显更高。这些发现更清楚地说明了糖尿病和阿尔茨海默氏症之间的联系，包括风险增加的程度以及新病例发生的频率。

paras.en: Researchers analyzed data from 40 studies in a systematic review and meta-analysis. They estimated that for every 1,000 people with type 2 diabetes, approximately 4.7 would develop Alzheimer's disease over the course of one year.
paras.zh: 研究人员通过系统评价和荟萃分析分析了 40 项研究的数据。他们估计，每 1000 名 2 型糖尿病患者中，大约有 4.7 人会在一年内患上阿尔茨海默病。

paras.en: A separate analysis found that people with type 2 diabetes had a 53 percent higher adjusted relative risk of developing Alzheimer's compared with those without the condition.
paras.zh: 另一项分析发现，与未患阿尔茨海默病的人相比，2 型糖尿病患者患阿尔茨海默病的调整相对风险要高出 53%。

paras.en: Understanding the Link Between Diabetes and Alzheimer's
paras.zh: 了解糖尿病和阿尔茨海默病之间的联系

paras.en: Study author Dr. Emmanuel Adewuyi, an NHMRC Investigator Fellow at the Curtin School of Population Health, explained that the findings offer a more precise understanding of Alzheimer's risk among people with type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 研究作者、科廷人口健康学院 NHMRC 研究员 Emmanuel Adewuyi 博士解释说，这些发现可以更准确地了解 2 型糖尿病患者患阿尔茨海默病的风险。

paras.en: Unlike previous research reviews that often examined multiple forms of diabetes or dementia together, this analysis concentrated specifically on type 2 diabetes and Alzheimer's disease. It also measured how frequently people with diabetes developed Alzheimer's, providing an additional perspective on the connection between the two conditions.
paras.zh: 与之前的研究评论经常同时检查多种形式的糖尿病或痴呆症不同，此次分析专门针对 2 型糖尿病和阿尔茨海默病。它还测量了糖尿病患者患阿尔茨海默病的频率，为研究这两种疾病之间的联系提供了额外的视角。

paras.en: "While many earlier reviews combined different types of diabetes or dementia, this review focused specifically on type 2 diabetes and Alzheimer's disease and estimated how often new cases occurred," Dr. Adewuyi said.
paras.zh: “虽然许多早期评论结合了不同类型的糖尿病或痴呆症，但本次评论特别关注 2 型糖尿病和阿尔茨海默病，并估计了新病例发生的频率，”Adewuyi 博士说。

paras.en: "Relative risk tells us how two groups compare, while incidence tells us how often new cases occur: putting those numbers together gives us a clearer picture of the burden of Alzheimer's disease among people living with type 2 diabetes."
paras.zh: “相对风险告诉我们两组的比较情况，而发病率告诉我们新病例发生的频率：将这些数字放在一起可以让我们更清楚地了解 2 型糖尿病患者中阿尔茨海默病的负担。”

paras.en: The study, "Incidence and risk of Alzheimer's disease in individuals with type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis," was published in Alzheimer's Research & Therapy.
paras.zh: 该研究题为“2 型糖尿病患者阿尔茨海默病的发病率和风险：系统评价和荟萃分析”，发表在《阿尔茨海默病研究与治疗》杂志上。

paras.en: Materials provided by Curtin University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由科廷大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

Incidence and risk of Alzheimerâs disease in individuals with type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Alzheimer\'s Research, 2026; DOI: 10.1186/s13195-026-02254-7
paras.zh: - Thi Thu Huong Nguyen、Asa Auta、Emmanuel Agada David、Chinedu I. Ossai、Victory Olutuase、Moulinath Banerjee、赵云、Davies Adeloye、Gavin Pereira、Emmanuel O. Adewuyi。 2 型糖尿病患者阿尔茨海默病的发病率和风险：系统评价和荟萃分析。阿尔茨海默病研究，2026； DOI：10.1186/s13195-026-02254-7

articles.title: Common medications may secretly rewire your gut, with effects lasting for years

paras.en: Common medications may secretly rewire your gut, with effects lasting for years
paras.zh: 常见药物可能会秘密地重塑您的肠道，其效果可持续数年

paras.en: - Medications taken years or even long ago may leave lasting changes in your gut microbiome, according to a study of more than 2,500 people. Researchers discovered that common drugs, including antidepressants, blood pressure medications, and anxiety treatments, can leave microbial âfingerprintsâ long after patients stop taking them. Surprisingly, some anxiety medications had effects comparable to broad-spectrum antibiotics.
paras.zh: - 一项对 2,500 多人进行的研究表明，几年甚至很久以前服用的药物可能会给您的肠道微生物组带来持久的变化。研究人员发现，常见药物，包括抗抑郁药、降压药和焦虑治疗药，在患者停止服用后很长时间内仍会留下微生物“指纹”。令人惊讶的是，一些抗焦虑药物的效果与广谱抗生素相当。

paras.en: Medications you stopped taking years ago may still be influencing the bacteria living in your gut. A large study from the University of Tartu Institute of Genomics has found that many commonly prescribed drugs leave lasting changes in the gut microbiome, even long after people stop using them.
paras.zh: 您几年前停止服用的药物可能仍然会影响肠道内的细菌。塔尔图大学基因组研究所的一项大型研究发现，许多常用处方药物即使在人们停止使用很久之后也会对肠道微生物组产生持久的变化。

paras.en: The gut microbiome is the vast community of bacteria and other microorganisms that inhabit the digestive tract. These microbes play important roles in digestion, immune function, and overall health. While antibiotics are well known for disrupting gut bacteria, the new findings suggest that many other medications can also have effects that persist for years.
paras.zh: 肠道微生物群是栖息在消化道中的细菌和其他微生物的庞大群落。这些微生物在消化、免疫功能和整体健康中发挥着重要作用。虽然众所周知，抗生素会破坏肠道细菌，但新发现表明，许多其他药物也可能产生持续多年的影响。

paras.en: To investigate these connections, researchers examined stool samples and prescription histories from more than 2,500 participants in the Estonian Biobank's Estonian Microbiome cohort. They discovered that most of the medications studied were associated with changes in gut bacteria. Even more surprisingly, a substantial number left detectable microbial "fingerprints" years after patients had stopped taking them.
paras.zh: 为了调查这些联系，研究人员检查了爱沙尼亚生物银行爱沙尼亚微生物组队列中 2,500 多名参与者的粪便样本和处方历史。他们发现大多数研究的药物都与肠道细菌的变化有关。更令人惊讶的是，在患者停止服用药物多年后，相当多的药物仍留下了可检测到的微生物“指纹”。

paras.en: Common Medications Leave Lasting Changes in Gut Bacteria
paras.zh: 常见药物会使肠道细菌产生持久变化

paras.en: The findings extend far beyond antibiotics. Antidepressants, beta-blockers, proton pump inhibitors, and benzodiazepines were all linked to differences in the gut microbiome.
paras.zh: 这些发现远远超出了抗生素的范围。抗抑郁药、β-受体阻滞剂、质子泵抑制剂和苯二氮卓类药物都与肠道微生物组的差异有关。

paras.en: These medications are widely used to treat everyday health conditions. Beta-blockers are commonly prescribed for high blood pressure and certain heart conditions, while proton pump inhibitors reduce stomach acid and are frequently used to treat acid reflux. Benzodiazepines are often prescribed for anxiety, and antidepressants help manage depression and other mental health conditions.
paras.zh: 这些药物广泛用于治疗日常健康状况。 β-受体阻滞剂通常用于治疗高血压和某些心脏病，而质子泵抑制剂可减少胃酸，常用于治疗胃酸反流。苯二氮卓类药物通常用于治疗焦虑症，抗抑郁药有助于控制抑郁症和其他心理健康状况。

paras.en: "Most microbiome studies only consider current medications, but our results show that past drug use can be just as important as it is a surprisingly strong factor in explaining individual microbiome differences," said Dr. Oliver Aasmets, lead author.
paras.zh: “大多数微生物组研究只考虑当前的药物，但我们的结果表明，过去的药物使用可能同样重要，因为它是解释个体微生物组差异的一个令人惊讶的强大因素，”主要作者 Oliver Aasmets 博士说。

paras.en: This discovery suggests that looking only at the medications someone currently takes may overlook an important part of their gut health history. Previous prescriptions could help explain why the composition of gut bacteria differs so much from one person to another.
paras.zh: 这一发现表明，仅关注某人当前服用的药物可能会忽视他们肠道健康史的一个重要部分。之前的处方可以帮助解释为什么肠道细菌的组成因人而异。

paras.en: Anxiety Medications Show Effects Comparable to Antibiotics
paras.zh: 抗焦虑药物的效果与抗生素相当

paras.en: One of the most striking findings involved benzodiazepines, a class of medications commonly used to treat anxiety.
paras.zh: 最引人注目的发现之一涉及苯二氮卓类药物，这是一类常用于治疗焦虑的药物。

paras.en: Researchers found that these drugs were associated with changes in the gut microbiome comparable to those seen with broad-spectrum antibiotics. These antibiotics target a wide variety of bacteria and are known to substantially alter the microbial communities living in the digestive system.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，这些药物与肠道微生物组的变化有关，与广谱抗生素所见的变化相当。这些抗生素针对多种细菌，并且已知可以显着改变消化系统中的微生物群落。

paras.en: The researchers also discovered that medications within the same drug class did not necessarily produce the same effects. For example, diazepam and alprazolam are both benzodiazepines used to treat similar conditions, yet they appeared to differ in how strongly they disrupted gut bacteria.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现，同一类药物中的药物不一定会产生相同的效果。例如，地西泮和阿普唑仑都是用于治疗类似病症的苯二氮卓类药物，但它们破坏肠道细菌的强度似乎有所不同。

paras.en: This suggests that the effects of medication on the microbiome may depend not only on the type of drug being taken, but also on the specific medication.
paras.zh: 这表明药物对微生物组的影响可能不仅取决于所服用药物的类型，还取决于具体药物。

paras.en: Gut Bacteria Can Change When Medications Are Started or Stopped
paras.zh: 当药物开始或停止时，肠道细菌会发生变化

paras.en: To investigate whether medications were actually contributing to these microbial changes, researchers collected additional stool samples from a smaller group of participants.
paras.zh: 为了调查药物是否确实导致了这些微生物变化，研究人员从一小群参与者那里收集了额外的粪便样本。

paras.en: By examining how the microbiome changed when people started or stopped certain medications, the team identified predictable shifts in gut bacteria. These findings provided additional evidence that the drugs themselves were contributing to the changes, rather than simply being associated with differences already present in patients.
paras.zh: 通过检查当人们开始或停止某些药物时微生物组如何变化，研究小组发现了肠道细菌的可预测变化。这些发现提供了额外的证据，表明药物本身正在促成这些变化，而不是简单地与患者中已经存在的差异相关。

paras.en: Although the number of participants in this follow-up analysis was relatively small, the researchers were able to verify lasting effects associated with several drug categories. These included proton pump inhibitors, selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, and certain antibiotics, including combinations of penicillins and macrolides.
paras.zh: 尽管此次后续分析的参与者数量相对较少，但研究人员能够验证与几种药物类别相关的持久影响。这些药物包括质子泵抑制剂、选择性血清素再摄取抑制剂和某些抗生素，包括青霉素和大环内酯类药物的组合。

paras.en: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, often called SSRIs, are a widely prescribed type of antidepressant. Macrolides are a class of antibiotics used to treat various bacterial infections.
paras.zh: 选择性血清素再摄取抑制剂（通常称为 SSRI）是一种广泛使用的抗抑郁药。大环内酯类是一类用于治疗各种细菌感染的抗生素。

paras.en: Why Your Medication History May Matter More Than Previously Thought
paras.zh: 为什么您的用药史可能比以前想象的更重要

paras.en: The findings point to an important consideration for researchers studying the relationship between gut bacteria and disease. Differences in the microbiome may reflect not only a person's current health and medication use, but also treatments received years earlier.
paras.zh: 这些发现为研究肠道细菌与疾病之间关系的研究人员指出了一个重要的考虑因素。微生物组的差异可能不仅反映了一个人当前的健康状况和药物使用情况，还反映了多年前接受的治疗。

paras.en: If previous medications are not taken into account, scientists could mistakenly attribute certain microbial differences to a disease or another health factor when past drug exposure may have contributed.
paras.zh: 如果不考虑以前的药物治疗，科学家可能会错误地将某些微生物差异归因于疾病或其他健康因素，而过去的药物暴露可能对此有所贡献。

paras.en: The results also highlight how much remains to be understood about the long-term relationship between medications and the gut microbiome. Although the study identified persistent microbial changes, these findings do not establish that such changes are necessarily harmful or that they lead to specific health problems.
paras.zh: 研究结果还强调了药物与肠道微生物组之间的长期关系还有多少有待了解。尽管该研究发现了持续的微生物变化，但这些发现并不能证明这种变化一定有害或会导致特定的健康问题。

paras.en: "This is a comprehensive systematic evaluation of long-term medication effects on the microbiome using real-world medical health records," said Professor Elin Org, corresponding author. "We hope this encourages researchers and clinicians to factor in medication history when interpreting microbiome data."
paras.zh: 通讯作者 Elin Org 教授说：“这是利用真实世界的医疗健康记录对长期药物对微生物群的影响进行的全面系统评估。” “我们希望这能鼓励研究人员和临床医生在解释微生物组数据时考虑用药史。”

paras.en: Materials provided by Estonian Research Council. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov.22, 1989: NASA launches space shuttle Discovery on classified STS-33 mission for the US military
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 22, 1989, the space shuttle Discovery launched on the secret mission STS-33 for the U.S. military. It lifted off from Kennedy Space Center and up into the dark of night.
paras.zh: 1989 年 11 月 22 日，发现号航天飞机为美国军方执行秘密任务 STS-33。它从肯尼迪航天中心升空，进入漆黑的夜晚。

paras.en: This was the third nighttime launch of the shuttle program and the 32nd shuttle mission overall. Discovery had five astronauts on board. Their mission was to deploy a classified payload for the U.S. Department of Defense. NASA and the military launched several secretive shuttle missions to deploy military satellites.
paras.zh: 这是航天飞机计划的第三次夜间发射，也是第 32 次航天飞机任务。发现号上有五名宇航员。他们的任务是为美国国防部部署机密有效载荷。美国宇航局和军方发起了几次秘密航天飞机任务来部署军用卫星。

paras.en: The satellite that launched with STS-33 is believed to be a type of spy satellite called Magnum. But exactly what Magnum was doing in orbit remains classified.
paras.zh: 与 STS-33 一起发射的卫星被认为是一种名为 Magnum 的间谍卫星。但马格南在轨道上到底做了什么仍然保密。

paras.en: From its start, the Space Transportation System, better known as the space shuttle, was a compromise between meeting civilian and military needs. NASA saw the vehicle as a means of supporting science research, establishing an on-orbit economy (servicing commercial satellites and flying company payloads) and ultimately, assembling the parts for a space station.
paras.zh: 从一开始，太空运输系统（即航天飞机）就是满足民用和军事需求之间的折衷方案。美国宇航局将这种飞行器视为支持科学研究、建立在轨经济（为商业卫星和飞行公司有效载荷提供服务）以及最终为空间站组装零件的一种手段。

paras.en: The Department of Defense saw the shuttle as an asset to deploying and retrieving reconnaissance satellites, among other projects, some of them classified. It was not until the loss of the space shuttle Challenger, that it was decided that the shuttle would only be used by the military when it was key to national security. Other needs would be met by expendable launch vehicles (ELVs).
paras.zh: 国防部将航天飞机视为部署和回收侦察卫星以及其他项目（其中一些项目属于机密）的资产。直到挑战者号航天飞机失事后，人们才决定航天飞机仅在对国家安全至关重要的情况下才供军方使用。其他需求将通过消耗性运载火箭（ELV）来满足。

paras.en: As an aside, the STS-33 astronauts also spent Thanksgiving in space during this mission. But the holiday was off to a crappy start when the shuttle's toilet broke first thing in the morning. After spending most of the day fixing it, they got to enjoy their Thanksgiving turkey together.
paras.zh: 顺便说一句，STS-33 宇航员在这次任务期间也在太空中度过了感恩节。但当航天飞机的厕所在早上就坏了时，这个假期就开始了一个糟糕的开始。在花了一天的大部分时间修理之后，他们一起享用了感恩节火鸡。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: Watch live today: Amazon launching 1st batch of internet satellites since Vulcan Centaur failure
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: Another batch of Amazon internet satellites will fly on Monday morning (Nov. 23), just eight days after a launch failure doomed 40 of the spacecraft.
paras.zh: 另一批亚马逊互联网卫星将于周一早上（11 月 23 日）升空，距离 40 颗航天器发射失败仅八天。

paras.en: An Ariane 6 rocket carrying 36 satellites for the Amazon Leo constellation is scheduled to lift off from Europe's Spaceport in Kourou, French Guiana on Monday, during a 29-minute window that opens at 6:09 a.m. EST (1109 GMT; 8:09 a.m. local time in Kourou).
paras.zh: 运载 36 颗亚马逊狮子座卫星的阿丽亚娜 6 号火箭计划于周一从位于法属圭亚那库鲁的欧洲太空港升空，发射时间为 29 分钟，时间为美国东部时间上午 6:09（格林尼治标准时间 1109；库鲁当地时间上午 8:09）。

paras.en: You can watch it live here at Space.com, courtesy of Arianespace, the French company that operates the Ariane 6. Coverage will begin about 30 minutes before launch.
paras.zh: 您可以在 Space.com 上观看直播，由运营阿丽亚娜 6 号的法国公司 Arianespace 提供。报道将在发射前 30 分钟左右开始。

paras.en: Amazon Leo, so named because it will operate in low Earth orbit, will compete with SpaceX's Starlink internet constellation, which currently consists of more than 11,000 operational spacecraft.
paras.zh: 亚马逊 Leo 之所以如此命名，是因为它将在近地轨道运行，将与 SpaceX 的 Starlink 互联网星座竞争，后者目前由 11,000 多个运行的航天器组成。

paras.en: Amazon's network will eventually have more than 3,200 satellites, but just 400 or so have reached orbit to date. Another 40 were supposed to be delivered on Nov. 15, but they were lost after their rocket ride, a United Launch Alliance (ULA) Vulcan Centaur, suffered a problem shortly after launch.
paras.zh: 亚马逊的网络最终将拥有 3,200 多颗卫星，但迄今为止只有 400 颗左右进入轨道。另外 40 枚原定于 11 月 15 日交付，但联合发射联盟 (ULA) 火神半人马座火箭在发射后不久遇到问题，导致它们丢失。

paras.en: Ariane 6 and Vulcan Centaur aren't the only rockets Amazon is depending on to build its broadband constellation. Jeff Bezos' company has also booked rides on ULA's Atlas V rocket, Blue Origin's New Glenn and SpaceX's Falcon 9.
paras.zh: 阿丽亚娜 6 号和火神半人马座并不是亚马逊构建其宽带星座的唯一火箭。杰夫·贝佐斯的公司还预订了 ULA 的 Atlas V 火箭、蓝色起源的 New Glenn 和 SpaceX 的 Falcon 9 号火箭。

paras.en: Vulcan will be grounded for a while as ULA investigates the Nov. 15 failure and works to fix whatever caused it. And New Glenn hasn't flown since April, when the rocket failed to deliver AST SpaceMobile's BlueBird 7 satellite to the proper orbit. New Glenn's return to flight was further complicated on May 28, when the rocket exploded during a routine prelaunch test.
paras.zh: Vulcan 将停飞一段时间，ULA 将对 11 月 15 日发生的故障进行调查，并努力解决导致故障的原因。自 4 月份以来，新格伦号火箭未能将 AST SpaceMobile 的蓝鸟 7 号卫星送入正确轨道，之后就再也没有升空过。 5 月 28 日，新格伦号的重返飞行变得更加复杂，当时火箭在例行的发射前测试中发生爆炸。

paras.en: The Ariane 6, the successor to Arianespace's Ariane 5 heavy lifter, debuted in July 2024 and has nine launches under its belt to date. All of them have been successful except that maiden mission, which was a partial failure.
paras.zh: 阿丽亚娜 6 是阿丽亚娜航天公司阿丽亚娜 5 重型运输机的后继者，于 2024 年 7 月首次亮相，迄今为止已进行了九次发射。除了首次任务部分失败外，所有这些任务都取得了成功。

paras.en: Monday's mission will be the fourth Amazon Leo flight for the Ariane 6, following launches in February, April and June of this year.
paras.zh: 周一的任务将是阿丽亚娜 6 号继今年 2 月、4 月和 6 月发射后的第四次亚马逊 Leo 飞行。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: UARX Space Marks a Milestone for Spain’s Space Industry with the Maiden Flight of OSSIE-D, Featuring a Complete Power Subsystem Supplied by DHV Technology
articles.author: UARX Space

paras.en: Nigrán, Spain | November 12 2026 – UARX Space has achieved a major milestone for Spain’s space industry with the deployment of OSSIE-D, an Orbital Transfer Vehicle (OTV) designed and manufactured entirely in Spain, with 75% of its components developed in-house by the company. Launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, OSSIE-D was deployed using SAU&RON 24, UARX Space’s proprietary separation system. The achievement marks a world first, bringing together an orbital transfer vehicle and a separation system developed by the same company in a single mission.
paras.zh: 西班牙尼格兰| 2026 年 11 月 12 日 – UARX Space 部署了 OSSIE-D，实现了西班牙航天工业的一个重要里程碑。OSSIE-D 是一种完全在西班牙设计和制造的轨道传输飞行器 (OTV)，其 75% 的组件由该公司内部开发。 OSSIE-D 由 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭发射，并使用 UARX Space 的专有分离系统 SAU&RON 24 进行部署。这一成就标志着世界首创，将同一家公司开发的轨道传输飞行器和分离系统结合在一次任务中。

paras.en: The mission represents a significant advance in Spain’s space technology capabilities, demonstrating the ability to develop and integrate key technologies for in-space transportation and orbital operations. By combining its OTV with its own SAU&RON 24 separation system, UARX Space reinforces its integrated approach to spacecraft development, spanning the vehicle itself and the technology required for its deployment into orbit.
paras.zh: 该任务代表了西班牙空间技术能力的重大进步，展示了开发和集成空间运输和轨道运行关键技术的能力。通过将其 OTV 与其自己的 SAU&RON 24 分离系统相结合，UARX Space 强化了其航天器开发的集成方法，涵盖航天器本身及其部署到轨道所需的技术。

paras.en: OSSIE-D also highlights the importance of collaboration between specialized companies across the European space industry. For this mission, DHV Technology designed, qualified and manufactured the vehicle’s complete electrical power subsystem, including the solar arrays, Power Conditioning and Distribution Unit (PCDU), main battery modules, SADA (Solar Array Drive Assembly) and additional supporting subsystems required to meet the mission’s power requirements.
paras.zh: OSSIE-D 还强调了欧洲航天工业专业公司之间合作的重要性。对于此次任务，DHV Technology 设计、鉴定和制造了车辆的完整电力子系统，包括太阳能电池阵列、功率调节和配电单元 (PCDU)、主电池模块、SADA（太阳能阵列驱动组件）以及满足任务电力要求所需的其他支持子系统。

paras.en: “OSSIE-D represents a milestone for the Spanish aerospace industry and shows how collaboration between companies with complementary capabilities can turn ambitious missions into reality. DHV Technology has been a key partner, with its expertise, highly reliable solutions and team commitment making a significant contribution to the mission’s energy capabilities. This partnership also highlights the potential of the Spanish space sector to innovate and compete at both European and global level,” said Dr. Andrés Villa, CTO and Co-Founder of UARX Space.
paras.zh: UARX Space 首席技术官兼联合创始人 Andrés Villa 博士表示：“OSSIE-D 代表了西班牙航空航天业的一个里程碑，展示了具有互补能力的公司之间的合作如何能够将雄心勃勃的任务变为现实。DHV Technology 一直是关键合作伙伴，其专业知识、高度可靠的解决方案和团队承诺为任务的能源能力做出了重大贡献。这种合作伙伴关系还凸显了西班牙航天部门在欧洲和全球层面的创新和竞争潜力。”

paras.en: Following launch, DHV Technology’s electrical power subsystem is operating nominally in orbit, starting from the generation of the power with the solar arrays, control and distribution with the PCDU and storage with the battery, including initial telemetry which confirms that the system is performing as expected. This represents an important milestone for DHV Technology’s engineering team and for the OSSIE-D mission as a whole.
paras.zh: 发射后，DHV Technology 的电力子系统名义上在轨道上运行，从太阳能电池阵列发电、PCDU 控制和分配以及电池存储开始，包括确认系统按预期运行的初始遥测。这对于 DHV Technology 的工程团队和整个 OSSIE-D 任务来说是一个重要的里程碑。

paras.en: “Seeing the full electrical power subsystem fully developed by DHV for OSSIE-D operating as expected in orbit is an important milestone for our team and for our collaboration with UARX Space,” said Dr. Vicente Díaz, Managing Director and Co-Founder of DHV Technology. “This achievement reflects the close cooperation between both engineering teams and the work invested throughout the design, manufacturing, testing and integration phases. We are proud to contribute to this mission and look forward to OSSIE-D continuing to deliver positive results for UARX Space and all the partners involved.”
paras.zh: DHV Technology 董事总经理兼联合创始人 Vicente Díaz 博士表示：“看到 DHV 完全开发的用于 OSSIE-D 的完整电力子系统在轨道上按预期运行，对于我们的团队以及我们与 UARX Space 的合作来说是一个重要的里程碑。” “这一成就反映了两个工程团队之间的密切合作以及在整个设计、制造、测试和集成阶段所投入的工作。我们很自豪能为这一任务做出贡献，并期待 OSSIE-D 继续为 UARX Space 和所有相关合作伙伴带来积极的成果。”

paras.en: Beyond supplying the electrical power subsystem, DHV Technology is using OSSIE-D as a platform to test innovative technological concepts in orbit. The results obtained during the mission will help increase the technological maturity of several of the company’s solutions, extending the value of the mission beyond its immediate operational objectives. These developments include novel electrical interconnection methods, improved solar panel deployment and hinge mechanisms, as well as advanced photovoltaic technologies.
paras.zh: 除了提供电力子系统之外，DHV Technology 还使用 OSSIE-D 作为在轨测试创新技术概念的平台。任务期间获得的结果将有助于提高公司多个解决方案的技术成熟度，使任务的价值超出其直接运营目标。这些发展包括新颖的电气互连方法、改进的太阳能电池板部署和铰链机构以及先进的光伏技术。

paras.en: The collaboration between UARX Space and DHV Technology underscores the importance of combining specialized engineering capabilities to deliver increasingly advanced space missions. While UARX Space leads the development of the OTV and its deployment architecture, DHV Technology’s electrical power subsystem provides a critical element for the vehicle’s operation while enabling the evaluation of new technologies under real space operating conditions.
paras.zh: UARX Space 和 DHV Technology 之间的合作强调了结合专业工程能力来交付日益先进的太空任务的重要性。虽然 UARX Space 引领 OTV 及其部署架构的开发，但 DHV Technology 的电力子系统为车辆的运行提供了关键要素，同时能够在真实的空间运行条件下评估新技术。

paras.en: OSSIE-D therefore represents progress on two fronts: it strengthens UARX Space’s capabilities and position in the in-space transportation sector, while providing an opportunity to validate technologies that could support future missions. The combination of an OTV developed in Spain, a proprietary separation system and a complete electrical power subsystem supplied by DHV Technology demonstrates the potential of Spain’s space industry to deliver increasingly complex technological projects.
paras.zh: 因此，OSSIE-D 代表了两个方面的进展：它增强了 UARX Space 在太空运输领域的能力和地位，同时提供了验证可支持未来任务的技术的机会。西班牙开发的 OTV、专有的分离系统和 DHV Technology 提供的完整电力子系统的结合展示了西班牙航天工业交付日益复杂的技术项目的潜力。
