Scientists have now made an important advance in understanding barium titanate (BTO), a promising material that could help improve the performance of future devices that transmit information using light.
paras.zh: 光可以携带大量信息，但开发更快、更高效的光通信系统需要精确控制光的传播方式。科学家们现在在了解钛酸钡（BTO）方面取得了重要进展，钛酸钡是一种很有前途的材料，可以帮助提高未来利用光传输信息的设备的性能。

paras.en: A research team led by KAIST has uncovered detailed information about how light moves through BTO and how much of it the material absorbs. These properties have been difficult to measure accurately for decades because of the crystal's complicated internal structure. The new findings provide engineers with a more reliable foundation for designing optical devices that minimize signal loss and support faster data transmission.
paras.zh: 由韩国科学技术院领导的一个研究小组发现了有关光如何穿过 BTO 以及材料吸收了多少的详细信息。由于晶体内部结构复杂，这些特性几十年来一直难以准确测量。新发现为工程师提供了更可靠的基础来设计光学设备，最大限度地减少信号损失并支持更快的数据传输。

paras.en: KAIST (President Choongsik Bae) announced the results on November 8. The research was led by Professor Min Seok Jang of KAIST's School of Electrical Engineering, working with Professor Harry A. Atwater's group at the California Institute of Technology (Caltech), the Korea Research Institute of Standards and Science (KRISS), and U.S.-based J.A. Woollam Co. Together, the researchers examined how BTO interacts with light across wavelengths extending from the ultraviolet to the far-infrared.
paras.zh: 韩国科学技术院（校长 Bae Choongsik）于 11 月 8 日公布了研究结果。这项研究由韩国科学技术院电气工程学院 Min Seok Jang 教授领导，与加州理工学院 (Caltech) 的 Harry A. Atwater 教授团队、韩国标准与科学研究所 (KRISS) 和美国 J.A. Woollam Co. 的研究人员共同研究了 BTO 如何与从紫外线到远红外线波长范围内的光相互作用。

paras.en: Why Barium Titanate Could Transform Optical Communications
paras.zh: 为什么钛酸钡可以改变光通信

paras.en: One of BTO's most valuable characteristics is its ability to change how it affects light when electricity is applied. This behavior, called the Pockels effect, gives the material a strong electro-optic response and makes it especially attractive for optical modulators. These components convert electrical information into signals carried by light, making them important building blocks for advanced communication systems.
paras.zh: BTO 最有价值的特性之一是它能够在通电时改变其对光的影响。这种称为普克尔斯效应的行为使材料具有很强的电光响应，使其对光调制器特别有吸引力。这些组件将电信息转换为光携带的信号，使其成为先进通信系统的重要构建模块。

paras.en: However, producing reliable devices requires a detailed understanding of two fundamental optical properties. The refractive index describes how light travels through a material, while the extinction coefficient indicates how strongly the material absorbs it. Engineers need both measurements to predict how light will behave inside a waveguide, a structure designed to direct light along a specific path, and how much of the optical signal may be lost.
paras.zh: 然而，生产可靠的器件需要详细了解两个基本光学特性。折射率描述了光如何穿过材料，而消光系数则表示材料吸收光的强度。工程师需要这两种测量来预测光在波导（一种设计用于沿着特定路径引导光的结构）内的行为，以及可能丢失多少光信号。

paras.en: Getting consistent measurements from BTO has been surprisingly challenging. The material can contain multiple microscopic regions, called domains, in which the crystal structure points in different directions. Because these regions interact with light differently, measurements of an entire sample can combine several distinct responses. This has contributed to widely conflicting reports of BTO's optical properties over many decades.
paras.zh: 从 BTO 获得一致的测量结果非常具有挑战性。该材料可以包含多个微观区域，称为域，其中晶体结构指向不同的方向。由于这些区域与光的相互作用不同，因此整个样品的测量可以结合几种不同的响应。这导致了几十年来关于 BTO 光学特性的广泛相互矛盾的报道。

paras.en: Solving a Decades-Old Mystery About Light
paras.zh: 解开数十年之久的光之谜

paras.en: To overcome this problem, the researchers used a sophisticated measurement method known as Mueller matrix spectroscopic ellipsometry. The technique examines how the polarization of light changes when light reflects from or passes through a material, allowing scientists to investigate its optical behavior in detail.
paras.zh: 为了克服这个问题，研究人员使用了一种复杂的测量方法，称为穆勒矩阵光谱椭圆光度术。该技术检查当光从材料反射或穿过材料时光的偏振如何变化，使科学家能够详细研究其光学行为。

paras.en: Rather than relying on crystals containing a complicated mixture of differently oriented regions, the team studied two types of single-crystal samples with relatively consistent domain orientations. This approach helped minimize overlapping optical responses and allowed the researchers to identify the material's underlying properties more accurately.
paras.zh: 该团队没有依赖包含不同取向区域的​​复杂混合物的晶体，而是研究了两种具有相对一致的畴取向的单晶样品。这种方法有助于最大限度地减少重叠的光学响应，并使研究人员能够更准确地识别材料的基本特性。

paras.en: Their measurements spanned wavelengths from 190 nanometers (nm) to 40 micrometers (μm), covering an exceptionally broad range of light from ultraviolet to far-infrared. Since a material's optical behavior changes with wavelength, the scientists divided the spectrum into three regions and applied a different analytical approach to each. This revealed how BTO's refractive index and light absorption depend on both wavelength and crystal orientation.
paras.zh: 他们的测量跨越 190 纳米 (nm) 到 40 微米 (μm) 的波长，涵盖从紫外线到远红外线的极其广泛的光范围。由于材料的光学行为随波长而变化，科学家将光谱分为三个区域，并对每个区域应用不同的分析方法。这揭示了 BTO 的折射率和光吸收如何取决于波长和晶体方向。

paras.en: The researchers also investigated a particularly important range in which BTO allows nearly all incoming light to pass through. By combining ellipsometry with separate measurements of light transmission, they detected extremely low absorption, determining extinction coefficients of approximately 10-5 in the 2-10 μm wavelength range. These precise values will help engineers estimate how much light is lost as it travels through or remains confined within optical components.
paras.zh: 研究人员还研究了一个特别重要的范围，BTO 允许几乎所有入射光通过。通过将椭圆光度法与单独的光透射测量相结合，他们检测到极低的吸收，确定 2-10 μm 波长范围内的消光系数约为 10-5。这些精确的值将帮助工程师估计有多少光在穿过光学元件或被限制在光学元件内时损失了多少。

paras.en: In another advance, the team developed a way to predict the combined optical behavior of crystals containing multiple domains. Their method uses the orientations of those domains and the proportion of the crystal occupied by each to calculate the material's overall response to light.
paras.zh: 在另一项进展中，该团队开发了一种方法来预测包含多个域的晶体的组合光学行为。他们的方法使用这些域的方向以及每个域占据的晶体比例来计算材料对光的整体响应。

paras.en: Opening the Door to Faster Data Transmission and Quantum Technology
paras.zh: 打开更快的数据传输和量子技术的大门

paras.en: The results could make the development of future optical devices more predictable and efficient. With accurate information about BTO's behavior, engineers can model how light will travel through components of different shapes and dimensions before manufacturing them. They can also better estimate absorption losses, potentially reducing the need for repeated prototypes, costly redesigns, and extensive testing.
paras.zh: 研究结果可以使未来光学设备的开发更加可预测和高效。有了有关 BTO 行为的准确信息，工程师可以在制造之前对光如何穿过不同形状和尺寸的组件进行建模。他们还可以更好地估计吸收损失，从而有可能减少重复原型、昂贵的重新设计和广泛测试的需要。

paras.en: The potential benefits extend beyond conventional optical communications. BTO could also play an important role in devices that produce light at different wavelengths, as well as photonic circuits that use light to process quantum information. Such technologies depend on controlling light with exceptional precision.
paras.zh: 潜在的好处超出了传统的光通信范围。 BTO 还可以在产生不同波长光的设备以及使用光处理量子信息的光子电路中发挥重要作用。此类技术依赖于以极高的精度控制光。

paras.en: "This study reveals the optical response of barium titanate, which had long remained unclear, and provides a reliable reference for how the material interacts with light," said Professor Min Seok Jang.
paras.zh: Min Seok Jang 教授表示：“这项研究揭示了长期以来一直不清楚的钛酸钡的光学响应，并为该材料如何与光相互作用提供了可靠的参考。”

paras.en: Jang also emphasized that the findings could contribute to optical communication devices capable of transmitting data faster while reducing light loss. The improved understanding of BTO may also support the development of quantum photonic technologies, where precise manipulation of light is essential.
paras.zh: Jang还强调，这些发现可能有助于光通信设备能够更快地传输数据，同时减少光损失。对 BTO 的进一步了解也可能支持量子光子技术的发展，其中光的精确操纵至关重要。

paras.en: The study was published online on October 20, 2026, in ACS Photonics. Jiwon Kang, a Ph.D. candidate in KAIST's School of Electrical Engineering, and Dr. Nina Hong of J.A. Woollam Co. served as co-first authors. Professors Min Seok Jang of KAIST and Harry A. Atwater of Caltech were the corresponding authors.
paras.zh: 该研究于 2026 年 10 月 20 日在线发表在 ACS Photonics 上。 Jiwon Kang，博士KAIST 电气工程学院的候选人和 J.A. 的 Nina Hong 博士Woollam Co. 担任共同第一作者。韩国科学技术院的 Min Seok Jang 教授和加州理工学院的 Harry A. Atwater 教授为通讯作者。

paras.en: Funding was provided through the Culture, Sports and Tourism R&D Program administered by the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA), with support from the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism; the Basic Science Research Program administered by the National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF), with support from the Ministry of Education; the Ministry of Science and ICT; and the U.S. Air Force Office of Scientific Research (AFOSR).
paras.zh: 在文化、体育和旅游部的支持下，韩国创意内容振兴院 (KOCCA) 管理的文化、体育和旅游研发计划提供了资金；韩国国家研究基金会 (NRF) 在教育部的支持下管理的基础科学研究计划；科学和信息通信技术部；和美国空军科学研究办公室 (AFOSR)。

paras.en: - Jiwon Kang, Nina Hong, Christopher M. Yi, Yun Su Go, Martin Thomaschewski, Hwi Je Woo, Prachi Thureja, Junghoon Jahng, Harry A. Atwater, Min Seok Jang. articles.title: Scientists say the human family tree may need a radical rewrite

paras.en: Scientists say the human family tree may need a radical rewrite
paras.zh: 科学家称人类家谱可能需要彻底改写

paras.en: - The human family tree may need a major overhaul. New research from Monash University challenges the traditional classification of our ancient ancestors, arguing that species such as Australopithecus and Paranthropus should be grouped within our own genus, Homo. As scientists uncover more fossils and analyze evolutionary relationships, the boundaries that once separated these ancient relatives are becoming increasingly difficult to defend.
paras.zh: - 人类家谱可能需要进行重大改革。莫纳什大学的新研究挑战了我们古代祖先的传统分类，认为南方古猿和傍人等物种应该归入我们自己的属中，即人属。随着科学家发现更多化石并分析进化关系，曾经分隔这些远古亲戚的界限变得越来越难以捍卫。

paras.en: The human family tree may be due for a major rewrite. New research from Monash University challenges the traditional way scientists classify our ancient ancestors, suggesting that several groups long considered separate from humans may actually belong within our own genus, Homo.
paras.zh: 人类家谱可能需要进行重大改写。莫纳什大学的新研究挑战了科学家对我们古代祖先的传统分类方式，表明一些长期被认为与人类分离的群体实际上可能属于我们自己的属，即人属。

paras.en: The study, published in the American Journal of Biological Anthropology, proposes a sweeping change to how we organize millions of years of human evolution. Its central argument is that all human species and their closely related fossil relatives from the past 4 to 5 million years should be classified within the genus Homo.
paras.zh: 这项发表在《美国生物人类学杂志》上的研究提出了对我们组织数百万年人类进化的方式进行彻底的改变。其核心论点是，过去 4 至 500 万年的所有人类物种及其密切相关的化石亲属都应归入人属。

paras.en: That would mean bringing groups such as Australopithecus and Paranthropus, which have traditionally been classified separately, into the same genus as modern humans. Although these ancient relatives differed considerably in appearance, anatomy, and behavior, the researchers argue that the evolutionary boundaries separating them are becoming increasingly difficult to justify.
paras.zh: 这意味着将传统上分开分类的南方古猿和傍人等群体纳入与现代人类相同的属中。尽管这些远古亲戚在外观、解剖结构和行为上存在很大差异，但研究人员认为，区分它们的进化界限变得越来越难以证明。

paras.en: Why the Human Family Tree May Need to Be Redrawn
paras.zh: 为什么人类家谱可能需要重新绘制

paras.en: Human evolution is frequently illustrated as a relatively orderly progression, beginning with ancestors that resembled apes and gradually moving through species such as Australopithecus and early Homo before arriving at modern humans, Homo sapiens.
paras.zh: 人类进化经常被描述为一个相对有序的进程，从类似猿类的祖先开始，逐渐经过南方古猿和早期智人等物种，最后到达现代人类——智人。

paras.en: However, evolution did not unfold as a simple sequence in which one species neatly replaced another. Instead, the fossil evidence reveals a complicated family tree with numerous branches, overlapping species, and evolutionary relationships that scientists are still working to understand.
paras.zh: 然而，进化并不是按照一个物种巧妙地取代另一个物种的简单顺序展开的。相反，化石证据揭示了一个复杂的家谱，其中有许多分支、重叠的物种以及科学家仍在努力了解的进化关系。

paras.en: Each new fossil discovery can complicate that picture. Traits once believed to distinguish one group of ancient human relatives from another have increasingly been found across multiple groups, making it harder to determine where traditional classifications should begin and end.
paras.zh: 每一个新的化石发现都会使情况变得复杂。曾经被认为可以区分一组古代人类亲戚和另一组的特征现在越来越多地在多个群体中被发现，这使得确定传统分类应该从哪里开始和结束变得更加困难。

paras.en: Dr. Ian Towle, a Research Fellow at the Monash Biomedicine Discovery Institute and lead researcher on the study, argues that these discoveries are exposing weaknesses in the existing classification system. This applies not only to species already assigned to Homo, but also to members of Australopithecus and Paranthropus, groups that lived during the past 5 million years.
paras.zh: 莫纳什生物医学发现研究所研究员、该研究的首席研究员 Ian Towle 博士认为，这些发现暴露了现有分类系统的弱点。这不仅适用于已归属于人属的物种，也适用于生活在过去 500 万年里的南方古猿和傍人族的成员。

paras.en: "Recent fossil discoveries and advances in evolutionary and genetic analysis make this an ideal time to reconsider whether our traditional taxonomy still accurately reflects human evolution," Dr. Towle said.
paras.zh: “最近的化石发现以及进化和遗传分析方面的进展使现在成为重新考虑我们的传统分类学是否仍然准确反映人类进化的理想时机，”托尔博士说。

paras.en: "These groups do not necessarily represent distinct evolutionary branches, or 'clades', and differences in behavior and ecology once used to distinguish them have also become increasingly difficult to maintain.
paras.zh: “这些群体不一定代表不同的进化分支或‘进化枝’，曾经用来区分它们的行为和生态差异也变得越来越难以维持。

paras.en: "I propose expanding Homo to include these other groups to provide a more accurate and stable way to represent the complex evolutionary relationships revealed by the growing fossil record."
paras.zh: “我建议扩大人属的范围，将这些其他群体包括在内，以提供一种更准确、更稳定的方式来表示不断增长的化石记录所揭示的复杂进化关系。”

paras.en: How Scientists Classify Our Ancient Ancestors
paras.zh: 科学家如何对我们的古代祖先进行分类

paras.en: To understand the proposed change, it helps to look at how scientists organize living and extinct organisms.
paras.zh: 为了理解拟议的改变，了解科学家如何组织现存和灭绝的生物体会有所帮助。

paras.en: The system is known as taxonomy, which involves naming species and arranging them into groups based on their characteristics and evolutionary relationships.
paras.zh: 该系统被称为分类学，涉及命名物种并根据其特征和进化关系将它们分组。

paras.en: A genus is one level of this system, sitting above the species level. Modern humans, for example, belong to the species Homo sapiens, with Homo identifying our genus and sapiens identifying our species.
paras.zh: 属是该系统的一个级别，位于物种级别之上。例如，现代人类属于智人（Homo sapiens），智人代表我们的属，智人代表我们的物种。

paras.en: Over the past 50 years, advances in evolutionary research have significantly changed how scientists approach classification. Rather than relying primarily on physical similarities, modern taxonomy increasingly seeks to organize species according to their actual evolutionary ancestry.
paras.zh: 过去 50 年来，进化研究的进步极大地改变了科学家进行分类的方式。现代分类学不再主要依赖于物理相似性，而是越来越多地寻求根据物种的实际进化祖先来组织物种。

paras.en: An important concept in this approach is the clade. A clade consists of a common ancestor and all of its descendants. By grouping organisms this way, scientists aim to produce classifications that accurately reflect the branches of the evolutionary tree.
paras.zh: 这种方法中的一个重要概念是进化枝。进化枝由共同的祖先及其所有后代组成。通过这种方式对生物体进行分组，科学家的目标是产生准确反映进化树分支的分类。

paras.en: This approach has become increasingly influential in biology over recent decades. However, Towle argues that the classification of our own evolutionary relatives has been slower to adopt these principles consistently.
paras.zh: 近几十年来，这种方法在生物学中的影响力越来越大。然而，托尔认为，我们自己的进化亲属的分类在一致地采用这些原则方面进展缓慢。

paras.en: Why Brain Size and Tool Use No Longer Define Humans
paras.zh: 为什么大脑大小和工具使用不再定义人类

paras.en: Traditionally, scientists have distinguished members of the genus Homo from other ancient human relatives using a combination of physical and behavioral characteristics.
paras.zh: 传统上，科学家通过结合身体和行为特征来区分人属成员和其他古代人类亲属。

paras.en: These have included relatively large brains, sophisticated tool use, and particular anatomical features associated with human evolution.
paras.zh: 其中包括相对较大的大脑、复杂的工具使用以及与人类进化相关的特定解剖特征。

paras.en: But discoveries over recent decades have challenged the reliability of those distinctions.
paras.zh: 但近几十年来的发现对这些区别的可靠性提出了挑战。

paras.en: Scientists have identified members of Homo with surprisingly small brains, demonstrating that a large brain was not necessarily a defining characteristic of every species in our genus.
paras.zh: 科学家们发现人属成员的大脑出奇地小，这表明大脑大并不一定是我们属中每个物种的决定性特征。

paras.en: At the same time, evidence suggests that species traditionally placed in Australopithecus and Paranthropus likely displayed more complex behaviors than researchers once assumed.
paras.zh: 与此同时，有证据表明，传统上属于南方古猿和傍人的物种可能表现出比研究人员曾经假设的更复杂的行为。

paras.en: Together, these findings have weakened the boundaries used to separate the three groups. Characteristics once thought to be exclusive to Homo may have been shared more widely among our ancient relatives.
paras.zh: 总之，这些发现削弱了区分这三个群体的界限。曾经被认为是人属独有的特征可能在我们的古代亲戚中更广泛地具有。

paras.en: As a result, determining which species belong within the human genus has become increasingly complicated. Towle argues that the problem may lie not with the fossil evidence, but with the classification system scientists are trying to fit it into.
paras.zh: 因此，确定哪些物种属于人类属变得越来越复杂。托尔认为，问题可能不在于化石证据，而在于科学家试图将其纳入的分类系统。

paras.en: A Radical Proposal for 5 Million Years of Human Evolution
paras.zh: 人类五百万年进化的激进提议

paras.en: Towle's proposed solution is to expand the genus Homo to include species currently classified as Australopithecus and Paranthropus.
paras.zh: 托尔提出的解决方案是扩大人属，将目前分类为南方古猿和傍人的物种包括在内。

paras.en: The idea is not that these ancient relatives were identical to modern humans or possessed all the traits associated with our species. Rather, the broader classification would recognize their evolutionary connections while still allowing scientists to distinguish among individual species.
paras.zh: 这个想法并不是说这些古代亲戚与现代人类相同或拥有与我们物种相关的所有特征。相反，更广泛的分类将认识到它们的进化联系，同时仍然允许科学家区分各个物种。

paras.en: Such a change could also make human taxonomy more stable. Instead of repeatedly revising the boundaries between major groups whenever new fossils are uncovered, scientists could use a broader genus that accommodates the diversity revealed by ongoing discoveries.
paras.zh: 这样的变化也可以使人类分类更加稳定。每当发现新化石时，科学家们不必反复修改主要类群之间的界限，而是可以使用更广泛的属来适应不断发现的多样性。

paras.en: The proposal represents a significant departure from traditional classifications, and it remains a scientific argument rather than an officially adopted change. Nevertheless, it highlights how much our understanding of human origins has evolved as new evidence has accumulated.
paras.zh: 该提案与传统分类有很大不同，它仍然是一个科学论据，而不是正式采用的改变。尽管如此，它凸显了随着新证据的积累，我们对人类起源的理解已经发生了多大的变化。

paras.en: "The more we learn about our ancestors and close fossil relatives, the more we realize how complex and non-linear our family tree is," Dr. Towle said.
paras.zh: “我们对我们的祖先和化石近亲了解得越多，我们就越意识到我们的家谱是多么复杂和非线性，”托尔博士说。

paras.en: "Expanding the Homo genus to also include species of Australopithecus and Paranthropus will allow us to account for differences without regularly reclassifying particular groups."
paras.zh: “将人属扩大到包括南方古猿和傍人种，将使我们能够解释差异，而无需定期对特定群体进行重新分类。”

paras.en: Ultimately, the research raises a fundamental question about how scientists define the human family. If the traits once used to separate our ancestors are not as distinctive as previously believed, the names and categories used to describe millions of years of human evolution may need to change along with our understanding of the past.
paras.zh: 最终，这项研究提出了一个关于科学家如何定义人类家庭的基本问题。如果曾经用来区分我们祖先的特征并不像以前认为的那样独特，那么用于描述数百万年人类进化的名称和类别可能需要随着我们对过去的理解而改变。

paras.en: Materials provided by Monash University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由莫纳什大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Ian Towle. Clades, Grades, and the Genus Problem: A Case for Revising Hominin Taxonomy. American Journal of Biological Anthropology, 2026; 190 (4) DOI: 10.1002/ajpa.70344
paras.zh: - 伊恩·托尔。进化枝、等级和属问题：修改古人类分类学的案例。美国生物人类学杂志，2026； 190 (4) DOI：10.1002/ajpa.70344

articles.title: As 'Star Trek: First Contact' turns 30, Director Jonathan Frakes reflects on his triumphant time-travel blockbuster (interview)
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: "Star Trek: First Contact" celebrates its 30th anniversary today, and the engaging sci-fi classic still looks fantastic three decades later. With the sad passing of its star, Patrick Stewart, last month, and "Star Trek's" milestone 60th birthday taking place in 2026, this is a bittersweet salute that also holds an extra special significance.
paras.zh: 今天，《星际迷航：第一次接触》迎来了它的 30 周年纪念，这部引人入胜的科幻经典在三十年后看起来仍然精彩。随着明星帕特里克·斯图尔特 (Patrick Stewart) 于上个月不幸去世，2026 年将迎来《星际迷航》里程碑式的 60 岁生日，这是一份苦乐参半的致敬，同时也具有额外的特殊意义。

paras.en: Directed by "The Next Generation's" Number One, Jonathan Frakes, in his feature film debut, "First Contact" consistently ranks as one of the finest "Star Trek" feature films among fans and critics, and those accolades are well deserved.
paras.zh: 《第一次接触》由“下一代”头号人物乔纳森·弗雷克斯执导，在他的故事片处女作中，一直被粉丝和评论家评为最优秀的《星际迷航》故事片之一，这些荣誉是当之无愧的。

paras.en: Based on a compelling screenplay by Brannon Braga and Ronald D. Moore, "First Contact" remains as bright and beautiful as ever, brimming with bravado, heart, horror, and heroism.
paras.zh: 根据布兰农·布拉加 (Brannon Braga) 和罗纳德·D·摩尔 (Ronald D. Moore) 的引人入胜的剧本改编，《第一次接触》一如既往地明亮美丽，充满了虚张声势、内心、恐怖和英雄主义。

paras.en: Not only was it a bona fide crowdpleaser when it was released by Paramount over Thanksgiving week on Nov. 22, 1996, but it was also a financial success for the studio, eventually pulling in a worldwide total of $212 million off a modest $45 million budget.
paras.zh: 派拉蒙在 1996 年 11 月 22 日感恩节期间发行的这部影片不仅获得了真正的观众喜爱，而且也为工作室带来了财务上的成功，最终在 4500 万美元的适度预算中获得了 2.12 亿美元的全球票房收入。

paras.en: Honestly, who can forget Alice Krige's seductive Borg Queen, Marina Sirtis’ Deana Troi tipsy on tequila, Brent Spiner's Data feeling the sensation of human skin, Patrick Stewart’s Jean-Luc Picard reliving past traumas, and James Cromwell's Zephram Cochrane blasting off in the Phoenix and dancing to Roy Orbison's "Ooby Dooby"?
paras.zh: 老实说，谁能忘记爱丽丝·克里奇 (Alice Krige) 饰演的迷人博格女王、玛丽娜·瑟提斯 (Marina Sirtis) 饰演的喝着龙舌兰酒的迪安娜·特洛伊 (Deana Troi)、布伦特·斯皮纳 (Brent Spiner) 饰演的 Data 感受人类皮肤的感觉、帕特里克·斯图尔特 (Patrick Stewart) 饰演的让-吕克·皮卡德 (Jean-Luc Picard) 重温过去的创伤，以及詹姆斯·克伦威尔 (James Cromwell) 饰演的泽弗拉姆·科克伦 (Zephram Cochrane) 在凤凰城起飞并伴着罗伊·奥比森 (Roy Orbison) 的《Ooby Dooby》起舞？

paras.en: We caught up with Frakes for "First Contact's" 30th anniversary to hear why this "Trek" treasure holds up and warp back to Hollywood’s heyday of the '90s. Resistance is futile!
paras.zh: 我们在《第一次接触》上映 30 周年之际采访了弗雷克斯，听听这部《迷航》宝藏为何能经久不衰，并穿越回好莱坞 90 年代的鼎盛时期。反抗是徒劳的！

paras.en: "What’s not to love?" Frakes tells SPACE regarding the film’s lasting popularity. "It was bulletproof. Dean Devlin ["Stargate," "Independence Day"] and I have very similar sensibilities about filmmaking. We like the whole idea of action, adventure, comedy, and in the case of 'First Contact,' a little horror as well. ILM’s John Knoll, the guy who won the Oscar for 'Star Wars,' just happened to be our Special Effects Supervisor."
paras.zh: “什么是不爱？”弗雷克斯向《太空》讲述了这部电影的持久受欢迎程度。 “它是无懈可击的。迪恩·德夫林（《星际之门》、《独立日》）和我对电影制作有着非常相似的感受。我们喜欢动作、冒险、喜剧的整体理念，而《第一次接触》也有一点恐怖。工业光魔的约翰·诺尔，因《星球大战》获得奥斯卡奖的人，恰好是我们的特效总监。”

paras.en: "First Contact" is filled with memorable moments and indelible performances, some of which certainly stand out for Frakes looking back over the years on the production.
paras.zh: 《第一次接触》充满了令人难忘的时刻和不可磨灭的表演，其中一些对于弗雷克斯多年来的制作来说无疑是引人注目的。

paras.en: "The two things that always come to mind were the beautiful scene with Alfre [Woodard] and Patrick, the Moby Dick scene, where she says, 'You broke your little ships,'" he recalls. "I was sitting under the camera with my face in my hands, watching two heavyweights go at it take after take. It was what you dream of. They were into it. The writing was great. We had time to do it right, and they were fabulous together.
paras.zh: “我总是想到的两件事是阿尔法·伍德德和帕特里克的美丽场景，《白鲸记》的场景，她说，‘你弄坏了你的小船，’”他回忆道。 “我坐在摄像机下，双手捂着脸，看着两位重量级人物拍了一个又一个镜头。这就是你梦想的。他们很投入。剧本很棒。我们有时间把它做好，他们在一起太棒了。

paras.en: "That and the Cromwell and Marina drunk on tequila scene. It's not only one extended take, but it contributes to the pace of the movie in the right kind of way. My wife tells me that I was really good in that scene because I was exhausted and relaxed. It’s true, you’re exhausted when you’re filming and acting at the same time. I got to sit there and watch those two. It was like watching a tennis game."
paras.zh: “那个场景以及克伦威尔和玛丽娜喝醉了龙舌兰酒的场景。这不仅仅是一个长镜头，而且以正确的方式促进了电影的节奏。我的妻子告诉我，我在那个场景中表现得非常好，因为我既疲惫又放松。是的，当你同时拍摄和表演时，你会筋疲力尽。我必须坐在那里看这两个人。就像看一场网球比赛。”

paras.en: Many Trekkies might not know that Alfre Woodard is Frakes' godmother, and he had specifically asked producer Rick Berman for approval to include her in the movie’s cast.
paras.zh: 许多星际迷可能不知道阿尔法·伍达德是弗雷克斯的教母，他曾专门请求制片人里克·伯曼批准将她纳入电影演员阵容。

paras.en: "She's one of our finest American actors," he notes. "Rick said, 'If we can get Alfre, that would be great.' I knew she’d do great with Patrick, so that was a no-brainer. I never had a godmother, and when I came out here to live in LA back in 1979, an old friend from college, Nathan Cook, was working with Alfre. We were at a barbecue, and it came up. She said, 'You don’t have a godmother? I’ll be your godmother.' I asked what that meant, and she said, 'I’ll be in charge of your spiritual being.' It's been a magical friendship that turned into her playing that part."
paras.zh: “她是我们最优秀的美国演员之一，”他指出。 “里克说，‘如果我们能得到阿尔弗雷，那就太好了。’我知道她会和帕特里克相处得很好，所以这是理所当然的。我从来没有教母，当我 1979 年来到洛杉矶居住时，大学时的老朋友内森·库克 (Nathan Cook) 正在和阿尔弗雷一起工作。我们在烧烤时，它出现了。她说：‘你没有教母吗？我会成为你的教母。我问这是什么意思，她说：“我将负责你的精神存在。”正是一种神奇的友谊让她扮演了这个角色。”

paras.en: The hive-minded cybernetic collective known as the Borg featured prominently in the time-travel tale, and that second filming unit did a masterful job lighting those scenes.
paras.zh: 被称为博格的蜂群控制论集体在时间旅行故事中占据了显着位置，而第二个拍摄单位在照亮这些场景方面做得非常出色。

paras.en: "The Borg costumes were torture, from what I was told," says Frakes. "We had our own set of ADs and an entirely separate special effects makeup crew, and the costume department had a certain number of Borg to build and rebuild. Now the Borg had been on the show, but with these Borg we had more time and more moving parts. It was kind of an enhanced thing that really paid off. I look back so fondly on that entire experience. Also, the Borg were one of the great movie villains. They held up!"
paras.zh: “据我所知，博格服装是一种折磨，”弗雷克斯说。 “我们有自己的一套广告和完全独立的特效化妆团队，服装部门有一定数量的博格需要建造和重建。现在博格已经出现在节目中，但有了这些博格，我们有了更多的时间和更多的活动部件。这是一种真正得到回报的增强的东西。我非常深情地回顾整个经历。而且，博格是电影中最伟大的反派之一。他们坚持了下来！”

paras.en: Frakes couldn’t be prouder of "First Contact", and he reminds us that most people like it right next to 1982's "Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan." That's rarefied air indeed!
paras.zh: 弗雷克斯对《第一次接触》感到无比自豪，他提醒我们，大多数人都喜欢它，紧接着 1982 年的《星际迷航 II：可汗之怒》。这确实是稀薄的空气！

paras.en: "We got Cromwell coming off of 'Babe.' So we had Alfre and Alice and Cromwell. They joined our family effortlessly. Because we'd done seven TV seasons, 182 episodes, and a movie already together, we were thick as thieves and still are; may Patrick rest in peace. The three of them joined us as if we’d been dancing with them forever."
paras.zh: “我们让克伦威尔从《宝贝》中走出来。所以我们有阿尔弗雷、爱丽丝和克伦威尔。他们毫不费力地加入了我们的家庭。因为我们已经一起拍了 7 季电视剧、182 集和一部电影，所以我们就像小偷一样紧密，现在仍然如此；愿帕特里克安息。他们三个加入了我们，就好像我们永远和他们一起跳舞一样。”

paras.en: "Star Trek: First Contact" is available to stream on Paramount+.
paras.zh: 《星际迷航：第一次接触》可在 Paramount+ 上观看。

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

articles.title: This viral star projector has been hyped to Mars and back, but we hunted down the best version you can buy
articles.author: Chris McMullen

paras.en: A great value USB-powered projector that fits in your pocket, offering sharp but static space-themed images. It’s an ideal small gift for stargazers of all ages — just make sure you buy the right model and don’t believe the misleading AI adverts.
paras.zh: 一款超值的 USB 供电投影仪，可放入口袋中，提供清晰但静态的太空主题图像。对于所有年龄段的观星者来说，这是一份理想的小礼物——只要确保你购买了正确的型号，并且不要相信误导性的人工智能广告。

paras.en: Our expert reviewers spend hours testing and comparing products and services so you can choose the best for you. Find out more about how we test and review products.
paras.zh: 我们的专家评审员花费大量时间测试和比较产品和服务，以便您可以选择最适合您的产品和服务。详细了解我们如何测试和审查产品。

paras.en: It was only a matter of time, but AI has come for astronomy accessories. I’ve yet to see a fictional elderly craftsman begging you to buy his hand-carved telescopes; however, it has absolutely muddied the waters around this viral gooseneck Galaxy Projector Night Light.
paras.zh: 这只是时间问题，但人工智能已经出现在天文配件中。我还没见过一个虚构的老工匠恳求你买他手工雕刻的望远镜；然而，它绝对让这款病毒式鹅颈银河投影夜灯周围的水变得浑浊。

paras.en: The good news is that there is an impressive little star projector to be had here, and I’m here to cut through the AI-assisted hype. To make sure you’re not hoodwinked, I’ve done the online legwork to bring you the best version of this device, and it won’t cost you a fortune to put a planetarium in your pocket.
paras.zh: 好消息是，这里有一台令人印象深刻的小型星空投影仪，我来这里是为了打破人工智能辅助的炒作。为了确保您不被蒙蔽，我已经在网上进行了调查，为您带来了该设备的最佳版本，并且将天文馆放入口袋中不会花费您很多钱。

paras.en: Before we dive into what makes this Galaxy Projector Night Light so great, there are a couple of pressing issues to address. No variant of this USB-powered star projector will break up heated dinner arguments by casting a beautifully animated space whale on the ceiling, as one ridiculous AI-generated advert asserts. Its projections are eye-catching enough to entertain space fans young and old, but they’re strictly static.
paras.zh: 在我们深入探讨这款 Galaxy 投影仪夜灯为何如此出色之前，有几个紧迫的问题需要解决。正如一则可笑的人工智能生成的广告所声称的那样，这款 USB 供电的星空投影仪的任何变体都不会通过在天花板上投射出精美的动画太空鲸鱼来平息激烈的晚餐争论。它的投影足够引人注目，可以娱乐年轻和年老的太空迷，但它们是严格静态的。

paras.en: Also, while you might be tempted by the lure of 24 interchangeable slides, compared to this Galaxy Projector Night Light’s 13, this lesser model’s slide selection is a letdown. Not only are the slides smaller and blurrier than this model, a large number are dedicated to seasonal holidays. As much as I enjoy Christmas, if I had Santa’s colossal face gazing down at me from the ceiling I’d never sleep again.
paras.zh: 此外，虽然您可能会被 24 个可互换幻灯片的诱惑所吸引，但与这款 Galaxy 投影夜灯的 13 个可互换幻灯片相比，这款较小型号的幻灯片选择令人失望。这些幻灯片不仅比这个模型更小、更模糊，而且很多幻灯片都是专门针对季节性假期的。尽管我很享受圣诞节，但如果圣诞老人那张巨大的脸从天花板上俯视着我，我就再也睡不着了。

paras.en: Zanbix 2 in 1 Galaxy Projector Night Light review
paras.zh: Zanbix 2 合 1 Galaxy 投影仪夜灯评论

paras.en: I tempered my expectations when I first got my hands on the Galaxy Projector Night Light. Packed in a small, relatively unassuming box, it looks remarkably similar to the standard model that’s spread across TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and so on. Just like that one, it’s powered via USB, with a flexible stalk, a slot for slides and a nose-mounted focus wheel.
paras.zh: 当我第一次拿到 Galaxy 投影夜灯时，我降低了自己的期望。它装在一个相对不起眼​​的小盒子里，看起来与 TikTok、YouTube、Facebook 等平台上流行的标准型号非常相似。就像那个一样，它通过 USB 供电，配有一根灵活的柄、一个用于幻灯片的插槽和一个安装在鼻子上的对焦轮。

paras.en: However, once I hooked it up to a handy USB socket, all my reservations vanished, and I was seriously impressed by the power of this little projector. You’ll need a darkened room but the Galaxy Projector Night Light’s larger lens is a serious step-up from the run-of-the-mill version. Its images are richer and clearer than you’d expect from a projector this size, and easily capable of transforming a mid-sized ceiling or wall into a cosmic display.
paras.zh: 然而，一旦我把它连接到一个方便的 USB 插座上，我所有的保留意见都消失了，这台小投影仪的强大功能给我留下了深刻的印象。您需要一个黑暗的房间，但 Galaxy 投影夜灯的更大镜头比普通版本有了很大的进步。它的图像比您对这种尺寸的投影仪的期望更丰富、更清晰，并且能够轻松地将中型天花板或墙壁转变为宇宙显示器。

paras.en: This stunning James Webb Space Telescope image of the Pillars of Creation, with its vast columns of gas and dust, is a perfect example of the projections on offer. The fact the display was static didn’t diminish its wow factor, and I spent a good 15 minutes gazing at it in wonder.
paras.zh: 这张令人惊叹的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜拍摄的创世之柱图像及其巨大的气体和尘埃柱，是所提供投影的完美示例。显示屏是静态的这一事实并没有削弱它的令人惊叹的因素，我花了整整 15 分钟好奇地盯着它。

paras.en: The Galaxy Projector Night Light does have a four-hour shut-off in case you drift off or want to use it to lull a child to sleep (and 12 hours for its night light function). It’s easy to adjust thanks to its flexible neck, and while it never once came loose, you’ll find some USB ports have a tighter grip than others.
paras.zh: Galaxy 投影仪夜灯确实有四个小时的关闭时间，以防您昏昏欲睡或想用它来哄孩子入睡（夜灯功能可以关闭 12 小时）。由于其灵活的颈部，调节起来很容易，虽然它从来没有松动过，但您会发现一些 USB 端口比其他端口握得更紧。

paras.en: Once I set aside the images of Santa Claus (you’re staying in the box, Saint Nick), jellyfish and a T. rex, I was left with 10 astronomy-related slides. Several, such as the black hole, are artistic illustrations, while others, like the aforementioned Pillars, are actual astronomical images.
paras.zh: 一旦我把圣诞老人（你住在盒子里，圣尼克）、水母和霸王龙的图像放在一边，我就剩下 10 张与天文学相关的幻灯片。其中一些，例如黑洞，是艺术插图，而另一些，例如前面提到的支柱，则是实际的天文图像。

paras.en: They all have their own distinct appeal. I wouldn’t, for example, describe the black hole slide as relaxing, but it’s absolutely captivating in a cosmic horror way. I’d have appreciated an auto-rotate option, but that would have added some bulk to the projector.
paras.zh: 它们都有自己独特的吸引力。例如，我不会将黑洞滑梯描述为令人放松，但它绝对以一种宇宙恐怖的方式令人着迷。我希望有自动旋转选项，但这会增加投影仪的体积。

paras.en: Switching slides is a breeze, each image mounted in its own slide holder. Oddly, a couple of mine had hair-like marks, but those disappeared when I brought the image into focus via the nose wheel.
paras.zh: 切换幻灯片轻而易举，每个图像都安装在自己的幻灯片支架中。奇怪的是，我的几个有头发状的痕迹，但当我通过前轮将图像聚焦时，这些痕迹就消失了。

paras.en: It’s mildly disappointing that there aren’t extra slide packs out there, but the selection is ample for entertainment, relaxation and even education. What better way to spark an interest in STEM than with the wonders of space?
paras.zh: 有点令人失望的是，没有额外的幻灯片包，但选择足够用于娱乐、放松甚至教育。还有什么比太空奇观更好地激发人们对 STEM 的兴趣呢？

paras.en: The Galaxy Projector Night Light will run off any USB port: a laptop, desktop, charger and so on. I even got it working with my TV’s USB socket, but the real bonus was realizing I could run it off the best power banks. If you’re on the move, slip the projector and slides into one pocket, a powerbank into another, and you’re good to go for hours.
paras.zh: Galaxy 投影仪夜灯可通过任何 USB 端口运行：笔记本电脑、台式机、充电器等。我什至让它可以与电视的 USB 插座配合使用，但真正的好处是我意识到我可以使用最好的移动电源来运行它。如果您在旅途中，请将投影仪滑入一个口袋，将充电宝滑入另一个口袋，这样您就可以出门几个小时了。

paras.en: Some of the best star projectors are styled so they blend in with a room, but this one is so small you can just pack it away until you need it. The projector’s marketing even advertises it for use in the car, which seems like an accident waiting to happen. Only the Blisslights Starport is smaller, but then you’re limited to laser-dot stars.
paras.zh: 一些最好的明星投影仪的设计使其能够与房间融为一体，但这款投影仪非常小，您可以将其收起来，直到需要时再使用。该投影仪的营销甚至宣传其可在汽车中使用，这似乎是一场即将发生的事故。只有极乐星港较小，但你只能看到激光点星。

paras.en: There’s no remote and no sound options, but the Galaxy Projector Night Light is so easy to use that children should be able to get to grips with it. Literally, in fact, since while the light portion warms up, it never really gets hot. Factor in its small size and pocket-friendly price, and it’s an ideal space gift or stocking stuffer for a young stargazer.
paras.zh: 没有遥控器，也没有声音选项，但 Galaxy 投影仪夜灯非常易于使用，孩子们应该能够掌握它。事实上，从字面上看，虽然光部分变暖，但它永远不会真正变热。考虑到其体积小、价格实惠，它是年轻观星者的理想太空礼物或圣诞礼物。

paras.en: As long as you don’t buy the hype and think you’re getting something that’ll bathe a room in beautifully animated starscapes, as several Amazon purchasers did, you’ll find this Galaxy Projector Night Light is a surprisingly capable little star projector.
paras.zh: 只要你不相信炒作，并认为你得到的东西能让房间沐浴在美丽的动画星空中，就像一些亚马逊购买者所做的那样，你会发现这款银河投影仪夜灯是一款功能惊人的小型星空投影仪。

paras.en: Are there bigger and better models out there? Yes, and we’ve rounded up the best star projectors if this one isn’t for you. But for convenience, value for money and portability, this Galaxy Projector Night Light is a great way to bring the cosmos into your home and it’s fast cemented itself as one of my favorites.
paras.zh: 有没有更大更好的型号？是的，如果这款投影仪不适合您，我们已经收集了最好的明星投影仪。但出于方便、物有所值和便携性的考虑，这款 Galaxy 投影仪夜灯是将宇宙带入家中的绝佳方式，并且它很快就成为我的最爱之一。

paras.en: Chris is a freelance journalist who, aside from covering games and gaming-related tech, has a taste for horror, sci-fi and the post-apocalyptic. As well as Space.com, you can find his work at GameSpew (where he’s the weekend editor) and more. You can follow him on Twitter @MarmaladeBus.
paras.zh: 克里斯是一名自由记者，除了报道游戏和游戏相关技术外，还对恐怖、科幻和后世界末日感兴趣。除了 Space.com，您还可以在 GameSpew（他是周末编辑）等网站上找到他的作品。您可以在 Twitter 上关注他@MarmaladeBus。

articles.title: SpaceX sends classified US spy satellites to orbit in early-morning launch from California coast (video)
articles.author: Josh Dinner

paras.en: SpaceX launched a batch of classified satellites this morning (Nov. 22), on the NROL-136 mission out of California.
paras.zh: 今天早上（11 月 22 日），SpaceX 在加州发射了 NROL-136 任务中的一批机密卫星。

paras.en: A Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from Vandenberg Space Force Base's Launch Complex-4E at 7:23 a.m. ET (1223 GMT; 4:23 a.m. local time in California). It was the sixth National Reconnaissance Office launch (NROL) this year to deliver a payload, or group of payloads, to low Earth orbit, all which have been carried out by SpaceX's workhorse Falcon 9.
paras.zh: 美国东部时间上午 7 点 23 分（格林尼治标准时间 1223；加利福尼亚州当地时间凌晨 4 点 23 分），一枚猎鹰 9 号火箭从范登堡太空部队基地的 4E 号发射场升空。这是美国国家侦察局 (NROL) 今年第六次向近地轨道发射一个或一组有效载荷，所有这些都是由 SpaceX 的主力猎鹰 9 号火箭完成的。

paras.en: The launch marks another step in the NRO's effort to expand its intelligence-gathering capabilities through a proliferated network of spacecraft designed to provide more frequent and timely surveillance of locations around the globe.
paras.zh: 这次发射标志着国家侦察局通过不断扩大的航天器网络扩大其情报收集能力的又一步，该网络旨在对全球各地进行更频繁、更及时的监视。

paras.en: About two minutes after liftoff, the Falcon 9's first-stage booster separated from the rocket's upper stage, which continued carrying the classified payloads onward to orbit. The booster then reversed course and returned to Vandenberg, touching down at Landing Zone 4 approximately seven and a half minutes after launch.
paras.zh: 升空大约两分钟后，猎鹰 9 号的第一级助推器与火箭的上级分离，后者继续将机密有效载荷送入轨道。随后助推器改变航线并返回范登堡，在发射后大约七分半钟降落在 4 号着陆区。

paras.en: Saturday's launch was the 14th flight for this particular Falcon 9 booster, dubbed B1097, which previously launched NASA's Sentinel-6B ocean-monitoring satellite, NROL-172, USSF-259 for the U.S. Space Force, and eight Starlink missions.
paras.zh: 周六的发射是猎鹰 9 号助推器的第 14 次飞行，该助推器被称为 B1097，此前曾发射过 NASA 的 Sentinel-6B 海洋监测卫星、NROL-172、美国太空军的 USSF-259 以及八次星链任务。

paras.en: NROL-136 is the 15th launch dedicated to building the NRO's "proliferated architecture," the satellites for which have been developed in partnership with SpaceX and Northrop Grumman. The network is designed to increase coverage and improve the "capability and resilience" of U.S. intelligence operations in space, according to the NRO's mission website.
paras.zh: NROL-136 是第 15 次发射，致力于构建 NRO 的“增殖架构”，其卫星是与 SpaceX 和诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司合作开发的。 NRO 任务网站称，该网络旨在扩大覆盖范围并提高美国太空情报行动的“能力和弹性”。

paras.en: The NRO began deploying the constellation in May 2024 with the launch of NROL-146. The most recent proliferated architecture mission before Sunday was NROL-179, which lifted off on June 19, 2026.
paras.zh: 随着 NROL-146 的发射，NRO 于 2024 年 5 月开始部署该星座。周日之前最近一次激增的建筑任务是 NROL-179，于 2026 年 6 月 19 日升空。

paras.en: As with any classified mission, the agency has not disclosed the exact number of satellites aboard NROL-136 or revealed details about their onboard technologies.
paras.zh: 与任何机密任务一样，该机构没有透露 NROL-136 上卫星的确切数量，也没有透露其机载技术的详细信息。

paras.en: Josh Dinner is Space.com's Spaceflight Staff Writer and a photographer with a passion for science and exploration. He has worked the space beat since 2016, covering the evolution of NASA's commercial spaceflight partnerships and crewed missions, planetary science missions, the Artemis program and humanity's return to the moon. He also enjoys building 1:144-scale model rockets and spacecraft. Find some of Josh's launch photography on Instagram, and follow him on X, where he mostly posts in haiku.
paras.zh: 乔什·丁纳 (Joshdinner) 是 Space.com 的 Spaceflight 特约撰稿人，也是一位热衷于科学和探索的摄影师。自 2016 年以来，他一直致力于太空领域的研究，报道了 NASA 商业航天合作伙伴关系和载人任务、行星科学任务、阿尔忒弥斯计划和人类重返月球的演变。他还喜欢建造 1:144 比例的火箭和航天器模型。在 Instagram 上查找 Josh 的一些首发照片，并在 X 上关注他，他主要在 X 上发布俳句。

articles.title: SpaceNukes Opens Los Alamos Manufacture and Materials Facility to Build Its Next-Generation Space Reactor
articles.author: Space Nuclear Power Corporation

paras.en: LOS ALAMOS, N.M., Nov. 16, 2026 — Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) opened its Manufacture and Materials Development Facility at 150 Central Park Square in Los Alamos on Nov. 13. The facility is dedicated to manufacture and materials development for the company’s Generation 2 reactor, including additive manufacturing of nickel-based and refractory alloys. No radioactive material is handled in the facility.
paras.zh: 新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，2026 年 11 月 16 日 — Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) 于 11 月 13 日在洛斯阿拉莫斯中央公园广场 150 号开设了制造和材料开发设施。该设施致力于该公司第二代反应堆的制造和材料开发，包括镍基和耐火合金的增材制造。该设施内不处理任何放射性物质。

paras.en: SpaceNukes’ next-generation reactor is designed to run much hotter. A hotter reactor needs a much smaller radiator, which makes up most of the mass of a space fission power system. Raising the temperature at which heat is rejected lets the same-size radiator shed roughly six times as much heat. The limit is not the nuclear physics but the materials. Today’s power conversion hardware already sits at the edge of what nickel-based superalloys tolerate over a long mission, so going hotter means moving to refractory alloys of tungsten, molybdenum, tantalum, rhenium and niobium. These metals are difficult to form, and many of the component shapes and materials SpaceNukes needs cannot be bought from any supplier.
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 的下一代反应堆设计为运行温度更高。更热的反应堆需要更小的散热器，它构成了空间裂变动力系统的大部分质量。提高散热温度可以让相同尺寸的散热器散发出大约六倍的热量。限制不是核物理而是材料。当今的电力转换硬件已经处于镍基高温合金长期任务承受能力的边缘，因此变得更热意味着转向钨、钼、钽、铼和铌的难熔合金。这些金属很难成型，而且 SpaceNukes 所需的许多部件形状和材料无法从任何供应商处购买。

paras.en: “Our next-generation reactor is a bet on temperature,” said Andrew Phelps, CEO of SpaceNukes. “What stands between us and that is not the nuclear physics. The physics is in good shape, and it was proven in 2018. The limit is metal. Our next reactor is a materials and manufacturing challenge before it is a reactor problem, and that is what this building is for.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席执行官安德鲁·菲尔普斯 (Andrew Phelps) 表示：“我们的下一代反应堆押注于温度。” “阻碍我们的不是核物理学。物理学状况良好，并在 2018 年得到了证明。限制是金属。我们的下一个反应堆在成为反应堆问题之前首先是材料和制造挑战，而这就是这座建筑的用途。”

paras.en: The facility is led by Omar Mireles, director of manufacture and materials, who heads the Generation 2 program. Mireles spent 13 years as a research engineer and principal investigator at NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center, where he led the $25 million Refractory Alloy Additive Manufacturing Build Optimization project.
paras.zh: 该工厂由制造和材料总监 Omar Mireles 领导，他也是第二代项目的负责人。 Mireles 在 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心担任了 13 年的研究工程师和首席研究员，领导了价值 2500 万美元的耐火合金增材制造构建优化项目。

paras.en: “Additive manufacturing is used only for specific circumstances,” Mireles said. “You have parts that are highly complex, made from materials that are difficult to form, have a low production rate that won’t benefit from economy of scale, and have the design flexibility that can optimize designs to the manufacturing process. These lessons were learned over the last two decades in the liquid rocket engine community, and we are applying them to the needs of SpaceNukes, which have very similar conditions. We are manufacturing aerospace components at aerospace-quality standards. This building is where we learn to make them.”
paras.zh: “增材制造仅用于特定情况，”米雷莱斯说。 “零件高度复杂，由难以成型的材料制成，生产率低，无法从规模经济中受益，并且具有可以优化制造过程设计的设计灵活性。这些经验教训是液体火箭发动机界在过去二十年中吸取的经验教训，我们正在将它们应用于具有非常相似条件的 SpaceNukes 的需求。我们正在按照航空航天质量标准制造航空航天部件。这座建筑是我们学习制造它们的地方。”

paras.en: The Los Alamos facility complements SpaceNukes’ integration and test facility in Medina, Ohio, led by chief engineer Marc Gibson. SpaceNukes is now building hardware to test components for its Generation 2 reactors at the Ohio facility.
paras.zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯工厂补充了 SpaceNukes 位于俄亥俄州麦地那的集成和测试工厂，该工厂由总工程师马克·吉布森 (Marc Gibson) 领导。 SpaceNukes 目前正在俄亥俄州工厂建造硬件来测试其第二代反应堆的组件。

paras.en: The grand opening featured remarks from Phelps and Mireles, a ribbon cutting and tours of the new facility. Guests included staff from the office of Sen. Martin Heinrich, D-N.M.; Los Alamos National Laboratory and its Feynman Center for Innovation; the Los Alamos County Council; the Los Alamos County Community Development Department; the Los Alamos Commerce & Development Corp.; the Los Alamos Chamber of Commerce; Century Bank; Merrill Lynch; and space industry partners.
paras.zh: 菲尔普斯和米雷莱斯在盛大的开幕式上致辞，并剪彩并参观了新设施。嘉宾包括新墨西哥州民主党参议员马丁·海因里希 (Martin Heinrich) 办公室的工作人员；洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室及其费曼创新中心；洛斯阿拉莫斯县议会；洛斯阿拉莫斯县社区发展部；洛斯阿拉莫斯商业发展公司；洛斯阿拉莫斯商会；世纪银行；美林；以及航天工业合作伙伴。

paras.en: The facility opening follows SpaceNukes’ Oct. 21 announcement of an agreement with the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, under its Fast Capacitance (Fat Cat) program, to design, build and ground-test an actively controlled Kilopower reactor with Los Alamos National Laboratory. It comes as SpaceNukes works to fly a nuclear reactor by 2028.
paras.zh: 该设施开业之前，SpaceNukes 于 10 月 21 日宣布与国防高级研究计划局达成协议，根据其快速电容 (Fat Cat) 计划，与洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室一起设计、建造和地面测试主动控制 Kilopower 反应堆。 SpaceNukes 正致力于在 2028 年之前飞行一座核反应堆。

paras.en: Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) builds nuclear reactors that power missions in space for government and commercial clients. In March 2018, the team that is now SpaceNukes ran a space reactor at full temperature and power for 28 hours, and it performed as predicted. It was the first time this had been done in the United States in 50 years. The team took it from concept to full power in three years for less than $20 million. Today, SpaceNukes has roughly 15 full-time employees, more than $50 million in contracts and agreements with the Department of War and NASA, two completed Space Force design reviews and a Los Alamos National Laboratory license for the reactor technology its founders invented there. Space Nuclear Power Corp., headquartered in Los Alamos, New Mexico, is committed to delivering safe, affordable, reliable nuclear power wherever people and machines go in space.
paras.zh: 太空核动力公司 (SpaceNukes) 建造核反应堆，为政府和商业客户的太空任务提供动力。 2018 年 3 月，SpaceNukes 团队在全温度和全功率下运行了一个空间反应堆 28 小时，其性能符合预期。这是美国 50 年来首次这样做。该团队用了不到 2000 万美元的时间，在三年内将其从概念转变为全面发挥作用。如今，SpaceNukes 拥有大约 15 名全职员工，与战争部和 NASA 签订了价值超过 5000 万美元的合同和协议，完成了两项太空部队设计审查，并为其创始人在洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室发明的反应堆技术获得了许可证。太空核电公司总部位于新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，致力于为人类和机器进入太空的任何地方提供安全、负担得起、可靠的核电。

paras.en: Andrew Phelps, CEO, Space Nuclear Power Corp.
paras.zh: 安德鲁·菲尔普斯 (Andrew Phelps)，太空核电公司首席执行官

articles.title: Origami and solar arrays
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode of SpaceMinds, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss talks with Thomas Sinn, the CEO of Dcubed, at Space Tech Expo Europe. They discuss the company’s new $30 million funding round, how to think of solar arrays like origami and the increasing power demands required for space.
paras.zh: 在这一集中的 SpaceMinds 中，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 在欧洲航天科技博览会上与 Dcubed 首席执行官 Thomas Sinn 进行了交谈。他们讨论了该公司新一轮 3000 万美元的融资、如何考虑折纸等太阳能电池阵列以及太空所需不断增长的电力需求。

paras.zh: 本集由 Space Inventor 赞助

paras.en: Satellites built in Denmark for the ultimate combination of pioneer and partner – where bold innovation meets absolute reliability. From modules to mini constellations of payload centric fleets, Space Inventor uniquely adapts to achieve your mission and to always – Make Space for Progress.
paras.zh: 丹麦制造的卫星是先锋与合作伙伴的终极结合——大胆的创新与绝对的可靠性相结合。从模块到以有效载荷为中心的微型星座，Space Inventor 能够以独特的方式实现您的使命，并始终——为进步创造空间。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

paras.en: Watch a new episode every Thursday on SpaceNews.com and on our YouTube, Spotify and Apple channels.

articles.title: All Points Logistics Announces Partnership with Expeditors for Space Prep Logistics Center at Kennedy Space Center
articles.author: All Points Logistics

paras.en: MERRITT ISLAND, FL, November 18, 2026 — All Points Logistics has announced a partnership with Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. (NYSE: EXPD) to serve as the exclusive logistics provider for its planned Space Prep Spaceport Logistics Center at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州梅里特岛，2026 年 11 月 18 日 — All Points Logistics 宣布与华盛顿 Expeditors International, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：EXPD）建立合作伙伴关系，为其计划中的位于佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心的太空准备航天港物流中心提供独家物流服务。

paras.en: Through this partnership, Expeditors will establish an on-site presence at the Space Prep facility, providing end-to-end mission logistics for government agencies and commercial space operators. Services for spacecraft, ground support equipment, and related mission materials will include aerospace warehousing, inventory control, transportation management, project cargo services, customs brokerage, supply chain visibility, and launch campaign support. The operation will serve space system operators and manufacturers working at Kennedy Space Center, Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, and other launch locations.
paras.zh: 通过此次合作，Expeditors 将在太空准备设施建立现场服务，为政府机构和商业太空运营商提供端到端的任务后勤服务。航天器、地面支持设备和相关任务材料的服务将包括航空航天仓储、库存控制、运输管理、项目货运服务、报关、供应链可视性和发射活动支持。该行动将为在肯尼迪航天中心、卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站和其他发射地点工作的航天系统运营商和制造商提供服务。

paras.en: “Companies in the space industry manage highly specialized equipment and materials across global supply chains,” said Ed Rone, Expeditors’ Regional Vice President of the U.S. Southeast. “This partnership puts our people and services closer to their launch operations, transforming logistics from a transportation function into a mission-readiness capability that helps ensure critical flight hardware, launch equipment, and operational assets are available at the right time. We look forward to working with All Points and applying our experience to the unique demands of this industry.”
paras.zh: Expeditors 美国东南部区域副总裁 Ed Rone 表示：“航天工业公司管理着全球供应链中高度专业化的设备和材料。” “这种伙伴关系使我们的人员和服务更接近他们的发射操作，将物流从运输功能转变为任务准备能力，有助于确保关键的飞行硬件、发射设备和运营资产在正确的时间可用。我们期待与 All Points 合作，并将我们的经验应用于该行业的独特需求。”

paras.en: As part of its Space Prep initiative, All Points plans to build a 266,000-square-foot Spaceport Logistics Center on its 65-acre site at Kennedy Space Center. Located within five miles of the launch pads, the facility is scheduled to open by the end of 2027. The site will also include an adjacent 260,000-square-foot Spacecraft Processing Center, bringing together launch-site logistics and specialized spacecraft processing capabilities.
paras.zh: 作为其太空准备计划的一部分，All Points 计划在肯尼迪航天中心 65 英亩的场地上建造一个 266,000 平方英尺的太空港物流中心。该设施距离发射台不到 5 英里，计划于 2027 年底开放。该设施还将包括一个毗邻的 260,000 平方英尺的航天器处理中心，汇集发射场物流和专业航天器处理能力。

paras.en: “Expeditors is an ideal partner for our Space Prep business,” said Phil Monkress, CEO of All Points Logistics. “Their global logistics expertise and specialized transportation capabilities align directly with the needs of our space industry customers, helping them move, stage, and manage mission-critical flight hardware more efficiently at major launch sites.”
paras.zh: “Expeditors 是我们 Space Prep 业务的理想合作伙伴，”All Points Logistics 首席执行官 Phil Monkress 表示。 “他们的全球物流专业知识和专业运输能力直接满足我们航天工业客户的需求，帮助他们在主要发射场更有效地移动、部署和管理关键任务飞行硬件。”

paras.en: Through this collaboration, Space Prep customers will also benefit from access to Expeditors’ broader global logistics network, connecting suppliers and manufacturing locations with launch operations. The Kennedy Space Center location will also position Expeditors to support existing customers, including hyperscalers, as they explore opportunities in space-based data centers and advanced computing infrastructure.
paras.zh: 通过此次合作，Space Prep 客户还将受益于 Expeditors 更广泛的全球物流网络，将供应商和制造地点与发射业务连接起来。肯尼迪航天中心的位置还将帮助 Expeditors 为现有客户（包括超大规模企业）提供支持，帮助他们探索天基数据中心和先进计算基础设施的机会。

paras.en: All Points developed Space Prep to help address the growing demand for spacecraft processing and launch-site logistics infrastructure. By combining specialized facilities, mission support services, and strategic partnerships, All Points is expanding its capabilities to support commercial and government space customers at America’s major launch sites.
paras.zh: All Points 开发了 Space Prep，以帮助满足对航天器处理和发射场物流基础设施不断增长的需求。通过结合专业设施、任务支持服务和战略合作伙伴关系，All Points 正在扩大其能力，为美国主要发射场的商业和政府太空客户提供支持。

paras.en: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. (NYSE: EXPD) is a leading S&P 500 global logistics company headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. Through a worldwide network of knowledgeable professionals across six continents and a globally connected technology platform, Expeditors tailors solutions to manage increasingly complex supply chains and international trade requirements. The asset-light company offers air, customs, ocean, order management, road, warehousing and distribution, and cargo insurance services to key industries worldwide. Guided by a culture of exceptional customer service, Expeditors aspires to be the most trusted and valued logistics company in the world. For more information, visit expeditors.com.
paras.zh: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：EXPD）是一家领先的标准普尔 500 强全球物流公司，总部位于华盛顿州贝尔维尤。通过遍布六大洲的知识丰富的专业人士的全球网络和全球互联的技术平台，Expeditors 定制解决方案来管理日益复杂的供应链和国际贸易要求。这家轻资产公司为全球主要行业提供空运、海关、海运、订单管理、公路、仓储和配送以及货物保险服务。在卓越客户服务文化的指导下，Expeditors 立志成为全球最值得信赖和最有价值的物流公司。欲了解更多信息，请访问 expeditors.com。

paras.en: Space Prep, a business line of All Points Logistics, LLC, is developing multi-user spacecraft processing and logistics facilities at the nation’s busiest launch bases in Florida and California, giving commercial and government customers flexible access to cleanroom processing, fueling, storage, and mission support services. Learn more at SpacePrep.com.
paras.zh: Space Prep 是 All Points Logistics, LLC 的一个业务部门，正在美国佛罗里达州和加利福尼亚州最繁忙的发射基地开发多用户航天器处理和物流设施，为商业和政府客户提供灵活的洁净室处理、加油、存储和任务支持服务。请访问 SpacePrep.com 了解更多信息。

paras.en: Established in 1997 as a service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB), All Points Logistics has operations in multiple states and has grown into a leading solution provider to a diverse array of government and commercial customers, with award-winning expertise in software development, IT services, modeling and simulation, launch support services, and integrated logistics. Learn more at allpointsllc.com.
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 成立于 1997 年，是一家退伍军人拥有的小型企业 (SDVOSB)，在多个州开展业务，现已发展成为面向各类政府和商业客户的领先解决方案提供商，在软件开发、IT 服务、建模和模拟、启动支持服务和综合物流方面拥有屡​​获殊荣的专业知识。如需了解更多信息，请访问 allpointsllc.com。

articles.title: 'No chance!' - Poch and Mainoo fume at 'unfair' Yoro red card

paras.en: Leny Yoro red card: Man Utd boss Mauricio Pochettino and Kobbie Mainoo angry at sending off for foul on Liverpool's Alexander Isak
paras.zh: 莱尼·约罗红牌：曼联主帅毛里西奥·波切蒂诺和科比·迈努对利物浦亚历山大·伊萨克犯规而被罚下感到愤怒

paras.en: Manchester United were thumped 4-0 by Liverpool following Leny Yoro's red card after eight minutes; one of the considerations regarding a red card for Denying of an Obvious Goalscoring Opportunity (DOGS), is the likelihood of the attacking player "keeping or gaining control of the ball"
paras.zh: 比赛第 8 分钟，莱尼·约罗 (Leny Yoro) 被红牌罚下，曼联以 4-0 惨败利物浦。关于拒绝明显进球机会（DOGS）而出示红牌的考虑因素之一是进攻球员“保持或获得控球权”的可能性

paras.en: Mauricio Pochettino felt Manchester United were given an "unfair" red card in their 4-0 defeat at Liverpool - with Kobbie Mainoo replying "no chance" when asked whether Leny Yoro should have been sent off.
paras.zh: 毛里西奥·波切蒂诺认为曼联在0-4输给利物浦的比赛中获得了一张“不公平”的红牌，当被问及莱尼·约罗是否应该被罚下时，科比·迈努回答“没有机会”。

paras.en: Pochettino's first United game started in dismal fashion as Yoro was given his marching orders in the eighth minute for bringing down Alexander Isak as the last defender outside the box.
paras.zh: 波切蒂诺在曼联的第一场比赛以惨淡的方式开始，约罗在第八分钟因放倒禁区外最后一名后卫亚历山大·伊萨克而被罚下场。

paras.en: Dominik Szoboszlai then scored from the resulting free-kick and Florian Wirtz doubled the lead after 13 minutes. Rio Ngumoha and Victor Munoz put gloss on the scoreline after half-time.
paras.zh: 多米尼克·索博斯莱 (Dominik Szoboszlai) 随后任意球破门，弗洛里安·维尔茨 (Florian Wirtz) 在 13 分钟后将领先优势扩大一倍。里奥·恩古莫哈和维克多·穆尼奥斯在半场结束后为比分增光添彩。

paras.en: - Liverpool 4-0 Man Utd - report and reaction
paras.zh: - 利物浦 4-0 曼联 - 报道和反应

paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在手机上观看英超联赛直播📱

paras.en: - No Sky? Get Sky Sports or stream with no contract on NOW 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？立即获取天空体育或无合同直播 📺

paras.en: However, Yoro's sending off was doused in controversy as Isak took a heavy touch into United goalkeeper Senne Lammens before going down under the challenge.
paras.zh: 然而，约罗的被罚下引起了争议，因为伊萨克在受到挑战之前重重地撞到了曼联门将塞内·拉门斯。

paras.en: Under the laws, one of the considerations regarding a red card for Denying of an Obvious Goalscoring Opportunity (DOGS), is the likelihood of the attacking player "keeping or gaining control of the ball".
paras.zh: 根据法律规定，因拒绝明显进球机会（DOGS）而出示红牌的考虑因素之一是进攻球员“保持或获得控球权”的可能性。

paras.en: Pochettino felt that not only did Isak lose control of the ball with his touch, but also that United should have been given a penalty for Jeremy Jacquet's challenge on Bryan Mbeumo at the opposite end just moments before.
paras.zh: 波切蒂诺认为，伊萨克不仅因触球而失去了对球的控制，而且曼联应该因杰里米·雅凯刚刚在另一端对布莱恩·姆博莫的挑战而受到点球。

paras.en: "So painful. So disappointed," Pochettino told Sky Sports. "It's not ok to start a game in the Premier League with this situation.
paras.zh: “太痛苦了。太失望了，”波切蒂诺告诉天空体育。 “在这种情况下在英超联赛中开始比赛是不合适的。

paras.en: "The game changed completely after six minutes. Now we can explain everything but the damage is done, it's so painful.
paras.zh: “六分钟后比赛完全改变了。现在我们可以解释一切，但损害已经造成，太痛苦了。

paras.en: "The players are so, so feeling the pain of the result. I told them to be calm: it was an unfair situation that happened. We need to accept that reality. We need to try to increase our focus, concentration and make better decisions on the field.
paras.zh: “球员们对结果感到非常非常痛苦。我告诉他们要冷静：这是一个不公平的情况发生。我们需要接受这个现实。我们需要努力提高注意力，在场上做出更好的决定。”

paras.en: "We also need to be critical on ourselves but some situations happened in the game that we are not happy."
paras.zh: “我们也需要对自己批评，但比赛中发生了一些让我们不高兴的情况。”

paras.en: Pushed on whether he was unhappy with Isak's heavy touch, the United boss replied: "The ball was for the goalkeeper.
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否对伊萨克的重击感到不满时，曼联主帅回答道：“球是给守门员的。

paras.en: "In that situation, if you review the VAR you can see for sure, [Yoro] never had the intention to connect with Isak. When the control was long with the striker, the ball was going to the goalkeeper, he runs and goes down.
paras.zh: “在那种情况下，如果你回顾一下VAR，你可以肯定地看到，[Yoro]从来没有意图与伊萨克联系。当前锋长时间控制时，球传给了守门员，他跑动并倒地。

paras.en: "In Leny's case, it wasn't intentional."
paras.zh: “就莱尼而言，这不是故意的。”

paras.en: But then Pochettino added: "If you look before, on the sixth minute. Jacquet on Mbeumo. Similar? No. If you compare the actions, that was a penalty.
paras.zh: 但随后波切蒂诺补充道：“如果你看之前，在第六分钟。雅凯对姆博莫。类似？不。如果你比较动作，那是一个点球。”

paras.en: "How that changes life, if you score after six minutes. Now, for sure, we are talking in a different way. We have to take responsibility, I take the responsibility. We keep pushing."
paras.zh: “如果你在六分钟后进球，这将如何改变生活。现在，可以肯定的是，我们正在以不同的方式谈论。我们必须承担责任，我承担责任。我们继续努力。”

paras.en: Pochettino was seen speaking to the officials at full-time and when asked on that, the United boss said: "It's not going to change what happened. Being respectful is the most important.
paras.zh: 有人看到波切蒂诺全职与官员交谈，当被问及此事时，曼联主帅表示：“这不会改变所发生的事情。尊重是最重要的。”

paras.en: "At the same time, I have to defend my club. And tell what I feel. That was an action that everyone who plays football, it was clear that a situation that was not a red card."
paras.zh: “与此同时，我必须捍卫我的俱乐部。并说出我的感受。这是每个踢足球的人都会采取的行动，很明显，这种情况不是红牌。”

paras.en: United midfielder Mainoo was equally angry at the call. "The game's been taken out of our hands by a red card that I don't think can be a red card," he said.
paras.zh: 曼联中场迈努对这一决定同样感到愤怒。 “比赛已经被一张红牌从我们手中夺走了，我认为这不可能是一张红牌，”他说。

paras.en: "No chance. The ball's already with the goalkeeper. They're both running full speed. What can we do? It is what it is.
paras.zh: “没有机会。球已经到了守门员那里。他们都在全速奔跑。我们能做什么？事情就是这样。”

paras.en: "It's 10 vs 11, you come to a place like Anfield, it's a tough game anyway. Then you lose a man, it makes it hard. I can't fault the boys for their fight in the game. We take the pain and move on.
paras.zh: “这是10对11，你来到像安菲尔德这样的地方，无论如何，这都是一场艰难的比赛。然后你失去了一个人，这会让事情变得困难。我不能责怪孩子们在比赛中的战斗。我们承受痛苦并继续前进。

paras.en: "I wouldn't say it all goes out the window. You can still take the things you did in training into the game, but it makes it 10 times harder with one less man in a situation like that.
paras.zh: “我不会说这一切都消失了。你仍然可以把你在训练中所做的事情带到比赛中，但在这种情况下，少一个人，事情就会变得困难十倍。”

paras.en: "It's hard, it's painful. But no one's coming to save us. We have to work hard, keep digging, keep working, keep fighting. It will all come round."
paras.zh: “这很难，很痛苦。但没有人来拯救我们。我们必须努力工作，继续挖掘，继续工作，继续战斗。一切都会好起来的。”

paras.en: There was comical defending for the Yoro red-card incident, with United defender Matthijs de Ligt - playing his first Premier League minutes of the season - letting a long ball drop that allowed Isak to run through.
paras.zh: 约罗红牌事件的防守很滑稽，曼联后卫马泰斯·德利赫特在本赛季英超联赛的第一分钟上场，他的长传球落下，让伊萨克跑了过去。

paras.en: That then led to the Yoro 'foul' - but Roy Keane felt it was unfair on United, even despite their poor defending.
paras.zh: 这导致了约罗的“犯规”——但罗伊·基恩认为这对曼联不公平，尽管他们的防守很差。

paras.en: "Isak's not getting the ball," he said. "There's no way he's getting the ball.
paras.zh: “伊萨克没有拿到球，”他说。 “他不可能拿到球。

paras.en: "It's clumsy from United. Obviously it's one straight ball over the top. You shouldn't be in so much trouble.
paras.zh: “曼联的动作很笨拙。显然，这是一记直球过顶。你不应该遇到这么大的麻烦。

paras.en: "But there's no way he's getting that ball. Absolutely not. I know Isak is quick and he's sharp, but we've looked at it again.
paras.zh: “但他不可能拿到那个球。绝对不行。我知道伊萨克很快而且很敏锐，但我们又看了一遍。

paras.en: "It's really poor defending. Players not smelling danger. But Isak is not getting that ball. Absolutely not."
paras.zh: “防守真的很差。球员没有嗅到危险的味道。但伊萨克没有拿到球。绝对没有。”

paras.en: Pochettino defended United's defending - as they became the worst defence in Europe when it comes to goals conceded across all competitions this season.
paras.zh: 波切蒂诺为曼联的防守辩护——就本赛季所有比赛的失球数而言，他们成为欧洲防守最差的球队。

paras.en: "I wasn't in the past," said Pochettino, referring to United's defensive record under his predecessor Michael Carrick.
paras.zh: “我不再是过去了，”波切蒂诺说道，他指的是他的前任迈克尔·卡里克领导下的曼联的防守记录。

paras.en: "I take responsibility for today, and today we concede four goals with 10 men, and in a circumstance after playing 80 minutes on Anfield with 10 men.
paras.zh: “我对今天负起责任，今天我们在 10 人的情况下丢了 4 个球，而且是在安菲尔德 10 人踢了 80 分钟后的情况下。

paras.en: "Of course I take responsibility about that, no worries, but I don't want to compare situations in the past."
paras.zh: “我当然对此承担责任，不用担心，但我不想比较过去的情况。”

paras.en: Pochettino defends De Ligt selection call
paras.zh: 波切蒂诺为德里赫特的选择辩护

paras.en: When put to him that United did not have to go and concede four goals after the sending off, he replied: "It's so easy to talk in this way.
paras.zh: 当被问及曼联不必在被罚下后丢四个球时，他回答说：“用这种方式说话很容易。

paras.en: "It's about the team, always it's about balance. It's not about one line, the defensive line, the midfield, the offensive. I think when the team concede it is because the balance is not so good, and that I take responsibility about that.
paras.zh: “这与球队有关，始终与平衡有关。这与一条防线、后防线、中场、进攻无关。我认为当球队失球时，是因为平衡不太好，我对此承担责任。”

paras.en: "It's still a lot of games to play. We are in the reality and we need to accept the reality and we need to be responsible and we need to be united, we need to be all together. And I think we feel disappointed because it's clear. It's clear that after eight minutes, it happened what happened, and I think all that the plan was in the bin.
paras.zh: “还有很多比赛要打。我们处于现实之中，我们需要接受现实，我们需要负责，我们需要团结，我们需要团结在一起。我认为我们感到失望，因为事情很清楚。很明显，八分钟后，发生了什么事，我认为所有的计划都被扔进了垃圾桶。”

paras.en: "And what I learn from my players is that they like to fight, they are committed with the team, with the club, and of course they want to win games, they want to make the effort, and I think today we made an unbelievable effort.
paras.zh: “我从我的球员身上学到的是，他们喜欢战斗，他们对球队、俱乐部忠诚，当然他们想要赢得比赛，他们想要付出努力，我认为今天我们做出了令人难以置信的努力。

paras.en: "I think today was a test. That for me is very positive. After eight minutes, 10 men, red card, concede the goal in this action, Szoboszlai that scored from a free-kick, and 80 minutes to play, more than 80 minutes because I think, you know, the injury time and everything. Do you think that is easy?
paras.zh: “我认为今天是一次考验。这对我来说非常积极。八分钟后，10个人，红牌，在这次行动中丢球，索博斯莱通过任意球进球，还有80分钟的比赛，超过80分钟是因为我认为，你知道，伤停补时和其他一切。你认为这很容易吗？

paras.en: "Even the best team in the world playing like this in this situation, in our circumstance, maybe concede the four goals or maybe more. And now what we are going to say? We are in a situation that this is very complicated, it's difficult, yes, but I think we fight, we made the effort."
paras.zh: “即使是世界上最好的球队，在这种情况下，在我们的情况下，可能会丢四个球，甚至更多。现在我们要说的是？我们所处的情况非常复杂，这很困难，是的，但我认为我们在战斗，我们付出了努力。”

paras.en: One of Pochettino's main decisions was to start De Ligt for the first time in the Premier League in 357 days.
paras.zh: 波切蒂诺的主要决定之一是让德利赫特在英超联赛357天后首次首发。

paras.en: When asked about that, the Argentine said of De Ligt: "He was training, he played in the Champions League before the international duty. I think when we arrived, we saw the combination [with Lisandro Martinez].
paras.zh: 当被问及这一点时，阿根廷人谈到德里赫特时说道：“他正在训练，在国际比赛之前他参加了冠军联赛。我想当我们到达时，我们看到了[与利桑德罗·马丁内斯]的组合。

paras.en: "And I repeat again, Jacquet was a penalty, and if the referee says that is a penalty, for sure that action after never comes, and maybe we talk in another way.
paras.zh: “我再说一遍，雅凯是一个点球，如果裁判说这是一个点球，那么接下来的行动肯定不会到来，也许我们会以另一种方式谈论。

paras.en: "But, you know, one centre-back made a mistake, was penalty, wasn't punished, and us, we made one mistake and we were punished. And now I accept all the situation, but the circumstance are the circumstance.
paras.zh: “但是，你知道，一名中后卫犯了一个错误，被点球，没有受到惩罚，而我们，我们犯了一个错误，我们受到了惩罚。现在我接受所有情况，但情况就是情况。”

paras.en: "It's so important to put the circumstance in front. Always."
paras.zh: “将具体情况放在首位非常重要。始终如此。”

articles.title: Alcaraz beats Zverev to claim elusive ATP Finals title

paras.en: ATP Finals: Carlos Alcaraz beats world No 1 Alexander Zverev in blockbuster final to claim title for first time
paras.zh: ATP 总决赛：卡洛斯·阿尔卡拉斯 (Carlos Alcaraz) 在轰动一时的决赛中击败世界排名第一的亚历山大·兹维列夫 (Alexander Zverev) 首次夺得冠军

paras.en: Carlos Alcaraz joins Andre Agassi , Roger Federer and Novak Djokovic as the only players to win a career Grand Slam and the ATP Finals title; Alcaraz defeated Alexander Zverev in straight sets to win the season finale for the first time
paras.zh: 卡洛斯·阿尔卡拉斯继安德烈·阿加西、罗杰·费德勒和诺瓦克·德约科维奇之后，成为唯一赢得职业生涯大满贯和 ATP 总决赛冠军的球员；阿尔卡拉斯直落两盘击败亚历山大·兹维列夫，首次赢得赛季决赛

paras.en: Carlos Alcaraz secured his maiden Nitto ATP Finals title with a straight-sets victory over top seed Alexander Zverez in Turin.
paras.zh: 卡洛斯·阿尔卡拉斯 (Carlos Alcaraz) 在都灵直落两盘击败头号种子亚历山大·兹维雷斯 (Alexander Zverez)，首次获得 Nitto ATP 总决赛冠军。

paras.en: Alcaraz dominated at times as he defeated Zverev 6-2 7-6 and became just the fourth man with a career Grand Slam and the ATP Finals title, following on from Andre Agassi, Roger Federer and Novak Djokovic .
paras.zh: 阿尔卡拉兹时常占据统治地位，他以6-2 7-6击败兹维列夫，成为继安德烈·阿加西、罗杰·费德勒和诺瓦克·德约科维奇之后第四位获得职业生涯大满贯和ATP总决赛冠军的人。

paras.en: Zverev won the first two Grand Slam titles this year but ends his breakout season having failed to beat Alcaraz or Jannik Sinner, with the German falling short in his bid to win the ATP Finals for a third time.
paras.zh: 兹维列夫今年赢得了前两个大满贯冠军，但未能击败阿尔卡拉兹或扬尼克·辛纳，结束了他突破性的赛季，德国人未能第三次赢得 ATP 总决赛。

paras.en: Alcaraz played with heavy strapping on his left leg but moved freely during his victory, which came in just over two hours and continued his 100 per cent record in finals against Zverev.
paras.zh: 阿尔卡拉兹的左腿上绑着沉重的绑带，但在他的胜利过程中动作自如，仅用了两个多小时就取得了胜利，并延续了他在决赛中对阵兹维列夫的百分百记录。

paras.en: The 23-year-old dropped just two sets during his 14-match winning streak, with ATP Finals victory following titles at the Vienna Open and Paris Masters and earning him a winner's prize of nearly $5.2m.
paras.zh: 这位 23 岁的选手在 14 场连胜中仅丢掉两盘，继维也纳公开赛和巴黎大师赛夺冠后又在 ATP 总决赛中获胜，并为他赢得了近 520 万美元的冠军奖金。

paras.en: How Alcaraz beat Zverev to ATP Finals title
paras.zh: 阿尔卡拉斯如何击败兹维列夫夺得 ATP 总决赛冠军

paras.en: Zverev hadn't dropped his serve all week but Alcaraz tested him from the start, earning three break points in the opening game of the match. He saved all three of those - one of them with an ace after receiving a time violation warning - only for Alcaraz to break him in his next three service games.
paras.zh: 兹维列夫整个星期都没有丢掉​​自己的发球局，但阿尔卡拉斯从一开始就对他进行了考验，在比赛的首盘比赛中赢得了三个破发点。他挽救了所有这三个球——其中一个是在收到违规警告后用一张Ace救出的——结果阿尔卡拉兹在接下来的三场发球局中破掉了他的发球局。

paras.en: When Alcaraz produced a "tweener" - a shot between his legs - to recover a lob midway through the first set and Zverev missed the ensuing overhead, he threw his racket angrily toward the baseline.
paras.zh: 当阿尔卡拉兹在第一盘中途打出一记“中间击球”（两腿之间的击球）以恢复一记高球时，兹维列夫错过了随后的过顶球，他愤怒地将球拍扔向底线。

paras.en: Zverev again took too long and was docked his first serve, prompting him to complain to the chair umpire, while Alcaraz controlled by stretching the German from corner to corner and breaking again early in the second set.
paras.zh: 兹维列夫再次花了太长时间，并被扣掉了他的一发，促使他向主裁判抱怨，而阿尔卡拉斯则通过将德国人从一个角落拉到另一个角落来控制局面，并在第二盘初期再次破发。

paras.en: Alcaraz pulled off an acrobatic, leaping overhead as he was falling backward, putting his finger to his ear to encourage more cheering from the crowd, with the match appearing for a quick finish before Zverev broke back to make it 4-4 in the second set.
paras.zh: 阿尔卡拉兹完成了一场杂技般的表演，在向后摔倒时从头顶跃过，并用手指捂住耳朵以鼓励观众更多的欢呼，比赛看起来很快就结束了，随后兹维列夫在第二盘中破发将比分追至4-4。

paras.en: Zverev wasted three set points in the tie-breaker before Alcaraz converted his second match point with a backhand winner up the line, then dropped to the court on his back in celebration.
paras.zh: 兹维列夫在决胜局中浪费了三个盘点，随后阿尔卡拉斯用反手制胜球赢得了第二个赛点，然后仰面倒在球场上庆祝。

paras.en: "You're an absolute legend of our sport and you're only 23 years old," Zverev said during his runner-up speech. "If you retire tomorrow, it's okay, you can just relax."
paras.zh: “你绝对是我们这项运动的传奇人物，而你只有 23 岁，”兹维列夫在亚军演讲中说道。 “如果你明天就退休了，没关系，你可以放松一下。”
