paras.en: New York City, United States – “You have all elected the first Palestinian in New York Senate history!” Aber Kawas shouted over cheers to hundreds of Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) members at a bar on election night.
paras.zh: 美国纽约市——“你们都选出了纽约参议院历史上第一位巴勒斯坦人！”选举之夜，阿伯·卡瓦斯在一家酒吧向数百名美国民主社会主义者（DSA）成员大声欢呼。

paras.en: As chants of “Aber! Aber! Aber!” filled the patio of Bohemia Beer Garden on November 3, media cameras flashed against her shiny blazer, embroidered with traditional Palestinian tatreez in gold and red.
paras.zh: 正如“阿伯！阿伯！阿伯！”的口号一样。 11 月 3 日，波希米亚啤酒花园的庭院里挤满了人，媒体镜头在她闪亮的西装外套上闪烁，上面绣着金色和红色的传统巴勒斯坦塔特雷兹。

paras.en: Kawas, 34, made history as the first Palestinian, and the first Muslim woman, in the New York state Senate and the state legislature. She won the seat representing district 12 in northwest Queens, home to one of New York City’s largest Arab communities, where nearly half of residents were born outside the United States.
paras.zh: 34 岁的卡瓦斯创造了历史，成为纽约州参议院和州立法机构的第一位巴勒斯坦人和第一位穆斯林女性。她赢得了代表皇后区西北部第 12 区的席位，该区是纽约市最大的阿拉伯社区之一，该区近一半的居民出生在美国境外。

paras.en: As her speech ended and chants of “Free, Free Palestine” rang through the garden, Stylianos Karolidis, a DSA organiser on Kawas’s team, stepped up to remind supporters that she really, really had not wanted to run for office. The DSA had to “hound her non-stop” until she acquiesced, he said.
paras.zh: 当她的演讲结束时，花园里响起了“自由、自由的巴勒斯坦”的口号，卡瓦斯团队中的 DSA 组织者斯蒂利亚诺斯·卡洛迪斯 (Stylianos Karolidis) 站出来提醒支持者，她真的、真的不想竞选公职。他说，DSA 不得不“不停地追捕她”，直到她默许为止。

paras.en: Kawas had worked with New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani when he was in the state legislature, so they knew her organising skills.
paras.zh: 卡瓦斯曾在纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 担任州议会议员期间与他共事，因此他们了解她的组织能力。

paras.en: Kawas said she did not initially think it was possible to run for office without compromising her commitment to Palestinian liberation. Her victory, with 74.5 percent of the vote against Republican Han Khon To, was part of a broader tide of wins for pro-Palestine and democratic socialist candidates in the midterm elections, including Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan and Mayor-elect Nithya Raman in Los Angeles, California.
paras.zh: 卡瓦斯表示，她最初并不认为在不损害对巴勒斯坦解放的承诺的情况下竞选公职是可能的。她以 74.5% 的得票率击败共和党人韩孔陶 (Han Khon To) 获胜，这是中期选举中支持巴勒斯坦和民主社会主义候选人的更广泛获胜浪潮的一部分，其中包括密歇根州当选参议员阿卜杜勒·赛义德和加利福尼亚州洛杉矶当选市长尼西亚·拉曼。

paras.en: “This midterm election showed a politics of human rights that includes Palestinians is a winning platform,” said Institute for Middle East Understanding policy project executive director Margaret DeReus. “For millions of Americans, holding Israel accountable for genocide and supporting Palestinian freedom are the litmus test.”
paras.zh: “这次中期选举表明，包括巴勒斯坦人在内的人权政治是一个获胜的平台，”中东理解研究所政策项目执行主任玛格丽特·德雷乌斯说。 “对于数百万美国人来说，追究以色列对种族灭绝的责任并支持巴勒斯坦自由是试金石。”

paras.en: Days after the election, Kawas reflected on the DSA’s first approach and her doubts about entering a political system she had long distrusted. In her Queens home, a poster honouring Palestinians who had been killed hung above shelves of books on Islamic liberation, the Palestinian movement and US politics. But she ran because the political climate had shifted, she told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 选举几天后，卡瓦斯反思了 DSA 的第一个做法，以及她对进入她长期以来不信任的政治体系的疑虑。在她位于皇后区的家中，一张纪念遇害巴勒斯坦人的海报挂在书架上，书架上摆放着有关伊斯兰解放、巴勒斯坦运动和美国政治的书籍。但她告诉半岛电视台，她参选是因为政治气候发生了变化。

paras.en: “It felt like being pro-Palestinian was the most important thing to run on.”
paras.zh: “感觉亲巴勒斯坦是竞选中最重要的事情。”

paras.en: Kawas’s parents were uprooted from their homes in Palestine during the mass expulsions. Her father was uprooted in 1948 and her mother in 1967. They grew up as neighbours in Jordan before falling in love, marrying and moving to the US with their infant son in the 1990s. They later had three daughters. Aber is the third child of the four, sandwiched between her two sisters. “Which is why I have a lot of politician skills,” she said, laughing.
paras.zh: 卡瓦斯的父母在大规模驱逐期间被迫离开巴勒斯坦的家园。她的父亲于 1948 年背井离乡，母亲于 1967 年背井离乡。他们在约旦作为邻居长大，随后坠入爱河、结婚并在 20 世纪 90 年代带着年幼的儿子移居美国。他们后来生了三个女儿。阿伯是四个孩子中的第三个，夹在她的两个姐妹中间。 “这就是为什么我拥有很多政治技巧，”她笑着说。

paras.en: But when she was in the seventh grade, her father was detained by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), which her mother described as a regular occurrence in New York’s post-9/11 Muslim community. His detention meant weekend visits to prison, and it left the family struggling.
paras.zh: 但当她七年级时，她的父亲被美国移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 拘留，她的母亲称这种情况在 9/11 事件后纽约的穆斯林社区经常发生。他被拘留意味着周末要去监狱，这让他的家人陷入困境。

paras.en: “I had to work whether I wanted to or not; you have to become both man and woman, father and mother,” her mother, Manal Abu Samaha, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “无论我愿意与否，我都必须工作；你必须成为男人和女人，父亲和母亲，”她的母亲马纳尔·阿布·萨马哈告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: When Kawas was a teenager, she said she travelled to Albany to tell her family’s story, hoping to expand opportunities for undocumented students like her older brother, who was ineligible for a college scholarship. Lawmakers seemed uninterested, Kawas recalls.
paras.zh: 卡瓦斯十几岁时，她说她去奥尔巴尼讲述了她家人的故事，希望为像她哥哥这样没有资格获得大学奖学金的无证学生增加机会。卡瓦斯回忆道，立法者似乎对此不感兴趣。

paras.en: The state senator-elect credits the experience with launching her advocacy career and shaping her goals as a politician. “It’s not upending systems, but it’s meeting real, immediate material needs for people,” she said. “That’s maybe a little kernel of what got me to run.”
paras.zh: 这位当选州参议员认为这段经历开启了她的倡导生涯并塑造了她作为政治家的目标。 “这不是颠覆系统，而是满足人们真实、直接的物质需求，”她说。 “这也许是促使我跑步的一个小核心。”

paras.en: Backed by Mamdani and the DSA, Kawas’s campaign said it mobilised more than 1,000 volunteers to knock on doors, make calls and campaign on affordable housing, healthcare and public transport, as well as the Palestinian solidarity work that has shaped her life.
paras.zh: 在马姆达尼和 DSA 的支持下，卡瓦斯的竞选活动表示，它动员了 1000 多名志愿者挨家挨户、打电话并就经济适用房、医疗保健和公共交通以及塑造她生活的巴勒斯坦团结工作开展活动。

paras.en: Kawas recalled that, while Mamdani was warned that supporting Palestine would end his political career, the stance instead helped him earn voters’ trust. Seeing this, she said, made her less wary that entering politics would require her to compromise her beliefs.
paras.zh: 卡瓦斯回忆说，虽然马姆达尼被警告支持巴勒斯坦将结束他的政治生涯，但这一立场反而帮助他赢得了选民的信任。她说，看到这一点，让她不再那么担心进入政坛需要她妥协自己的信仰。

paras.en: “I voted for Aber Kawas because Palestinian liberation is not separate from the everyday survival and basic needs that Americans and New Yorkers struggle with,” said community organiser Doreen Mohammed. “Aber Kawas’s vocal support for Palestine is what we need more of everywhere.”
paras.zh: “我投票给阿伯·卡瓦斯，因为巴勒斯坦解放与美国人和纽约人的日常生存和基本需求密不可分，”社区组织者多琳·穆罕默德说。 “阿伯·卡瓦斯对巴勒斯坦的声援是我们各地都需要的。”

paras.en: Kawas told Al Jazeera she believes her stance on Palestine helped her earn trust from local leaders. Whether it can change US policy is a harder question.
paras.zh: 卡瓦斯告诉半岛电视台，她相信自己在巴勒斯坦问题上的立场帮助她赢得了当地领导人的信任。它是否能够改变美国的政策是一个更难的问题。

paras.en: “Many of us are rightfully cautious, if not outright sceptical, when it comes to electoral politics,” said Samee Sulaiman, an anthropologist at Columbia University who studies the Middle East. “Can we build and use this nascent power to finally end American support of Israel in every way? This will be the real test.”
paras.zh: “在涉及选举政治时，我们中的许多人即使不是完全怀疑，也是有理由保持谨慎的，”哥伦比亚大学研究中东问题的人类学家萨米·苏莱曼说。 “我们能否建立并利用这一新兴力量最终结束美国对以色列的各种支持？这将是真正的考验。”

paras.en: Kawas acknowledged that a lot will depend on the political will of legislative leaders.
paras.zh: 卡瓦斯承认，这在很大程度上取决于立法领导人的政治意愿。

paras.en: “The challenge, truly, is going to be the political will of the leadership,” she said. “We [the DSA] are still a minority in the legislature.”
paras.zh: “真正的挑战将是领导层的政治意愿，”她说。 “我们（DSA）仍然是立法机构中的少数派。”

paras.en: Her first priority is reviving the Not on Our Dime! bill, which she drafted with then-Assembly member Zohran Mamdani in 2023 to prohibit New York non-profits from supporting illegal Israeli settlement activity in the occupied Palestinian territory. Rejected at the time, it is now back before the New York state Senate.
paras.zh: 她的首要任务是重振“Not on Our Dime”！她与当时的议会议员 Zohran Mamdani 于 2023 年起草了该法案，禁止纽约非营利组织支持以色列在巴勒斯坦被占领土上的非法定居点活动。当时被拒绝，现在又回到纽约州参议院。

paras.en: Kawas said she remains convinced change is possible, pointing to the activists who helped bring an end to apartheid in South Africa.
paras.zh: 卡瓦斯表示，她仍然相信改变是可能的，并指出了帮助结束南非种族隔离的活动人士。

paras.en: “If there’s the power of the people behind you, that is what you carry with you, and that’s who you’ll be accountable to.”
paras.zh: “如果你背后有人民的力量，那就是你随身携带的力量，这就是你要对谁负责的人。”

articles.title: Cockroaches, dissent and a paradigm shift in India

paras.en: The rise of Cockroach Janta Party and what it reveals about the future of politics and journalism in India.
paras.zh: 蟑螂简塔党的崛起及其揭示了印度政治和新闻业的未来。

paras.en: A youth-led movement born as online satire has unsettled Indian politics. Named after a dismissive remark by the chief justice, the Cockroach Janta Party has mobilised some of the country’s biggest protests in years. They have been driven by anger over exam leaks, unemployment and a lack of political accountability.
paras.zh: 一场以网络讽刺形式诞生的、由年轻人领导的运动扰乱了印度政坛。蟑螂简塔党以首席大法官的轻蔑言论命名，已经动员了该国多年来最大规模的一些抗议活动。他们对考试泄密、失业和缺乏政治问责感到愤怒。

paras.en: The demonstrators have been met by heavy police crackdowns and clashed with mainstream media outlets they accuse of serving the government.
paras.zh: 示威者遭到警方的严厉镇压，并与他们指责为政府服务的主流媒体发生冲突。

paras.en: As young Indians turn to social media and independent outlets to tell their stories, this film examines the growing divide between India’s youth and mainstream media and what it could mean for the future of politics and journalism.
paras.zh: 随着印度年轻人转向社交媒体和独立媒体讲述他们的故事，这部电影探讨了印度年轻人和主流媒体之间日益扩大的分歧，以及这对政治和新闻业的未来意味着什么。

paras.en: Manisha Pande – Editorial director, Newslaundry
paras.zh: Manisha Pande – Newslaundry 编辑总监

paras.en: Ashutosh Ranka – Co-convenor, Cockroach Janta Party
paras.zh: Ashutosh Ranka – 蟑螂简塔党联合召集人

paras.en: Rajat Sethi – Visiting fellow, India Foundation
paras.zh: Rajat Sethi – 印度基金会访问学者

articles.title: Anthropic worker claims to have solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of AI
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Anthropic worker claims to have solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of AI
paras.zh: 人类工作者声称在人工智能的帮助下解决了数学问题的圣杯

paras.en: A mathematician who works for artificial intelligence giant Anthropic claims he has solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of the company's AI tool Claude.
paras.zh: 人工智能巨头 Anthropic 的一位数学家声称，在该公司的人工智能工具 Claude 的帮助下，他已经解决了数学问题的圣杯。

paras.en: It marks the second time in recent months that an AI company or someone linked to one claims to have cracked a famed unsolved math problem.
paras.zh: 这是近几个月来第二次有人工智能公司或相关人员声称已经解决了一个著名的未解决的数学问题。

paras.en: Levent Alpöge, a member of the company's technical staff, made the announcement Friday by way of a four-page explanation posted on his website. He said that he believes by working with Claude, he has found a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis.
paras.zh: 该公司技术人员 Levent Alpöge 周五通过在其网站上发布的四页解释宣布了这一消息。他说，他相信通过与克劳德的合作，他已经找到了黎曼猜想的证明。

paras.en: "Claude and I have had a great time together with such breadth in recent months, but this time Claude far outpaced me near the finish line," Alpöge wrote. "No, Claude flew, and danced, and sparkled near that finish line."
paras.zh: “近几个月来，克劳德和我一起度过了一段美好的时光，但这次克劳德在终点线附近远远超过了我，”阿尔波格写道。 “不，克劳德在终点线附近飞翔、跳舞、闪闪发光。”

paras.en: Formulated in 1859, the Riemann Hypothesis centers on the distribution of prime numbers — those that are only divisible by one and themselves — as they grow towards infinity.
paras.zh: 黎曼猜想于 1859 年提出，其核心是素数（只能被 1 和它们本身整除的素数）随着素数向无穷大方向发展的分布。

paras.en: Alpöge said his discovery came late Sunday night. He messaged Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei to ask about "my ability to announce," as the San Francisco-based company was about to make major news with its stock market debut.
paras.zh: 阿尔波格说，他的发现是在周日深夜发现的。他给 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 发信息，询问“我是否有能力宣布这一消息”，因为这家总部位于旧金山的公司即将在股市首次亮相时发布重大新闻。

paras.en: A day after the company's initial public offering — the most valuable in history — Alpöge revealed he'd solved the problem that has proved elusive for more than 150 years. Anthropic did not respond to an email from The Associated Press requesting comment on Alpöge's claim.
paras.zh: 在该公司首次公开募股（史上最有价值的一次）后的第二天，Alpöge 透露，他已经解决了 150 多年来一直难以解决的问题。 Anthropic 没有回复美联社要求对 Alpöge 的说法发表评论的电子邮件。

paras.en: Alpöge released his and Claude's proof of the Riemann Hypothesis within 17 million lines of Lean code, a programing language that allows people to program proofs of mathematical theorems. Traditionally the findings buried in that code would be published in a formal paper, said Alex Kontorovich, distinguished professor and department chair of mathematics at Rutgers University.
paras.zh: Alpöge 在 1700 万行 Lean 代码中发布了他和 Claude 对黎曼猜想的证明，这是一种允许人们编写数学定理证明程序的编程语言。罗格斯大学杰出教授兼数学系主任亚历克斯·康托罗维奇 (Alex Kontorovich) 表示，传统上，隐藏在该代码中的发现将发表在正式论文中。

paras.en: "Usually when somebody gives you a paper, that's also kind of code for a proof and you have to actually read the paper, follow it yourself, figure out if you believe every single line in that paper. And when you're done, you should have a deep understanding of why something is true," he said.
paras.zh: “通常，当有人给你一篇论文时，这也是一种证明代码，你必须实际阅读论文，自己遵循它，弄清楚你是否相信论文中的每一行。当你完成后，你应该深刻理解为什么某些事情是正确的，”他说。

paras.en: He said Claude followed that code and said the proof is true.
paras.zh: 他说克劳德遵循了这个准则，并说证明是正确的。

paras.en: "Does that mean I understand it? Not yet. But the computer is extraordinarily picky, way pickier than I am and so if you can satisfy the computer, there's a very, very good chance you're going to satisfy me too," he said. "But I have to do the work."
paras.zh: “这是否意味着我明白了？还没有。但是计算机非常挑剔，比我挑剔得多，所以如果你能让计算机满意，那么你也很有可能让我满意，”他说。 “但我必须做这项工作。”

paras.en: Hours after the announcement, the Riemann Hypothesis remained listed as unsolved on the Clay Mathematics Institute's website. The institute had selected the hypothesis back in 2000 as one of seven Millennium Prize Problems and offered a reward of $1 million for the solution.
paras.zh: 消息公布几小时后，黎曼猜想在克莱数学研究所的网站上仍然被列为未解决。该研究所早在 2000 年就将该假设选为七个千年奖问题之一，并为解决该问题提供了 100 万美元的奖励。

paras.en: The assessment process of whether the problem has actually been solved takes time, explained Martin Bridson, president of the institute.
paras.zh: 该研究所所长马丁·布里德森解释说，评估问题是否真正得到解决的过程需要时间。

paras.en: "This is an announcement of historic significance, which holds the promise of a dramatic transformation in the perception of what is possible in the struggle to extend the human understanding of mathematics," he said in a statement. "But the journey from today's announcement to a place of real understanding will be long and difficult."
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中表示：“这是一项具有历史意义的宣布，它有望使人们对在扩展人类对数学理解的斗争中可能实现的目标的看法发生巨大转变。” “但从今天的宣布到真正理解的过程将是漫长而艰难的。”

paras.en: Alpöge said he is "presenting the world with a complete argument before having mastered a massive neighbourhood around its mathematics." He said more than 250,000 pages came out of his work with AI.
paras.zh: 阿尔波格说，他“在掌握了数学的大量邻域之前，向世界展示了一个完整的论点。”他说他的人工智能工作成果超过 250,000 页。

paras.en: In September, OpenAI said its technology was key in a similar breakthrough with Navier-Stokes, an equation that governs the flow of fluids.
paras.zh: 九月份，OpenAI 表示，其技术是纳维-斯托克斯方程（控制流体流动的方程）类似突破的关键。

paras.en: "Navier-Stokes fell and now the Riemann Hypothesis," said Kontorovich. "There's some kind of out-of-body experience where I'm looking at myself saying, 'Yes, the Riemann Hypothesis has been solved,' and kind of trying to comprehend what the hell these words are coming out of my mouth."
paras.zh: “纳维-斯托克斯衰落了，现在黎曼猜想衰落了，”康托罗维奇说。 “有一种灵魂出窍的体验，我看着自己说，‘是的，黎曼猜想已经解决了’，并试图理解这些话到底是从我嘴里说出来的。”

paras.en: Anthropic made a blockbuster Wall Street debut this week, through which it raised a record-breaking $81 billion at a $1.5 trillion valuation.
paras.zh: Anthropic 本周在华尔街首次亮相，引起轰动，以 1.5 万亿美元的估值筹集了创纪录的 810 亿美元资金。

paras.en: Amodei has projected an optimistic vision for AI's future in which the technology leads to significant advancements in math and science research while simultaneously warning about the potential risks AI poses.
paras.zh: 阿莫迪对人工智能的未来提出了乐观的愿景，即该技术将带来数学和科学研究的重大进步，同时警告人工智能带来的潜在风险。

articles.title: Climate change talks fall apart in final hours over fossil fuels
articles.author: Lauren Sommer

paras.en: Climate change talks fall apart in final hours over fossil fuels
paras.zh: 气候变化谈判在最后几个小时因化石燃料而破裂

paras.en: ANTALYA, Turkey — International climate change talks in Antalya, Turkey, broke down in overtime hours over the main cause of planetary warming — fossil fuels. On Sunday, nearly 200 countries failed to reach an agreement on whether they should move away from energy sources like coal and natural gas.
paras.zh: 土耳其安塔利亚——在土耳其安塔利亚举行的国际气候变化谈判在加班后就因地球变暖的主要原因——化石燃料而破裂。周日，近 200 个国家未能就是否应放弃煤炭和天然气等能源达成一致。

paras.en: The talks ended in a dramatic fashion, with the European Union negotiators saying they could not agree to a final agreement without mentioning the transition away from fossil fuels — the primary driver of climate change. The EU bloc then walked out of the room. Burning fossil fuels like oil, gas and coal make up roughly 73% of global emissions.
paras.zh: 谈判以戏剧性的方式结束，欧盟谈判代表表示，如果不提及摆脱化石燃料（气候变化的主要驱动因素）的过渡，他们就无法达成最终协议。随后欧盟集团走出房间。石油、天然气和煤炭等化石燃料的燃烧约占全球排放量的 73%。

paras.en: After representatives of the EU walked out, other countries also objected – including Panama and island states such as the Marshall Islands.
paras.zh: 欧盟代表退出后，其他国家也表示反对，包括巴拿马和马绍尔群岛等岛国。

paras.en: The European climate chief, Wopke Hoekstra, said that when the world is heading for an overshoot of 1.5 degrees, the EU could not tolerate an agreement that does not mention fossil fuels. "That is not acceptable," Hoekstra told reporters after walking out of the talks. "We do that with a heavy heart with many other countries, but we simply cannot accept this."
paras.zh: 欧洲气候负责人沃普克·霍克斯特拉 (Wopke Hoekstra) 表示，当全球气温即将超调 1.5 度时，欧盟无法容忍一项不提及化石燃料的协议。 “这是不可接受的，”胡克斯特拉在退出会谈后告诉记者。 “我们怀着沉重的心情与许多其他国家这样做，但我们根本无法接受这一点。”

paras.en: This is the first U.N. climate summit where there's been scientific consensus that the world will surpass a key global warming threshold. Countries agreed in 2015 to limit climate change to 1.5 degrees Celsius (2.7 degrees Fahrenheit), but the planet has essentially reached that limit already.
paras.zh: 这是第一次联合国气候峰会，科学界一致认为世界将超过全球变暖的关键阈值。 2015 年，各国同意将气候变化限制在 1.5 摄氏度（2.7 华氏度）以内，但地球基本上已经达到了这一限制。

paras.en: Passing that threshold means more severe climate impacts, like more intense hurricanes and heat waves. The United Nations found that a best-case scenario of 1.7 or 1.8 degrees Celsius would require cutting emissions immediately, reducing them by 45% by 2035. That, scientists say, would require dramatically cutting fossil fuel use.
paras.zh: 超过这个阈值意味着更严重的气候影响，例如更强烈的飓风和热浪。联合国发现，最好的情况是 1.7 或 1.8 摄氏度，需要立即减少排放，到 2035 年将排放量减少 45%。科学家表示，这需要大幅减少化石燃料的使用。

paras.en: "It's good that that decision has been rejected," says Mohamed Adow of Power Shift Africa, a nonprofit focused on climate change in Africa. "It doesn't have enough to help protect the people who are most vulnerable to climate change, who have contributed the least and are now suffering firsthand the worst."
paras.zh: “这一决定被拒绝是一件好事，”专注于非洲气候变化的非营利组织 Power Shift Africa 的穆罕默德·阿多 (Mohamed Adow) 说道。 “它不足以帮助保护那些最容易受到气候变化影响的人们，他们对气候变化的贡献最小，现在正遭受最严重的痛苦。”

paras.en: NPR correspondent Michael Copley contributed to this story. This story was edited by Sadie Babits.
paras.zh: NPR 记者迈克尔·科普利 (Michael Copley) 对本文做出了贡献。这个故事由萨迪·巴比特 (Sadie Babits) 编辑。

paras.en: A previous version of this story incorrectly said the European Union walked out along with other countries. In fact, EU representatives walked out while other countries objected.
paras.zh: 这个故事的前一个版本错误地称欧盟与其他国家一起退出。事实上，欧盟代表在其他国家反对的情况下退出了。

articles.title: Lebanese villagers return to wrecked homes as the Israeli army pulls back
articles.author: Jane Arraf

paras.en: Lebanese villagers return to wrecked homes as the Israeli army pulls back
paras.zh: 随着以色列军队撤退，黎巴嫩村民返回被毁的家园

paras.en: ZAWTAR AL-GHARBIYAH, Lebanon — After two decades of working installing vehicle air conditioning in Saudi Arabia, Atef Kadouh saved up enough money to build a house in his hometown in southern Lebanon.
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩扎瓦塔尔加尔比亚——阿特夫·卡杜 (Atef Kadouh) 在沙特阿拉伯从事汽车空调安装工作二十年后，攒了足够的钱在黎巴嫩南部的家乡建造了一栋房子。

paras.en: He and his wife, Soumaya Yaghi lived in the house for 40 years and had five children — all born at home.
paras.zh: 他和妻子 Soumaya Yaghi 在这座房子里生活了 40 年，并育有 5 个孩子，全都在家中出生。

paras.en: A photo of the youngest, Adel, is propped up in a basket of dried flowers near the doorway.
paras.zh: 门口附近的一篮干花里放着一张最小的阿德尔的照片。

paras.en: Adel, clean-cut with a trimmed beard, was a sports teacher and a basketball champion who was planning to travel to France this summer to pursue his doctorate. When the war with Israel began this year, he decided to volunteer as an ambulance driver.
paras.zh: 阿德尔是一名体育老师，也是一名篮球冠军，身材干净，胡须修剪整齐，他计划今年夏天前往法国攻读博士学位。今年与以色列的战争开始时，他决定志愿担任救护车司机。

paras.en: The Israeli military killed him and four other medics on March 28 in a drone strike as the first responders buried a 75-year-old man who had died in hospital.
paras.zh: 3 月 28 日，当急救人员埋葬一名在医院死亡的 75 岁男子时，以色列军方在一次无人机袭击中杀死了他和其他四名医务人员。

paras.en: "This one broke me," his father says. "He was my youngest son, 27 years old. There have been wars in every country in the world but there are rules for war … you attack a paramedic rescuing wounded people, children? He was not a fighter at the front."
paras.zh: “这让我心碎，”他的父亲说。 “他是我最小的儿子，27岁。世界上每个国家都发生过战争，但战争也是有规则的……你袭击了一名正在抢救伤员、孩子的护理人员？他不是前线的战士。”

paras.en: He says he warned his son that Israel could not be trusted not to kill medical personnel.
paras.zh: 他说，他警告儿子，不能相信以色列不会杀害医务人员。

paras.en: "He would not listen to me. He said, 'Dad there are wounded children — we have to go rescue them,'" he says.
paras.zh: “他不听我的。他说，‘爸爸，有受伤的孩子——我们必须去营救他们，’”他说。

paras.en: Lebanon's Health Ministry says Israel has killed more than 135 first responders and medical staff in the past two years.
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩卫生部表示，以色列在过去两年中杀害了超过 135 名急救人员和医务人员。

paras.en: Asked about this airstrike, the Israeli military replied, without providing proof, that militants routinely pose as paramedics and transport weapons in ambulances for the militant group Hezbollah and its allies.
paras.zh: 当被问及这次空袭时，以色列军方在没有提供证据的情况下回答说，武装分子经常冒充医护人员，并用救护车为武装组织真主党及其盟友运输武器。

paras.en: It did not respond to follow-up questions pointing out the five were not killed in an ambulance but at a burial.
paras.zh: 它没有回应后续问题，指出这五人不是在救护车上而是在葬礼上被杀的。

paras.en: The Kadouh family returned to the village in July when it became the first and until now only test of a U.S.-brokered plan for Israeli forces to withdraw and the Lebanese army to take over.
paras.zh: 卡杜一家于 7 月返回该村，当时这是对美国斡旋的以色列军队撤军和黎巴嫩军队接管计划的第一次也是迄今为止唯一一次测试。

paras.en: The plan is aimed at keeping Iran-backed Hezbollah out of the area, after they started firing rockets across the nearby border in solidarity with the Palestinian militant group Hamas who launched a surprise attack on southern Israel in October 2023.
paras.zh: 该计划旨在将伊朗支持的真主党排除在该地区之外，此前他们开始向附近边境发射火箭，以声援巴勒斯坦激进组织哈马斯，该组织于 2023 年 10 月对以色列南部发动了突然袭击。

paras.en: Israel responded with devastating air strikes and eventually a ground invasion, and says it has continued attacks in south Lebanon following a U.S.-brokered ceasefire this year to eliminate what it believes are continued threats to northern Israel. Israel's defense minister has acknowledged destroying more than 20,000 homes across the Lebanese border in a self-declared security zone.
paras.zh: 以色列以毁灭性的空袭和最终的地面入侵作为回应，并表示，今年在美国斡旋的停火协议之后，以色列继续对黎巴嫩南部发动袭击，以消除以色列北部的持续威胁。以色列国防部长承认摧毁了黎巴嫩边境一侧自行宣布的安全区内的 20,000 多所房屋。

paras.en: When Kadouh and Yaghi returned to the village, they found that Israeli soldiers had occupied their house. And then it had been set on fire.
paras.zh: 当卡杜和亚吉回到村庄时，他们发现以色列士兵占领了他们的房子。然后它就被点燃了。

paras.en: Upstairs in the hallway, near scorched walls and shattered windows, what appeared to be a work roster was written on the wall in blue marker in Hebrew with the first names of Israeli soldiers.
paras.zh: 楼上的走廊里，靠近烧焦的墙壁和破碎的窗户的地方，墙上用蓝色记号笔用希伯来语写着一份似乎是工作名单的东西，上面写着以色列士兵的名字。

paras.en: Almost everything in the house had been destroyed. Appliances — the fridge, freezer and washing machine — had bullet holes in them. Some, along with furniture, had been pushed over the second floor balcony, smashing on the ground below.
paras.zh: 房子里的所有东西几乎都被毁了。冰箱、冰柜和洗衣机等电器上都有弹孔。有些连同家具一起被推到二楼阳台上，砸在下面的地面上。

paras.en: Kadouh says they knew from satellite photos there was destruction in their village "but the level of destruction — we were not expecting that. Everything that could be broken they broke."
paras.zh: 卡杜说，他们从卫星照片中得知，他们的村庄遭到了破坏，“但破坏的程度是我们没有预料到的。所有可以破坏的东西，他们都破坏了。”

paras.en: In the kitchen were shattered floor tiles and kitchen cupboards wrenched from the walls.
paras.zh: 厨房里的地砖已经破碎，厨房的橱柜也从墙上被扯下来。

paras.en: The fire appeared to be set as the soldiers were leaving. Blackened, burned food packets — fruit boxes and cans of energy drinks with Hebrew writing — were on the floor along with rotting sandwiches.
paras.zh: 火灾似乎是在士兵们离开时被点燃的。地板上散落着发黑、烧焦的食品包——水果盒和印有希伯来语文字的能量饮料罐——以及腐烂的三明治。

paras.en: In their 18-month-old grandson's bedroom, soot from a scorched ceiling dripped down on walls decorated with images of hot-air balloons and teddy bears climbing ladders to the moon.
paras.zh: 在他们 18 个月大的孙子的卧室里，烧焦的天花板上的烟灰滴落在墙壁上，墙壁上装饰着热气球和泰迪熊爬梯子登月的图案。

paras.en: Yaghi shows a bullet — one of many she says she found throughout the house. The spent engine casing of a missile or a drone with English markings reading "propulsion unit – tactical" was found in one of the rooms.
paras.zh: 亚吉展示了一颗子弹——她说她在房子里发现了许多子弹中的一颗。在其中一个房间里发现了一枚导弹或一架无人机的废发动机外壳，上面有英文标记，上面写着“推进装置 - 战术”。

paras.en: There is no running water or electricity — Kadouh says the Israeli military destroyed the solar panels.
paras.zh: 没有自来水或电力——卡杜说以色列军方摧毁了太阳能电池板。

paras.en: The Lebanese army told them that when it reentered the village many of the houses had been rigged to be blown up. It said it dismantled explosives left by Israeli forces in their house and others.
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩军队告诉他们，当他们重新进入村庄时，许多房屋已被炸毁。该公司表示，它拆除了以色列军队留在他们房屋和其他地方的爆炸物。

paras.en: The Israeli army did not reply to NPR queries about why the house was damaged or set on fire. It said military policy bars burning homes or leaving explosives.
paras.zh: 以色列军队没有回复国家公共广播电台关于房屋为何被损坏或着火的询问。报告称，军事政策禁止焚烧房屋或留下爆炸物。

paras.en: Unable to enter the village while Israeli forces were there, Kadouh said he saw a tank in their courtyard from drone images posted on social media.
paras.zh: 卡杜表示，当以色列军队在那里时，他无法进入村庄，他从社交媒体上发布的无人机图像中看到了庭院里有一辆坦克。

paras.en: Yaghi says the Israeli army used a bulldozer to uproot the trees — including the pine trees which yield one of their most prized cash crops: pine nuts. When they had killed the trees, she says they demolished the family's garage and destroyed their tractor.
paras.zh: 亚吉说，以色列军队使用推土机将树木连根拔起，其中包括松树，松树是以色列最珍贵的经济作物之一：松子。她说，当他们砍伐树木后，他们拆毁了家里的车库并毁坏了他们的拖拉机。

paras.en: "We are back to square one," Kadouh says. "Starting from scratch."
paras.zh: “我们又回到了原点，”卡杜说。 “从头开始。”

paras.en: Even more precarious, though, than when they started decades ago. Despite a ceasefire, smoke rises from a nearby village where Israel is still attacking.
paras.zh: 然而，比几十年前开始时更加不稳定。尽管停火，附近的一个村庄仍冒出浓烟，以色列仍在袭击该村庄。

paras.en: Amid all the damage, the destruction of the family's trees cuts the deepest.
paras.zh: 在所有的破坏中，对家族树木的破坏影响最深。

paras.en: "I tended to them as if they were small children — they were all dear to me," Kadouh says.
paras.zh: “我照顾他们就像照顾小孩子一样——他们对我来说都很亲爱，”卡杜说。

paras.en: Yaghi points out where there were fruit-bearing cactus, olive trees, a fig tree one of her sons brought from Italy, avocado trees and fields of thyme, avocado.
paras.zh: 亚吉指出，那里有结果实的仙人掌、橄榄树、她的一个儿子从意大利带来的一棵无花果树、鳄梨树和百里香、鳄梨田。

paras.en: Up until a decade ago, almost everyone here grew tobacco, diversifying crops when that market collapsed.
paras.zh: 直到十年前，这里几乎每个人都种植烟草，当市场崩溃时，他们使农作物多样化。

paras.en: "We raised our children through hard work and thank God all of them were educated," Yaghi says, noting with pride that they all became professionals.
paras.zh: “我们通过辛勤工作养育了我们的孩子，感谢上帝，他们都受到了教育，”亚吉说道，并自豪地指出他们都成为了专业人士。

paras.en: She maintains a visceral connection to the land.
paras.zh: 她与这片土地保持着发自内心的联系。

paras.en: "Record this," she asks, walking next to rose bushes that have begun to bloom again. "Our land is a paradise with everything in it. Our life is this land. Our life is our homes. Even if we were to die in our homes it would be much better than to live outside."
paras.zh: “记录下来，”她边走边问道，玫瑰丛又开始绽放了。 “我们的土地是一个天堂，里面有一切。我们的生命就是这片土地。我们的生命就是我们的家园。即使我们死在家里，也比住在外面好得多。”

paras.en: Villagers here feel abandoned by even their own government — and still in danger from nearby Israeli forces.
paras.zh: 这里的村民感到甚至被自己的政府抛弃了，而且仍然面临着附近以色列军队的危险。

paras.en: "Our homes were destroyed and no one came to check on us," Kadouh says. "Not the Lebanese state or outsiders or the parties," he says, referring to Hezbollah and its allies. "They just say 'Go back, go back' to the village. We came back and there are no essentials — no electricity, no water."
paras.zh: “我们的房屋被毁，没有人来检查我们，”卡杜说。 “不是黎巴嫩国家、局外人或各方，”他指的是真主党及其盟友。 “他们只是对村子说‘回去吧，回去吧’。我们回来后发现没有生活必需品——没有电，没有水。”

paras.en: Kadouh has a son in the Lebanese army and another in national security services but he says, because the Lebanese army is deliberately underequipped to avoid presenting a threat to Israel, they have never been allowed to do their jobs.
paras.zh: 卡杜的一个儿子在黎巴嫩军队服役，另一个儿子在国家安全部门服役，但他表示，由于黎巴嫩军队故意装备不足，以避免对以色列构成威胁，因此他们从未被允许履行职责。

paras.en: "The Lebanese state never sent a soldier here to protect us," he says." That is why the parties and others came in — Hezbollah or Amal or even the Palestinian factions decades ago. "But the vacuum that the Lebanese state has left brought us to this tragedy" he says.
paras.zh: “黎巴嫩政府从未派一名士兵来这里保护我们，”他说。这就是为什么各派和其他势力介入的原因——几十年前是真主党、阿迈勒运动，甚至是巴勒斯坦各派。“但黎巴嫩政府留下的真空地带将我们带入了这场悲剧。”他说。

paras.en: "We love the Lebanese army — let them bring us an army, but let them protect us," he says. "This army has a rifle — Israel has an F-35" fighter jet.
paras.zh: “我们热爱黎巴嫩军队——让他们为我们带来一支军队，但让他们保护我们，”他说。 “这支军队有一支步枪——以色列有一架F-35”战斗机。

paras.en: "But we would rather sit in the dirt," he says. "Our soul, our life is here, I was born here."
paras.zh: “但我们宁愿坐在泥土里，”他说。 “我们的灵魂、我们的生命都在这里，我出生在这里。”

paras.en: Kadouh says maybe someday there will be peace with Israel, but after all the deaths and destruction, not in his lifetime — and not with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 卡杜说，也许有一天会与以色列实现和平，但在经历了所有的死亡和破坏之后，这不是在他有生之年，也不是与以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的和平。

paras.en: "Netanyahu is the one who killed my son. Let him bring back my son," he says. "If just yesterday Israel killed my son, am I supposed to tell the Israelis, 'Put your hand in my hand'? If they want to be our neighbors they should do good. Instead they burn us."
paras.zh: “内塔尼亚胡是杀害我儿子的人。让他带回我的儿子，”他说。 “如果昨天以色列杀了我的儿子，我是否应该告诉以色列人，‘把手放在我的手上’？如果他们想成为我们的邻居，他们应该做好事。相反，他们会烧死我们。”

articles.title: Jim Beam to pause production at flagship Kentucky distillery in major shift for iconic American whiskey brand

paras.en: Jim Beam will indefinitely pause production at its historic flagship distillery in Clermont, Kentucky, amid declining whiskey sales and record inventories.
paras.zh: 由于威士忌销量下降和库存创纪录，金边将无限期暂停其位于肯塔基州克莱蒙的历史悠久的旗舰酿酒厂的生产。

paras.en: The iconic American whiskey brand, owned by Japanese multinational brewing and distilling company Suntory Global Spirits, announced last December that it would pause production at its Clermont, Kentucky facility for one year, with plans to resume operations in 2027, Food Dive reported.
paras.zh: 据 Food Dive 报道，日本跨国酿酒和蒸馏公司三得利全球烈酒公司 (Suntory Global Spirits) 旗下的标志性美国威士忌品牌去年 12 月宣布，将暂停肯塔基州克莱蒙工厂的生产一年，并计划于 2027 年恢复运营。

paras.en: However, in a new development, it is now uncertain when the Clermont distillery will begin operations again, the company told The Courier Journal.
paras.zh: 然而，该公司告诉《信使日报》，在新的发展中，克莱蒙酿酒厂何时重新开始运营目前还不确定。

paras.en: Suntory told the outlet that it manages its Kentucky production in accordance with demand, inventory and long-term needs.
paras.zh: 三得利告诉媒体，它根据需求、库存和长期需求来管理肯塔基州的生产。

paras.en: The company noted that it plans to reassess production needs in the future.
paras.zh: 该公司指出，计划未来重新评估生产需求。

paras.en: In the meantime, Jim Beam has moved production to its nearby Booker Noe Distillery in Boston, Kentucky, which, with an output of 45 million original proof gallons annually, is the brand’s largest distillery, according to Food Dive.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Jim Beam 已将生产转移到附近位于肯塔基州波士顿的 Booker Noe 酿酒厂，据 Food Dive 称，该酿酒厂每年产量为 4500 万加仑，是该品牌最大的酿酒厂。

paras.en: The brand's Fred B. Noe distillery, located on the Clermont facility's campus, will continue its operations producing whiskey labels including Knob Creek, Little Book and Booker's, Inc. reported.
paras.zh: 据报道，该品牌位于克莱蒙工厂园区的 Fred B. Noe 酿酒厂将继续生产威士忌品牌，包括 Knob Creek、Little Book 和 Booker's, Inc.。

paras.en: Fox News Digital reached out to Jim Beam and the brand’s parent company, Suntory Holdings, for comment.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字媒体联系了占边 (Jim Beam) 和该品牌的母公司三得利控股 (Suntory Holdings)，请其置评。

paras.en: Jim Beam’s move comes amid an ongoing decrease in consumer demand for whiskey, with large quantities of the spirit sitting untouched.
paras.zh: Jim Beam 此举正值消费者对威士忌的需求持续下降，大量威士忌未受影响。

paras.en: Whiskey inventory in the U.S. is three times higher than estimated annual demand, global beverage alcohol data and insight firm IWSR reported in October.
paras.zh: 全球饮料酒精数据和洞察公司 IWSR 10 月份报告称，美国的威士忌库存是预计年需求量的三倍。

paras.en: "The unifying theme across Scotch, US, Japanese and Irish whiskey is polarisation by price tier: we are seeing growth narrowing to specific bands within each whisky sub-category, rather than spreading across the price ladder," said Marten Lodewijks, IWSR managing director and president.
paras.zh: IWSR 董事总经理兼总裁 Marten Lodewijks 表示：“苏格兰威士忌、美国威士忌、日本威士忌和爱尔兰威士忌的统一主题是按价格等级两极分化：我们看到增长缩小到每个威士忌子类别内的特定区间，而不是在整个价格阶梯上扩散。”

paras.en: "And in most cases, that growth is concentrating at the premium end, while the mainstream and value tiers absorb the pain," he added.
paras.zh: “在大多数情况下，增长集中在高端市场，而主流和价值市场则吸收了痛苦，”他补充道。

paras.en: Members of the Kentucky Distillers Association held an inventory of 16.1 million barrels of whiskey as of October 2025, according to the organization’s website.
paras.zh: 据肯塔基州酿酒商协会网站称，截至 2025 年 10 月，该协会成员持有 1610 万桶威士忌库存。

paras.en: Total beverage alcohol sales declined for the third consecutive year in 2025, according to IWSR.
paras.zh: IWSR 的数据显示，2025 年酒精饮料总销量连续第三年下降。

articles.title: Massive 17-foot shark comes face-to-face with scientists in incredible deep-sea footage

paras.en: A video making the rounds on social media Sunday shows a massive deep-water shark getting up close and personal with a group of scientists inside a submersible.
paras.zh: 周日在社交媒体上流传的一段视频显示，一条巨大的深水鲨鱼在潜水器内与一群科学家进行了近距离接触。

paras.en: And when I say up close and personal, I mean it.
paras.zh: 当我说近距离和个人时，我是认真的。

paras.en: In the footage, the shark slowly circles the vessel, seemingly just as curious about its human visitors as they are about her. At one point, she swims right up to the viewing window and presses her snout against the glass.
paras.zh: 在视频中，鲨鱼慢慢地绕着船只转，似乎对人类游客和他们对她一样好奇。有一次，她游到观察窗前，把鼻子压在玻璃上。

paras.en: The video is spectacular, but it isn't new. The encounter actually happened back in June 2019, roughly 1,700 feet beneath the surface of the Atlantic Ocean near the Bahamas.
paras.zh: 这段视频很精彩，但并不新鲜。这次遭遇实际上发生在 2019 年 6 月，地点是巴哈马群岛附近大西洋海面以下约 1,700 英尺处。

paras.en: Check out the piercing blue eye at the 52-second mark.
paras.zh: 看看 52 秒处那双锐利的蓝眼睛。

paras.en: The shark is a bluntnose sixgill, a deep-water species that can grow up to 20 feet long. Researchers estimated that the particularly inquisitive female in the video measured about 16-17 feet.
paras.zh: 鲨鱼是一种钝鼻六鳃鲨，是一种深水物种，可以长到 20 英尺长。研究人员估计，视频中这位特别好奇的女性身高约为 16-17 英尺。

paras.en: And as incredible as the footage is, the story behind it might be even cooler.
paras.zh: 尽管镜头令人难以置信，但其背后的故事可能更酷。

paras.en: Scientists got more than they bargained for during deep-sea shark expedition
paras.zh: 科学家在深海鲨鱼探险中得到的超出了他们的预期

paras.en: The encounter occurred during an expedition by OceanX, an ocean exploration organization working alongside marine scientists to study the bluntnose sixgill shark.
paras.zh: 这次遭遇发生在 OceanX 的一次探险期间，OceanX 是一个海洋探索组织，与海洋科学家一起研究钝鼻六鳃鲨。

paras.en: The team traveled to the deep waters of Exuma Sound aboard the research vessel Alucia, hoping to accomplish something that had never been done before: attach a satellite tracking tag to a sixgill shark without bringing it to the surface.
paras.zh: 研究小组乘坐阿露西亚号研究船前往埃克苏马海峡的深水区，希望完成以前从未做过的事情：将卫星跟踪标签贴在六鳃鲨身上，而不将其带到水面。

paras.en: Previously, researchers studying these animals had to capture them and haul them up from the depths. But that process can stress the sharks and disrupt their natural behavior, making it difficult to collect reliable data about how they actually live.
paras.zh: 此前，研究这些动物的研究人员必须捕获它们并将它们从深处拖上来。但这个过程会给鲨鱼带来压力并扰乱它们的自然行为，从而很难收集有关它们实际生活方式的可靠数据。

paras.en: Using OceanX's three-person submersible, Nadir, the team descended into the darkness with roughly 100 pounds of bait to attract the sharks.
paras.zh: 使用 OceanX 的三人潜水器 Nadir，团队带着大约 100 磅的诱饵潜入黑暗中来吸引鲨鱼。

paras.en: After several unsuccessful attempts involving bad weather, equipment problems and even a grouper that interfered with the tagging process, the researchers finally got their chance on June 29.
paras.zh: 经过几次尝试均未成功，包括恶劣天气、设备问题，甚至石斑鱼干扰了标记过程，研究人员终于在 6 月 29 日得到了机会。

paras.en: According to the Florida Museum of Natural History, scientist Gavin Naylor successfully attached a satellite tag to a male sixgill shark more than 1,700 feet underwater.
paras.zh: 据佛罗里达自然历史博物馆称，科学家加文·内勒成功地将卫星标签贴在水下 1,700 多英尺的雄性六鳃鲨身上。

paras.en: It was the first time scientists had successfully tagged one at depth in its natural habitat.
paras.zh: 这是科学家第一次成功地在其自然栖息地深处对其进行标记。

paras.en: But the team also encountered several other sharks during the dive, including the enormous female that stars in the viral video.
paras.zh: 但研究小组在潜水过程中还遇到了其他几条鲨鱼，其中包括视频中出现的巨大雌性鲨鱼。

paras.en: "She was studying us," Naylor told the Florida Museum. "It was delightful for me to see a shark being curious. We'd be arrogant to think we were the only ones doing the evaluating."
paras.zh: “她在研究我们，”内勒告诉佛罗里达博物馆。 “看到鲨鱼好奇，我很高兴。如果我们认为我们是唯一进行评估的人，那就太傲慢了。”

paras.en: Prehistoric giants are just casually lurking in the deep
paras.zh: 史前巨人只是随意潜伏在深处

paras.en: Bluntnose sixgill sharks are among the largest predatory sharks in the ocean, although most people will never see one. That's because these animals spend much of their lives hundreds or even thousands of feet below the surface. Some have been documented at depths approaching 6,500 feet.
paras.zh: 钝鼻六鳃鲨是海洋中最大的掠食性鲨鱼之一，尽管大多数人永远不会看到它。这是因为这些动物一生中的大部分时间都在地表以下数百甚至数千英尺的地方度过。其中一些已被记录在接近 6,500 英尺的深度。

paras.en: They're also pretty much living fossils. According to the Florida Museum, sixgills closely resemble sharks that swam the oceans roughly 200 million years ago.
paras.zh: 它们也几乎是活化石。据佛罗里达博物馆称，六鳃鲨与大约 2 亿年前在海洋中游动的鲨鱼非常相似。

paras.en: Way down there, sixgills aren't generally a threat to humans. They spend their days hunting fish, squid and other marine life, occasionally scavenging larger carcasses.
paras.zh: 在深处，六鳃鱼一般不会对人类构成威胁。它们整天捕猎鱼类、鱿鱼和其他海洋生物，偶尔也会捕食较大的尸体。

paras.en: And considering how little we still know about what goes on in the depths of our oceans, it's pretty fascinating to think about what else might be lurking down there.
paras.zh: 考虑到我们对海洋深处发生的事情仍然知之甚少，思考那里可能还潜藏着什么是非常有趣的。
