articles.title: This Self-Charging Toothbrush Has Bristles That Generate Electricity to Help Kill Bacteria That Cause Cavities and Gum Disease

paras.en: Researchers in China have reinvented a familiar tool: the toothbrush.
paras.zh: 中国的研究人员重新发明了一种熟悉的工具：牙刷。

paras.en: Brushing your teeth is an important part of your oral care routine. Both regular and electric toothbrushes rely on physically scrubbing away bacteria that can cause cavities and gum disease. But a new design, described November 4 in the journal Science Advances, features bristles that generate bacteria-killing electricity when they bend, perhaps providing a long-awaited update to the hygiene tool.
paras.zh: 刷牙是日常口腔护理的重要组成部分。普通牙刷和电动牙刷都依靠物理方式清除可能导致蛀牙和牙龈疾病的细菌。但 11 月 4 日《科学进展》杂志上描述的一种新设计，其特点是刷毛弯曲时会产生杀菌电流，这或许为卫生工具带来了期待已久的更新。

paras.en: “Toothbrushes have undergone no substantive improvements beyond their mechanical function for about 1118 years to date,” the researchers write in the study. “Conventional toothbrushes often fail to establish an antibacterial environment on the tooth surface, allowing bacteria to recover and recolonize. Here, we developed an innovative self-charged toothbrush that integrates daily tooth brushing with piezoelectric functionality.”
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究报告中写道：“迄今为止，大约 1118 年以来，牙刷除了机械功能之外没有发生任何实质性改进。” “传统牙刷往往无法在牙齿表面建立抗菌环境，从而使细菌得以恢复和重新定殖。在这里，我们开发了一种创新的自充电牙刷，它将日常刷牙与压电功能融为一体。”

paras.en: Piezoelectric materials generate electricity when put under mechanical stress, like being squeezed or compressed. In the new study, researchers applied this property to the toothbrush by creating bristles from polyvinylidene fluoride, a material that produces an electrical charge when it bends.
paras.zh: 压电材料在受到机械应力（例如挤压或压缩）时会发电。在这项新研究中，研究人员通过用聚偏二氟乙烯制造刷毛，将这种特性应用到牙刷上，聚偏二氟乙烯是一种弯曲时会产生电荷的材料。

paras.en: The electricity doesn’t directly zap oral bacteria, however. Instead, the charge creates highly unstable molecules called reactive oxygen species in the saliva. These molecules disrupt the membranes of bacteria in dental plaque—a sticky layer of the harmful organisms, along with food particles and spit.
paras.zh: 然而，电流并不会直接杀死口腔细菌。相反，电荷会在唾液中产生高度不稳定的分子，称为活性氧。这些分子会破坏牙菌斑中的细菌膜（有害生物的粘性层）以及食物颗粒和唾液。

paras.en: “The concept is great,” Nicholas Jakubovics, an oral microbiologist at Newcastle University in England who did not participate in the research, tells New Scientist’s Christa Lesté-Lasserre. “Basically, the mechanical forces recharge the surface, so it’s really innovative. Anything that even slightly improves the way dental care works could have a benefit, because oral disease is just so widespread.” Experts estimate that almost 3.7 billion people worldwide have oral diseases, such as gum disease and tooth decay.
paras.zh: “这个概念很棒，”英国纽卡斯尔大学口腔微生物学家 Nicholas Jakubovics（未参与这项研究）告诉《新科学家》杂志的 Christa Lesté-Lasserre。 “基本上，机械力会为表面充电，因此它确实具有创新性。任何稍微改善牙科护理工作方式的方法都可能会带来好处，因为口腔疾病非常普遍。”专家估计，全世界有近 37 亿人患有口腔疾病，例如牙龈疾病和蛀牙。

paras.en: The researchers first conducted lab tests of the piezoelectric toothbrush using two key oral pathogens: Streptococcus mutans, which causes cavities, and Porphyromonas gingivalis, which causes gum disease. The charge-producing bristles killed about half of the cavity-causing bacteria and more than half of the gum disease agent present, while traditional nylon bristles eliminated only about 9 percent and 8 percent, respectively.
paras.zh: 研究人员首先使用两种主要的口腔病原体对压电牙刷进行了实验室测试：引起蛀牙的变形链球菌和引起牙龈疾病的牙龈卟啉单胞菌。产生电荷的刷毛可以杀死大约一半的蛀牙细菌和一半以上的牙龈疾病病原体，而传统的尼龙刷毛只能分别杀死大约 9% 和 8%。

paras.en: Then, they moved to a human trial. The team enrolled 115 participants with tooth decay or mild gum disease, called gingivitis. They asked some people to use the electricity-generating toothbrushes and others to use nylon-bristled brushes twice a day for three months.
paras.zh: 然后，他们进行了人体试验。该团队招募了 115 名患有蛀牙或轻度牙龈疾病（称为牙龈炎）的参与者。他们要求一些人使用发电牙刷，另一些人使用尼龙毛刷，每天两次，持续三个月。

paras.en: At the end of the study period, participants who brushed with the experimental tool had less plaque, gum inflammation and bleeding than regular toothbrush users, the team found.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，在研究结束时，使用实验工具刷牙的参与者比普通牙刷使用者的牙菌斑、牙龈炎症和出血更少。

paras.en: “It’s great to have new approaches that actually enhance the effect of mechanical cleaning,” Jakubovics tells Live Science’s Isha Ishtiaq. “The idea that the toothbrush surface itself is actively doing something is really interesting.”
paras.zh: “能够真正增强机械清洁效果的新方法真是太棒了，”Jakubovics 告诉 Live Science 的 Isha Ishtiaq。 “牙刷表面本身正在积极地做一些事情，这个想法真的很有趣。”

paras.en: One of the limits of the research, however, is the clinical trial’s short duration, he notes. “We would want to make sure that it is safe on the tissues for long-term use.”
paras.zh: 然而，这项研究的局限性之一是临床试验的持续时间较短，他指出。 “我们希望确保长期使用它在组织上是安全的。”

paras.en: Frank Scannapieco, a periodontist and microbiologist at the University of Buffalo who did not participate in the study, agrees that more research is necessary to prove the toothbrush is safe and effective, per Nature’s Elizabeth Gibney.
paras.zh: 布法罗大学牙周病学家和微生物学家弗兰克·斯坎纳皮科（Frank Scannapieco）没有参与这项研究，但据《自然》杂志的伊丽莎白·吉布尼（Elizabeth Gibney）报道，他同意需要进行更多研究来证明牙刷的安全性和有效性。

paras.en: This isn’t the first time researchers have taken a swing at upgrading toothbrushes. Previous designs have included bristles with antibacterial chemicals, but researchers aren’t sure if they have a lasting effect. Others produced charged particles to help clean teeth, but these require batteries.
paras.zh: 这并不是研究人员第一次尝试升级牙刷。以前的设计包括含有抗菌化学物质的刷毛，但研究人员不确定它们是否具有持久效果。其他人产生带电粒子来帮助清洁牙齿，但这些需要电池。

paras.en: “The toothbrush is humanity’s mightiest soldier in the battle against dental plaque,” according to a statement. The researchers behind the new study “have now upgraded this warrior.”
paras.zh: 一份声明称：“牙刷是人类对抗牙菌斑的最强大的战士。”这项新研究背后的研究人员“现在已经升级了这个战士”。

paras.en: Still, there’s a long way to go before this upgrade can sit on pharmacies’ oral health shelves.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，要让这一升级产品登上药店的口腔健康货架，还有很长的路要走。

articles.title: Have Archaeologists Finally Pieced Together the 'Parthenon Puzzle,' One of Ancient Greece's Greatest Mysteries?

paras.en: When the Parthenon was built some 2,500 years ago atop the Acropolis of Athens, one of the temple’s facades stood out for its striking imagery. Stretching for nearly 100 feet above the building’s eastern entrance, the marble-carved pediment depicted Athena being birthed from the head of a nearly 13-foot-tall Zeus; they were flanked on either side by 37 other intricately sculpted figures, including gods and goddesses. For its fine craftsmanship and potent symbolism, the pediment is widely considered by scholars to be one of antiquity’s most famous images.
paras.zh: 大约 2,500 年前，当帕台农神庙在雅典卫城顶上建成时，神庙的其中一个外墙因其引人注目的图像而引人注目。大理石雕刻的山形墙在建筑东入口上方延伸近 100 英尺，描绘了雅典娜从近 13 英尺高的宙斯头上诞生的情景；它们的两侧各有 37 个其他复杂的雕塑人物，其中包括男神和女神。由于其精湛的工艺和强有力的象征意义，山形墙被学者们广泛认为是古代最著名的图像之一。

paras.en: But no one alive today has ever looked upon the scene in its original glory. Sometime between the fifth century C.E. and 1670, the pediment was largely destroyed—fires, earthquakes and humans all played roles in its destruction. Only 20 percent of the ruins were recovered, and these fragments have since been scattered to museums across the world. Piecing together what the original artwork may have looked like has intrigued historians for centuries. Now, a team of researchers believe they have finally reached a solution to the Parthenon puzzle.
paras.zh: 但今天还活着的人都没有见过这个场景原来的辉煌。公元 5 世纪至 1670 年间，山墙大部分被毁——火灾、地震和人类活动都在其毁坏中发挥了作用。只有 20% 的废墟被回收，这些碎片随后被分散到世界各地的博物馆。几个世纪以来，历史学家一直对原始艺术作品的外观拼凑起来感兴趣。现在，一组研究人员相信他们终于找到了帕特农神庙之谜的解决方案。

paras.en: Open this week at the Liebieghaus Sculpture Collection in Frankfurt, Germany, “Athena, the Stage is Yours: The Parthenon Puzzle” offers visitors a chance to see what the institution is calling the first-ever “archaeologically grounded proposal” for what the pediment once looked like.
paras.zh: 本周，“雅典娜，舞台是你的：帕台农神庙之谜”在德国法兰克福利比格豪斯雕塑收藏馆开幕，为参观者提供了一个机会，一睹该机构所称的第一个“基于考古的提案”，了解山墙曾经的样子。

paras.en: “For around 200 years, archaeological research has sought to reconstruct the lost overall appearance of the Parthenon’s east pediment,” Philipp Demandt, the museum’s director, says in a statement. “With this exhibition, we are presenting our findings to the public for the first time and inviting visitors to take a fresh look at and discuss one of the most significant works of art from antiquity.”
paras.zh: “大约 200 年来，考古研究一直致力于重建帕台农神庙东山墙失去的整体外观，”博物馆馆长菲利普·德曼特 (Philipp Demandt) 在一份声明中说道。 “通过这次展览，我们首次向公众展示我们的发现，并邀请参观者重新审视和讨论古代最重要的艺术作品之一。”

paras.en: Recreating the image took decades of dedicated research. The museum’s effort was led by Vinzenz Brinkmann and his wife, Ulrike Koch-Brinkmann, who are both archaeologists. They began by referencing the most complete, existing body of work about the pediment. In the early 20th century, Arthur Hamilton Smith, a curator at the British Museum, produced plaster casts of more than 200 small surviving fragments from the pediment and meticulously documented their known placements in relation to each other.
paras.zh: 重建图像需要数十年的专门研究。博物馆的工作由 Vinzenz Brinkmann 和他的妻子 Ulrike Koch-Brinkmann 领导，他们都是考古学家。他们首先参考了有关山墙饰的最完整的现有著作。 20 世纪初，大英博物馆馆长阿瑟·汉密尔顿·史密斯 (Arthur Hamilton Smith) 用 200 多个幸存的三角墙小碎片制作了石膏模型，并仔细记录了它们之间已知的位置关系。

paras.en: The duo created digital renderings of these pieces, which still left massive gaps in the overall pediment. They then began scouring archives around the world for unidentified clues to the original design. A breakthrough came during a trip to the Hermitage Museum in St. Petersburg, Russia, in 2014. There, they observed an ancient Roman sarcophagus with a relief on its lid depicting the birth of Athena. The scene resembled nearly exactly what scholars envisioned of the pediment.
paras.zh: 两人对这些作品进行了数字渲染，但在整体山墙饰上仍然留下了巨大的空白。然后他们开始在世界各地的档案中搜寻原始设计的不明线索。 2014 年，他们在参观俄罗斯圣彼得堡艾尔米塔什博物馆时取得了突破。在那里，他们观察到了一座古罗马石棺，棺盖上有浮雕，描绘了雅典娜的诞生。这一场景几乎与学者们对山墙饰的想象一模一样。

paras.en: Brinkmann and Koch-Brinkmann are also noted for their painstaking work to accurately recreate the original color schemes of classical white marble statues. For authenticity, they used the same mineral and organic pigments available to the ancients.
paras.zh: 布林克曼和科赫-布林克曼还因其精确再现古典白色大理石雕像的原始配色方案的艰苦工作而闻名。为了保证真实性，他们使用了与古人相同的矿物和有机颜料。

paras.en: “It was really a chance discovery,” Brinkmann tells the Art Newspaper’s Catherine Hickley. “We noticed a figural relief on the lid of a sarcophagus that was clearly closely related to the composition of the east pediment. It refers to the few surviving figures from the corners of the pediment, such as Helios and Selene with their chariots, but also to figures that have repeatedly been proposed as having belonged to the east pediment, such as the Horae [and] Moirai.”
paras.zh: “这确实是一个偶然的发现，”布林克曼告诉《艺术报》的凯瑟琳·希克利。 “我们注意到石棺盖上的人物浮雕，显然与东山墙饰的构成密切相关。它指的是山墙饰角落里幸存的少数人物，例如赫利俄斯和塞勒涅及其战车，但也指那些一再被认为属于东山墙饰的人物，例如霍拉[和]莫伊莱。”

paras.en: Brinkmann’s team studied nine sarcophagi in total, mostly in the Vatican Museum and elsewhere in Rome. “The Romans copied everything the Greeks did,” he explains to the Art Newspaper.
paras.zh: 布林克曼的团队总共研究了九个石棺，大部分位于梵蒂冈博物馆和罗马其他地方。 “罗马人复制了希腊人所做的一切，”他向《艺术报》解释道。

paras.en: While no single sarcophagus showed the entire 39-figure scene, they each showed different aspects of the pediment, which the researchers were able to piece together digitally, with the help of 3D scanners. Earlier scholars noticed this connection between sarcophagi lids and the pediment, Brinkmann tells Deutsche Welle’s Katharina Abel. “But we really seized on the idea and never let go.”
paras.zh: 虽然没有一个石棺展示了整个 39 尊雕像的场景，但它们都展示了山形墙的不同方面，研究人员能够在 3D 扫描仪的帮助下以数字方式将其拼凑在一起。布林克曼告诉德国之声的凯瑟琳娜·阿贝尔，早期学者注意到石棺盖和山形墙之间的这种联系。 “但我们确实抓住了这个想法，从未放弃。”

paras.en: The researchers searched for missing artifacts that could piece together the lost scene. On the surviving fragments they studied drill holes and the edges of broken shards for clues about adjacent pieces. They referenced ancient texts for possible descriptions of the pediment’s positioning. They identified lost sculptures and worked with international institutions to ask and answer new questions as they arose.
paras.zh: 研究人员寻找丢失的文物，以拼凑出丢失的场景。在幸存的碎片上，他们研究了钻孔和破碎碎片的边缘，以寻找有关相邻碎片的线索。他们参考了古代文献来寻找对三角墙的位置的可能描述。他们识别了丢失的雕塑，并与国际机构合作提出并回答出现的新问题。

paras.en: “Piece by piece, the puzzle came together to form a new, archaeologically grounded overall picture of the Parthenon’s east pediment,” Brinkmann says in the statement.
paras.zh: 布林克曼在声明中说：“拼图一块一块地拼凑在一起，形成了一幅新的、以考古为基础的帕台农神庙东山墙的整体图景。”

paras.en: Inside the exhibit, the reconstructed pediment is presented as a 13 foot-long, 3D-printed model, at a scale of 1:7.7 compared to the original. There are also life-size reproductions of the largely missing central figures, Zeus, Athena and Hera, based on surviving fragments and comparable sculptures. Casts of the well-preserved figures at opposite ends of the pediment—Helios, the sun god, and Selene, the moon goddess—mark the passing of time from day to night. A colorful animation created especially for the exhibition brings the tale to life through a retelling of the myth of Athena’s birth.
paras.zh: 在展览中，重建的山墙饰以 13 英尺长的 3D 打印模型的形式呈现，与原始山墙墙的比例为 1:7.7。还有根据幸存的碎片和类似雕塑制作的基本失踪的中心人物宙斯、雅典娜和赫拉的真人大小复制品。山墙两端保存完好的雕像——太阳神赫利俄斯和月亮女神塞勒涅——标志着时间从白天到黑夜的流逝。专为展览制作的彩色动画通过重述雅典娜诞生的神话，将故事带入生活。

paras.en: “Research belongs in the public sphere. In particular, a museum can demonstrate how scientific knowledge is generated by interpreting traces, asking questions and correlating different sources,” Ina Hartwig, who heads the city of Frankfurt’s Department of Culture and Science, says in a statement. “The exhibition makes this process immediately comprehensible to visitors.”
paras.zh: “研究属于公共领域。特别是，博物馆可以通过解释痕迹、提出问题和关联不同来源来展示科学知识是如何产生的，”法兰克福市文化和科学部负责人伊娜·哈特维格(Ina Hartwig)在一份声明中表示。 “展览让参观者可以立即理解这一过程。”

paras.en: “Athena, the Stage is Yours: The Parthenon Puzzle” is on view at the Liebieghaus Sculpture Collection in Frankfurt through July 25, 2027.
paras.zh: “雅典娜，舞台是你的：帕台农神庙之谜”将于 2027 年 7 月 25 日在法兰克福 Liebieghaus 雕塑收藏馆展出。

articles.title: The NIH Has Decided to Move Its Last Group of Retired Research Chimpanzees to an Animal Sanctuary Next Year

paras.en: Roughly three dozen chimpanzees currently live at the Keeling Center for Comparative Medicine and Research in Bastrop, Texas. They used to serve as subjects in scientific studies. Next year, however, these primates—the last federally owned chimps at an American research facility—will move to a retirement home at an animal sanctuary, according to an announcement by the National Institutes of Health (NIH) on November 18.
paras.zh: 目前大约有三打黑猩猩生活在德克萨斯州巴斯特罗普的基林比较医学和研究中心。它们曾经作为科学研究的对象。然而，根据美国国立卫生研究院 (NIH) 11 月 18 日的公告，明年这些灵长类动物（美国研究机构中最后一批联邦拥有的黑猩猩）将搬到动物保护区的养老院。

paras.en: “Completing their transfers will fulfill NIH’s commitment, announced in November 2015, to retire all NIH-owned chimpanzees to sanctuary,” says Jay Bhattacharya, director of the agency, in the statement.
paras.zh: “完成它们的转移将履行 NIH 于 2015 年 11 月宣布的承诺，将 NIH 拥有的所有黑猩猩退休到庇护所，”该机构主任杰伊·巴塔查亚 (Jay Bhattacharya) 在声明中表示。

paras.en: The move has been a long time in the making. In 2000, the Chimpanzee Health Improvement Maintenance Protection (CHIMP) Act established a national sanctuary system for chimps no longer needed for federal biomedical research. Then, in 2015, the NIH announced it would end its funding and support of all research on the primate species. The agency committed to retire all its approximately 300 chimps and move them to Chimp Haven, a 200-acre federal sanctuary in Keithville, Louisiana.
paras.zh: 这一举措已经酝酿了很长时间。 2000 年，《黑猩猩健康改善维护保护 (CHIMP) 法案》为联邦生物医学研究不再需要的黑猩猩建立了国家保护区系统。随后，2015 年，美国国立卫生研究院 (NIH) 宣布将终止对所有灵长类动物研究的资助和支持。该机构承诺将其大约 300 只黑猩猩全部退休，并将它们转移到路易斯安那州基斯维尔占地 200 英亩的黑猩猩避难所联邦保护区。

paras.en: But the plan proceeded slowly. In 2019, the NIH veterinary panel determined that the 44 federally owned chimpanzees at the Alamogordo Primate Facility in New Mexico were too old or ill to move. Many of the retirees were near the upper end of their life expectancy in captivity and had severe health problems like heart disease. Two years later, the agency decided the same for the 51 primates at the Keeling Center and the 11 at the Southwest National Primate Research Center in San Antonio, Texas.
paras.zh: 但计划进展缓慢。 2019 年，美国国立卫生研究院 (NIH) 兽医小组认定，新墨西哥州阿拉莫戈多灵长类动物设施中的 44 只联邦政府拥有的黑猩猩年龄太大或病重，无法移动。许多退休人员在囚禁期间已接近预期寿命的上限，并且患有心脏病等严重的健康问题。两年后，该机构对基林中心的 51 只灵长类动物和德克萨斯州圣安东尼奥市西南国家灵长类动物研究中心的 11 只灵长类动物做出了同样的决定。

paras.en: However, in 2024, staffing changes at Alamogordo and public pressure—including a lawsuit filed by animal welfare organizations—forced the NIH to shift its plans for the remaining chimps at the facility. They finally moved to Chimp Haven last year, meaning only the Keeling Center chimps remained at an NIH facility, given that the Southwest National Primate Research Center stopped receiving funding from the agency.
paras.zh: 然而，2024 年，阿拉莫戈多的人员变动和公众压力（包括动物福利组织提起的诉讼）迫使 NIH 改变了对该设施中剩余黑猩猩的计划。去年，它们终于搬到了黑猩猩避难所，这意味着，鉴于西南国家灵长类研究中心停止接受该机构的资助，只有基林中心的黑猩猩留在 NIH 设施中。

paras.en: Although one elderly Alamogordo chimp died on the way to the sanctuary, the transfer prompted NIH leadership to revisit the potential transfer of Keeling Center animals, Bhattacharya says in the statement. “After careful analysis and internal consultations, NIH leadership decided to proceed.”
paras.zh: 巴塔查亚在声明中表示，尽管一只老年阿拉莫戈多黑猩猩在前往保护区的途中死亡，但这次转移促使美国国立卫生研究院领导层重新考虑基林中心动物的潜在转移。 “经过仔细分析和内部协商，NIH 领导层决定继续进行。”

paras.en: Animal advocacy organizations have welcomed the news.
paras.zh: 动物保护组织对这一消息表示欢迎。

paras.en: “This has been a long road and something that many people thought would never happen,” says Kathleen Conlee, vice president of animal research issues at the Humane World for Animals, to Emily Anthes at the New York Times. “It’s a really historic moment. This will be the end of the government’s use and confinement of chimps in labs.”
paras.zh: “这是一条漫长的道路，许多人认为永远不会发生，”动物人道世界负责动物研究问题的副总裁凯瑟琳·康利 (Kathleen Conlee) 对《纽约时报》的艾米丽·安西斯 (Emily Anthes) 说道。 “这确实是一个历史性的时刻。这将是政府在实验室中使用和限制黑猩猩的结束。”

paras.en: Biomedical research groups, on the other hand, oppose the transfer. They argue that the aging chimps would be safer staying at a place with staff they know, reports David Grimm at Science.
paras.zh: 另一方面，生物医学研究团体则反对转让。据《科学》杂志的大卫·格林报道，他们认为，年老的黑猩猩和他们认识的工作人员呆在一个地方会更安全。

paras.en: “These are sensitive and intelligent beings with complex social histories that include strong relationships with their chimp and human families,” says Cindy Buckmaster, former chair of Americans for Medical Progress, an advocacy organization that supports humane animal research, to Science.
paras.zh: “这些是敏感而聪明的生物，有着复杂的社会历史，其中包括与黑猩猩和人类家族的牢固关系，”支持人道动物研究的倡导组织美国医学进步协会前主席辛迪·巴克马斯特对《科学》杂志说。

paras.en: At the Keeling Center, chimps have access to large, open enclosures, she says. “They have everything they need where they are. We should leave them be and let them live the rest of their lives in peace.”
paras.zh: 她说，在基林中心，黑猩猩可以进入大型开放式围栏。 “他们拥有他们所需要的一切。我们应该离开他们，让他们平静地度过余生。”

paras.en: Staff at Chimp Haven, for their part, are excited to welcome the animals. The primates from Alamogordo appear to be acclimating well, says Rana Smith, the sanctuary’s president and CEO, to the Times. They hope to receive all the Keeling Center chimps by the end of next year, with some transfers beginning in January.
paras.zh: 黑猩猩天堂的工作人员很高兴欢迎这些动物。保护区主席兼首席执行官拉纳·史密斯 (Rana Smith) 向《泰晤士报》表示，阿拉莫戈多的灵长类动物似乎适应得很好。他们希望在明年年底之前接收所有基林中心的黑猩猩，其中一些转移从一月份开始。

paras.en: “When that very last chimp arrives from the Keeling Center, I think that is a milestone moment,” Smith says. “We’re just happy to be a part of it and provide the chimps with their happy ending.”
paras.zh: “当最后一只黑猩猩从基林中心抵达时，我认为这是一个里程碑时刻，”史密斯说。 “我们很高兴能成为其中的一部分，为黑猩猩带来幸福的结局。”

articles.title: Best Laptops for Travel (2026): Which to Take on the Road
articles.author: Luke Larsen

paras.en: As a laptop reviewer, I have plenty of devices to choose from when I travel for work. In some cases, my favorite overall laptop doesn’t translate into the one I want to travel with. When I’m squeezed into a plane, I’ll choose maximum battery life and portability over features like a bigger screen or more ports.
paras.zh: 作为一名笔记本电脑评测者，当我出差时，我有很多设备可供选择。在某些情况下，我最喜欢的整体笔记本电脑并不能转化为我想要携带的笔记本电脑。当我被挤进飞机时，我会选择最大的电池寿命和便携性，而不是更大的屏幕或更多的端口等功能。

paras.en: Fortunately, there are many great travel laptops, and you’ll still appreciate them when you aren’t on the road. Of the hundreds of laptops I’ve tested in my life, here are the ones I always choose to travel with.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，有很多很棒的旅行笔记本电脑，当您不在路上时，您仍然会欣赏它们。在我一生中测试过的数百台笔记本电脑中，以下是我总是选择随身携带的笔记本电脑。

paras.en: If there’s an obvious pick for the best travel laptop, it’s the Dell XPS 13. It’s been the best compact laptop you can buy for years, and that’s even more true in its latest incarnation. The key dimension to pay attention to on the XPS 13 is the depth, which is crucial for air travel. At 7.9 inches, it’s among the smallest laptops you can buy. Those economy-class seat-back tray tables on airplanes are only around 10 inches deep, and while that’s technically enough to accommodate even a 16-inch MacBook Pro, whether you can actually open the lid and use the laptop is another question. The XPS 13 is even smaller than the MacBook Neo, despite having a larger screen.
paras.zh: 如果有一个明显的最佳旅行笔记本电脑选择，那就是戴尔 XPS 13。多年来，它一直是您可以购买的最好的紧凑型笔记本电脑，在其最新版本中更是如此。 XPS 13 需要注意的关键尺寸是深度，这对于航空旅行至关重要。它的尺寸为 7.9 英寸，是您能买到的最小的笔记本电脑之一。飞机上的经济舱座椅靠背小桌板深度只有 10 英寸左右，虽然从技术上讲这足以容纳 16 英寸的 MacBook Pro，但能否真正打开盖子并使用笔记本电脑则是另一个问题。尽管屏幕更大，但 XPS 13 甚至比 MacBook Neo 还要小。

paras.en: The XPS 13 achieves this by using a 13.4-inch display (measured diagonally), compared to many of the 14-inch laptops on this list. Second, it has very narrow bezels around that screen, minimizing the device’s overall footprint. While 14-inch laptops have become more popular in recent years, that bigger display size also increases the overall footprint—and every millimeter counts when working on a plane. The XPS 13 still has enough room for your palms when typing (unless you have huge hands), and the keyboard is among my favorites to type on.
paras.zh: 与此列表中的许多 14 英寸笔记本电脑相比，XPS 13 通过使用 13.4 英寸显示屏（对角线测量）来实现这一目标。其次，它的屏幕边框非常窄，最大限度地减少了设备的整体占地面积。虽然 14 英寸笔记本电脑近年来变得越来越流行，但更大的显示屏尺寸也增加了整体占地面积 - 在飞机上工作时，每一毫米都很重要。 XPS 13 在打字时仍然有足够的空间容纳你的手掌（除非你有很大的手），而且键盘是我最喜欢打字的键盘之一。

paras.en: The other two major advantages for travel are weight and battery life. This little laptop only weighs 2.2 pounds, a full half-pound lighter than the 13-inch MacBook Air. You might forget you have it in your backpack while traveling.
paras.zh: 旅行的另外两个主要优势是重量和电池寿命。这款小型笔记本电脑仅重 2.2 磅，比 13 英寸 MacBook Air 轻了整整半磅。旅行时您可能会忘记背包里有它。

paras.en: Now, the XPS 13 isn't the most powerful laptop in the world—at least not the cheaper models. The standard version comes with only 8 GB of RAM and an Intel chip with only two Performance cores. It’s good enough for basic web tasks, but for real work, you might run into limitations. You can address this by opting for the 16 GB model (which keeps the price under $1,000) or upgrading to the much more powerful Core Ultra 7 355 processor. The latter is much more expensive and comes with twice the storage, but it doesn’t add extra weight or size. Regardless of the chip you choose, the XPS 13 gets absolutely fantastic battery life. It depends on what you're doing with it, but you could easily work through a long international flight without worrying about plugging in.
paras.zh: 现在，XPS 13 并不是世界上最强大的笔记本电脑，至少不是更便宜的型号。标准版本仅配备 8 GB RAM 和只有两个性能核心的 Intel 芯片。对于基本的 Web 任务来说它已经足够好了，但对于实际工作，您可能会遇到限制。您可以通过选择 16 GB 型号（价格低于 1,000 美元）或升级到功能更强大的 Core Ultra 7 355 处理器来解决此问题。后者要贵得多，并且存储空间是原来的两倍，但不会增加额外的重量或尺寸。无论您选择哪种芯片，XPS 13 都能获得绝对出色的电池续航时间。这取决于您用它做什么，但您可以轻松地完成长途国际航班，而无需担心充电问题。

paras.en: If weight is your primary concern, the Asus Zenbook A14 is another contender. Despite being larger overall than the XPS 13 (with a bigger screen), the Zenbook A14 weighs 2.16 pounds—a hair lighter than the Dell. That’s seriously impressive, and I still remember how astounded I was when I first picked it up. Asus debuts its “ceraluminum” material in the chassis, which gives you the sturdiness of aluminum with the lightness of plastic. It’s not quite as rigid as metal, but it’s not as flimsy as ultra-light laptops in the past.
paras.zh: 如果重量是您最关心的问题，那么华硕 Zenbook A14 是另一个竞争者。尽管整体比 XPS 13（屏幕更大）大，但 Zenbook A14 的重量为 2.16 磅，比戴尔轻了一根头发丝。这真是令人印象深刻，我仍然记得当我第一次拿起它时我是多么惊讶。华硕在机箱中首次采用“陶瓷铝”材料，既具有铝的坚固性，又具有塑料的轻盈性。它不像金属那么坚硬，但也不像过去的超轻笔记本电脑那么脆弱。

paras.en: If you’re less worried about working on the plane and more about lugging a laptop around, the Zenbook A14 is a good choice. The Zenbook A14 has several advantages over the XPS 13 that can be helpful on the go, including built-in ports like a headphone jack, USB-A, and HDMI. If you’re working out of a remote office or presenting to a client, these can definitely come in handy. The XPS 13 only has two USB-C ports and nothing else.
paras.zh: 如果您不太担心在飞机上工作，而更担心携带笔记本电脑到处走动，那么 Zenbook A14 是一个不错的选择。与 XPS 13 相比，Zenbook A14 具有多项优势，可以在旅途中提供帮助，包括耳机插孔、USB-A 和 HDMI 等内置端口。如果您在远程办公室工作或向客户演示，这些绝对可以派上用场。 XPS 13 只有两个 USB-C 端口，没有其他端口。

paras.en: There are a number of different versions of the Asus Zenbook A14 floating around out there. I’d stay away from the 8 GB model Asus sells and opt for the 16 GB model instead. There’s also a newer model that uses the Snapdragon X2 Elite chip, but I don’t think it’s worth the extra $450—especially not for a laptop focused on travel.
paras.zh: 市面上有许多不同版本的华硕 Zenbook A14。我不会选择华硕销售的 8 GB 型号，而是选择 16 GB 型号。还有一款使用 Snapdragon X2 Elite 芯片的较新型号，但我认为它不值得额外支付 450 美元，尤其是对于专注于旅行的笔记本电脑而言。

paras.en: The 13-inch MacBook Air also makes a great travel laptop. It’s relatively small, thanks to its 13.6-inch screen.
paras.zh: 13 英寸 MacBook Air 也是一款出色的旅行笔记本电脑。由于其 13.6 英寸的屏幕，它相对较小。

paras.en: In terms of portability, its main advantage over the XPS 13 and Zenbook A14 is its thinness. At 0.42 inches, it’s the thinnest laptop out there—and it doesn’t stick huge rubber feet on the bottom to compensate like other laptops do, such as the Razer Blade 14. You might not think thickness matters much in a travel laptop, but if you’re squeezing stuff into a backpack, every extra millimeter matters.
paras.zh: 在便携性方面，它相对于 XPS 13 和 Zenbook A14 的主要优势在于它的轻薄。它的厚度为 0.42 英寸，是市面上最薄的笔记本电脑，而且它不像其他笔记本电脑（例如 Razer Blade 14）那样在底部贴上巨大的橡胶脚垫来进行补偿。您可能认为厚度对于旅行笔记本电脑来说并不重要，但如果您将东西挤进背包中，那么每一毫米都非常重要。

paras.en: The MacBook Neo is also worth mentioning here. It’s not quite as thin as the MacBook Air, but because its screen is 0.4 inches smaller, it has a more compact overall footprint. Battery life is the bigger issue when taking the Neo on a trip, as it doesn’t last as long as the MacBook Air or Dell XPS 13. The 8 GB of RAM limitation doesn’t affect its use as a travel laptop much, but it's something to consider for a work laptop in general. That said, it has a very pretty screen for a laptop at this price.
paras.zh: MacBook Neo 在这里也值得一提。它不像 MacBook Air 那样薄，但由于其屏幕小了 0.4 英寸，因此整体占地面积更加紧凑。携带 Neo 旅行时，电池续航时间是一个更大的问题，因为它的续航时间不如 MacBook Air 或戴尔 XPS 13。8 GB RAM 限制不会对其作为旅行笔记本电脑的使用产生太大影响，但对于一般工作笔记本电脑来说，这是需要考虑的。也就是说，对于这个价位的笔记本电脑来说，它的屏幕非常漂亮。

paras.en: Budget laptops aren’t typically known for being particularly lightweight and travel-worthy. Most of them struggle, especially with battery life. The HP OmniBook 5 might be an exception. You can usually find it on sale for under $700, even with 16 GB of RAM and an OLED display.
paras.zh: 经济型笔记本电脑通常并不以特别轻巧和适合旅行而闻名。他们中的大多数人都在挣扎，尤其是在电池寿命方面。 HP OmniBook 5 可能是一个例外。即使配备 16 GB RAM 和 OLED 显示屏，您通常也能以低于 700 美元的价格找到它。

paras.en: The OmniBook 5 isn’t quite as compact as the MacBook Neo because of its larger screen, but it is also half an inch thick and weighs only 2.8 pounds. The Snapdragon X Plus also delivers solid battery life, plenty to feel comfortable traveling with. It’s not a laptop without compromises (like the poor touchpad), but it comes with 16 GB of RAM, unlike some other laptops at this price. That’s a solid deal if you need something to travel with on a budget.
paras.zh: 由于屏幕较大，OmniBook 5 不像 MacBook Neo 那样紧凑，但厚度也只有半英寸，重量仅为 2.8 磅。 Snapdragon X Plus 还提供稳定的电池续航时间，让您在旅行时倍感舒适。它不是一台没有任何妥协的笔记本电脑（比如糟糕的触摸板），但它配备了 16 GB RAM，与这个价位的其他一些笔记本电脑不同。如果您需要在预算范围内携带一些旅行物品，那么这是一个不错的选择。

paras.en: Good question. Tablets can make for great travel devices because of their size and ease of use. If you need a proper keyboard and touchpad—and the app support to handle a typical workday—you’re probably better off getting a laptop.
paras.zh: 好问题。平板电脑因其尺寸和易用性而成为出色的旅行设备。如果您需要合适的键盘和触摸板以及应用程序支持来处理典型的工作日，那么您最好购买笔记本电脑。

paras.en: The Surface Pro 12 is the two-in-one laptop I’d recommend first. It’s absolutely tiny for a computer, even though it runs the full version of Windows 11. Even with the detachable keyboard connected, it weighs only 1.8 pounds. The only real problem with bringing this on a plane is the kickstand, which adds some extra depth. It’s just small enough that it should fit while open on an airplane tray table, unlike the 13.8-inch Surface Pro model.
paras.zh: Surface Pro 12 是我首先推荐的二合一笔记本电脑。尽管它运行完整版的 Windows 11，但对于一台计算机而言，它绝对很小。即使连接了可拆卸键盘，它的重量也仅为 1.8 磅。将其带上飞机的唯一真正问题是支架，它增加了一些额外的深度。与 13.8 英寸 Surface Pro 型号不同，它足够小，打开时可以放在飞机托盘桌上。

paras.en: Of course, that kickstand is also a huge advantage for the Surface Pro 12 if you’re using it without the keyboard. While that would make work difficult, it’s ideal for watching movies. Set this up on your tray table with some movies downloaded, and you’ll be the envy of your aisle. And when you need to get some work done in a coffee shop or at a smaller table, you’ll be happy to have access to the keyboard and touchpad—both of which are very comfortable to use. Just know that it's sold separately.
paras.zh: 当然，如果您在没有键盘的情况下使用 Surface Pro 12，该支架对于 Surface Pro 12 来说也是一个巨大的优势。虽然这会让工作变得困难，但它非常适合看电影。把它放在你的小桌上，下载一些电影，你就会成为过道上的羡慕对象。当您需要在咖啡店或较小的桌子上完成一些工作时，您会很高兴能够使用键盘和触摸板，这两者使用起来都非常舒适。只要知道它是单独出售的。

paras.en: The iPad Air, paired with the Magic Keyboard, avoids the Surface Pro 12’s kickstand issue. And with only an 11-inch screen, it’s perfect for use in small spaces—with or without the keyboard (note that there is also a 13-inch version). If you can accomplish all your work on an iPad, more power to ya! The iPad Air should give you everything you need, so long as you get the Magic Keyboard. If your travels involve more leisurely activities, the iPad Air is a great device for reading by the pool or for playing games.
paras.zh: iPad Air 与妙控键盘搭配使用，避免了 Surface Pro 12 的支架问题。它只有 11 英寸的屏幕，非常适合在狭小的空间中使用——无论有没有键盘（请注意，还有 13 英寸版本）。如果您可以在 iPad 上完成所有工作，那就更强大了！只要您拥有妙控键盘，iPad Air 就能满足您所需的一切。如果您的旅行涉及更多休闲活动，iPad Air 是在泳池边阅读或玩游戏的绝佳设备。

paras.en: One benefit of this latest version of the iPad Air is not only its performance (thanks to the M4 chip inside) but also the front-facing camera, which has been moved to landscape for more natural-feeling video calls. Of course, you could also opt for the 11-inch iPad Pro for extra performance (and the incredible tandem OLED screen). It’s also slightly thinner and lighter, though I don't think it's worth the significant price difference.
paras.zh: 最新版本 iPad Air 的优势之一不仅在于其性能（得益于内部的 M4 芯片），还在于前置摄像头，该摄像头已移至横向，以实现更自然的视频通话。当然，您也可以选择 11 英寸 iPad Pro 以获得额外的性能（以及令人难以置信的串联 OLED 屏幕）。它也稍微更薄更轻，但我认为不值得这么大的价格差异。

paras.en: Lastly, there’s definitely room here for laptops with 360-degree hinges—a different class of two-in-one laptops. I haven’t tested a recent Windows device with this form factor that I truly loved, but there’s no question it works well on an airplane. Just fold the screen back with the keyboard face down, and you have the perfect screen for watching movies. The Lenovo Yoga 9i 14 is a gorgeous option, though it’s incredibly expensive right now. But if you can afford it, you’ll love the 2-in-1 action combined with one of the slickest designs imaginable. The Framework Laptop 12 is also worth considering. While it’s a bit thick and heavy for a travel laptop, its smaller screen, touchscreen, and 360-degree hinge make it a good option. It’s also one of the cheaper options available, and it’s user-upgradeable.
paras.zh: 最后，这里绝对有空间容纳具有 360 度铰链的笔记本电脑——一种不同类别的二合一笔记本电脑。我还没有测试过具有我真正喜欢的这种外形尺寸的最新 Windows 设备，但毫无疑问它在飞机上运行良好。只需将屏幕向后折叠，键盘面朝下，您就拥有了观看电影的完美屏幕。联想 Yoga 9i 14 是一个不错的选择，尽管现在它的价格非常昂贵。但如果您负担得起，您一定会喜欢二合一动作与可以想象到的最时尚的设计之一。 Framework Laptop 12 也值得考虑。虽然对于旅行笔记本电脑来说它有点厚重，但其较小的屏幕、触摸屏和 360 度铰链使其成为一个不错的选择。它也是可用的更便宜的选项之一，并且用户可以升级。

paras.en: Whether you’re packing for a trip across the world or across the state, a proper travel laptop shouldn’t be heavy or overly large. That rules out 15-inch and 16-inch laptops, which are so big you can’t use them on airplane tray tables or at coffee shops. But even when you narrow it down to 14-inch laptops or smaller, there are three portability factors to consider.
paras.zh: 无论您是准备环游世界还是跨州旅行，合适的旅行笔记本电脑都不应该太重或太大。这就排除了 15 英寸和 16 英寸笔记本电脑，它们太大了，无法在飞机托盘桌上或咖啡店使用。但即使将范围缩小到 14 英寸或更小的笔记本电脑，也需要考虑三个便携性因素。

paras.en: - Thickness: The size of the laptop with the lid closed matters for travel, especially if you’re trying to stuff your bag with as much as possible (like I usually am). Thicker laptops also tend to be heavier. The MacBook Air is the standard bearer here at 0.42 inches thick, but I’d consider anything under 0.6 inches thin enough to travel with.
paras.zh: - 厚度：笔记本电脑合上盖子后的尺寸对于旅行来说很重要，尤其是当您想尽可能多地装东西时（就像我通常做的那样）。较厚的笔记本电脑也往往较重。 MacBook Air 是这里的标准，厚度为 0.42 英寸，但我认为任何厚度低于 0.6 英寸的设备都足以随身携带。

paras.en: - Dimensions: The laptop’s depth (measured from the bottom of the trackpad to the hinge) determines whether it fits on small tables. The width matters in some cases, especially if you’re trying to fit it into a smaller bag. Larger laptops are around 9 or 10 inches deep, while smaller ones like the Dell XPS 13 are under 8 inches.
paras.zh: - 尺寸：笔记本电脑的深度（从触控板底部到铰链测量）决定了它是否适合小桌子。在某些情况下，宽度很重要，尤其是当您试图将其放入较小的包中时。较大的笔记本电脑深度约为 9 或 10 英寸，而较小的笔记本电脑（如戴尔 XPS 13）深度低于 8 英寸。

paras.en: - Weight: This one is obvious, perhaps, but the difference between a 4-pound laptop and a 2-pound laptop is noticeable. When you’re on your feet for hours with lots of luggage, the lighter the load, the better. These days, I'd consider anything under 3 pounds to be light enough to travel with, while the ones closer to 2 pounds (like the Asus Zenbook A14) are among the lightest you can buy.
paras.zh: - 重量：这一点也许是显而易见的，但 4 磅笔记本电脑和 2 磅笔记本电脑之间的差异是显而易见的。当您带着大量行李连续行走数小时时，负载越轻越好。如今，我认为任何重量低于 3 磅的设备都足够轻，可以随身携带，而重量接近 2 磅的设备（如华硕 Zenbook A14）是您可以购买的最轻的设备之一。

paras.en: When you’re on the go, you want a laptop that doesn’t constantly make you worry about finding an outlet. Bringing a laptop power bank can help, but the biggest factor in staying sane while traveling is a device that can stay on. Many factors affect how long a laptop can last, including CPU efficiency, battery wattage, screen brightness and resolution, and more.
paras.zh: 当您在旅途中时，您想要一台不会经常让您担心找不到插座的笔记本电脑。带上笔记本电脑充电宝会有所帮助，但在旅行时保持理智的最大因素是可以保持开机状态的设备。许多因素会影响笔记本电脑的续航时间，包括 CPU 效率、电池瓦数、屏幕亮度和分辨率等。

paras.en: Long-lasting laptops, such as the Dell XPS 13, will get you through a long flight. The processor is the main thing to look out for. Qualcomm’s Snapdragon X series of chips are battery-efficient, as are Apple’s M-series chips. Intel also has some highly efficient CPUs in its most recent lineup, though you’ll need to pay close attention to the model number, as it can vary wildly depending on the specific CPU you’re using. To dig deeper, read my extensive guide on How to Buy the Right Laptop, which breaks down different CPU options.
paras.zh: 耐用的笔记本电脑（例如戴尔 XPS 13）将帮助您度过长途飞行。处理器是需要关注的主要内容。高通的 Snapdragon X 系列芯片具有电池效率，苹果的 M 系列芯片也是如此。英特尔在其最新的产品系列中也有一些高效的 CPU，但您需要密切关注型号，因为它可能会根据您使用的特定 CPU 的不同而有很大差异。要深入了解，请阅读我关于如何购买合适的笔记本电脑的详细指南，其中详细介绍了不同的 CPU 选项。

paras.en: The size of seat-back tray tables varies. There’s no exact size because of various factors, such as the airline, aircraft, cabin, and seat. Remember: Just because a laptop can physically fit on a tray table doesn’t mean you’ll have space to open and use it. With that in mind, here are the general averages to keep in mind. Airlines do not list tray table sizes, but you can expect one in economy to measure around 16 x 9 inches, while premium cabins will have larger tables depending on the seat.
paras.zh: 座椅靠背托盘桌的尺寸各不相同。由于航空公司、飞机、机舱和座位等多种因素的影响，没有确切的尺寸。请记住：仅仅因为笔记本电脑可以放在小桌板上，并不意味着您就有空间打开和使用它。考虑到这一点，以下是需要牢记的一般平均值。航空公司没有列出小桌板尺寸，但经济舱的小桌板尺寸约为 16 x 9 英寸，而高级客舱的小桌板尺寸则较大，具体取决于座位。

paras.en: I’ve included both tablets and laptops in my recommendations, but your choice will depend on why you’re traveling with a device. If it’s for a vacation and you really only need a device to read, watch, and play on (perhaps with the occasional email check), a tablet works perfectly. Lounging with a tablet, whether on a plane or by the pool, feels much more leisurely than using a laptop. More importantly, it'll help you avoid dipping back into work mode. Whether an Android tablet, iPad, or Windows tablet, just pair it with a compatible keyboard case—and you’re good to go.
paras.zh: 我的推荐中包括了平板电脑和笔记本电脑，但您的选择将取决于您携带设备旅行的原因。如果是为了度假，而您确实只需要一台设备来阅读、观看和玩耍（也许偶尔检查一下电子邮件），那么平板电脑就可以完美发挥作用。无论是在飞机上还是在泳池边，闲逛时使用平板电脑都比使用笔记本电脑感觉更悠闲。更重要的是，它将帮助您避免重新陷入工作模式。无论是 Android 平板电脑、iPad 还是 Windows 平板电脑，只需将其与兼容的键盘盒配对即可开始使用。

paras.en: However, if you’re traveling for work (or need to work while traveling), a proper laptop will be better. The one you already have may work just fine, but frequent fliers know they prefer a more compact device. And more specifically, a small laptop with a keyboard and trackpad will work better on your lap or on small desks than a tablet.
paras.zh: 但是，如果您出差旅行（或需要在旅行时工作），那么合适的笔记本电脑会更好。您已有的设备可能工作得很好，但经常乘坐飞机的人知道他们更喜欢更紧凑的设备。更具体地说，带有键盘和触控板的小型笔记本电脑比平板电脑更适合放在腿上或小桌子上。

articles.title: Our Top Tested Picks From Tineco’s Black Friday Sale (2026)
articles.author: Louryn Strampe

paras.en: Black Friday is associated with deals on high-end electronics, but it's also one of the best times of the year to pick up some new home essentials. Tineco makes some fantastic cleaning gadgets, and right now, many of our WIRED-tested favorites are on sale for up to 60 percent off. I've rounded up the highlights below, and you can check out the full sale here.
paras.zh: 黑色星期五与高端电子产品的促销有关，但它也是一年中购买一些新的家居必需品的最佳时机之一。 Tineco 制造了一些非常棒的清洁小工具，目前，许多经过 WIRED 测试的最爱产品都以高达 60% 的折扣进行促销。我总结了下面的重点内容，您可以在此处查看完整的促销信息。

paras.en: We're covering tons of early Black Friday deals and will be ramping up our deals coverage throughout Cyber Monday.
paras.zh: 我们正在报道大量早期的黑色星期五优惠，并将在整个网络星期一扩大我们的优惠报道。

paras.en: The Tineco Pure One Station 5 is a very solid cordless vacuum. We like its self-emptying docking station that's easy to set up (no drilling or fancy installation required). There's a handy headlight that makes it easier to spot dirt and debris, and we like the large canister capacity. It performs better on hardwood than on carpet, though. This is the best price we've seen for it.
paras.zh: Tineco Pure One Station 5 是一款非常坚固的无绳吸尘器。我们喜欢它的自清坞站，它易于设置（无需钻孔或精美的安装）。有一个方便的头灯，可以更容易地发现灰尘和碎片，而且我们喜欢大容量的罐子。不过，它在硬木上的表现比在地毯上更好。这是我们见过的最优惠的价格。

paras.en: This carpet cleaner is on the heavy side, but it's one of our favorites, especially with its easy-to-rinse tanks for the dirty and clean water. There's a large LED screen that shows which cleaning mode you're in, and the drying mode gets everything dried off in a flash. It'll pull old stains from your carpet and even comes with an accessory for upholstery.
paras.zh: 这款地毯清洁剂虽然重，但它是我们的最爱之一，尤其是它易于冲洗脏水和干净水的水箱。有一个大 LED 屏幕，显示您所处的清洁模式，而干燥模式则可以瞬间干燥所有东西。它可以去除地毯上的旧污渍，甚至还配有室内装饰配件。

paras.en: I haven't tested the newer version of this steam mop yet, but I've been testing models from other brands for an update to that buying guide, and this older Floor One S7 still holds up. It looks great on its docking station, and it cleans my floors efficiently without leaving behind too much water. It does struggle along baseboards, but I truthfully have yet to meet a steam mop that doesn't. It is easy to maneuver with its self-propulsion and also has a handy light that'll show you cleaning progress as you pass over an area. I like the built-in suction too, which means I don't have to use two gadgets to clean one floor.
paras.zh: 我还没有测试过这款蒸汽拖把的新版本，但我一直在测试其他品牌的型号以更新购买指南，而这款旧版 Floor One S7 仍然有效。它在扩展坞上看起来很棒，并且可以有效地清洁我的地板，而不会留下太多水。它确实很难沿着底板移动，但说实话，我还没有遇到过这样的蒸汽拖把。它具有自驱动功能，易于操作，并且还配有方便的灯，可以在您经过某个区域时显示清洁进度。我也喜欢内置吸力，这意味着我不必使用两个小工具来清洁一层地板。

articles.title: Sony Bravia 9 II Review (2026): Adjustable and Bright
articles.author: John Brandon

paras.en: The current flagship television from Sony, the Bravia 9 II, is an RGB TV model (Sony calls it “True RGB”) that brings to life even the darkest scenes in Game of Thrones. Much brighter than the midrange Bravia 7 II, the 9 II's best qualities are related to its black levels, picture quality, and excellent viewing angles that allow me to see Jon Snow and the GoT dragons perfectly, even when I'm sitting off to the side.
paras.zh: 索尼目前的旗舰电视 Bravia 9 II 是一款 RGB 电视型号（索尼称之为“True RGB”），即使是《权力的游戏》中最黑暗的场景也能栩栩如生。 9 II 比中端 Bravia 7 II 明亮得多，其最佳品质与它的黑电平、图像质量和出色的视角有关，这些角度让我即使坐在一边也能完美地看到琼恩·雪诺和 GoT 龙。

paras.en: This premium Sony television carries a premium price of $3,600 for the 65-inch model, but that’s still $1,400 less than the LG Micro RGB Evo, which retails for $5,000. I ended up preferring the overall picture quality of that LG model and some other OLED models, but—after my usual rigorous testing—I felt the Bravia 9 II came close to matching the high caliber of those other options. In fact, it’s just a notch or two lower than the absolute best television you might find.
paras.zh: 这款优质索尼电视的 65 英寸型号售价为 3,600 美元，但仍比零售价 5,000 美元的 LG Micro RGB Evo 低 1,400 美元。我最终更喜欢 LG 型号和其他一些 OLED 型号的整体图像质量，但经过我一贯的严格测试后，我觉得 Bravia 9 II 接近与其他选项的高品质相匹配。事实上，它只比您可能找到的绝对最好的电视低一两个档次。

paras.en: The Sony Bravia 9 II is all black, sits on two feet, and includes four HDMI ports (only two are HDMI 2.1, though, which allows for higher-bandwidth streaming and sound at 48 Gbps). Setup was a breeze; Google TV was up and running in less than five minutes, which is an impressive feat, given that both Samsung and LG televisions typically add a few extra steps to the install process, such as authenticating your login (with Samsung) or relying on an app (with the LG ThinQ).
paras.zh: 索尼 Bravia 9 II 是全黑的，有两个脚，包括四个 HDMI 端口（不过，只有两个是 HDMI 2.1，可实现 48 Gbps 的更高带宽流媒体和声音）。设置过程轻而易举； Google TV 在不到五分钟的时间内就启动并运行了，这是一个令人印象深刻的壮举，因为三星和 LG 电视通常都会在安装过程中添加一些额外的步骤，例如验证您的登录（使用三星）或依赖应用程序（使用 LG ThinQ）。

paras.en: The premium Sony Bravia 9 II also offers exceptional sound. It includes two upfiring tweeters for more realistic Dolby Atmos than the Bravia 7 II, which lacks these extra channels. When I watched House of the Dragon, the room-filling audio made me feel like I was flying a dragon or piloting a ship.
paras.zh: 优质的索尼 Bravia 9 II 还提供卓越的音质。它包括两个上发式高音扬声器，比 Bravia 7 II 更逼真的杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos)，而 Bravia 7 II 缺乏这些额外的声道。当我观看《龙之屋》时，充满整个房间的音频让我感觉自己在驾驶一条龙或驾驶一艘船。

articles.title: Gorillaz, CHVRCHES, Yung Lean & More: 5 Best Moments in Mexico City’s Corona Capital (Day 1)
articles.author: Isabela Raygoza

paras.en: Corona Capital’s opening day on Friday (Nov. 20) marked Gorillaz’s highly anticipated return to Mexico City after eight years away. The band delivered an emotional set packed with hits and gave a special shoutout to Mexico and its president. The British collective also brought out veteran guitarist Johnny Marr and Argentine rapper Trueno as special guests.
paras.zh: Corona Capital 于周五（11 月 20 日）开业，标志着 Gorillaz 在阔别八年后重返墨西哥城，备受期待。乐队演奏了充满激情的歌曲，并向墨西哥及其总统表示特别的赞扬。英国乐队还邀请了资深吉他手约翰尼·马尔和阿根廷说唱歌手特鲁诺作为特邀嘉宾。

paras.en: “I f— with Mexico because you have a revolutionary spirit here,” Gorillaz frontman Damon Albarn told the crowd. “This is an inspirational country.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢墨西哥，因为这里有革命精神，”Gorillaz 主唱达蒙·阿尔巴恩 (Damon Albarn) 对人群说道。 “这是一个鼓舞人心的国家。”

paras.en: The first day of the festival’s 16th edition featured established acts and rising artists across indie, soul, electro-pop, folk and contemporary rap. Female artists — performing solo or with their bands — were especially well represented, including CHVRCHES, Violet Grohl, Olivia Dean, CMAT, Grace Ives, Anna Luna and Darianna Everett.
paras.zh: 第 16 届音乐节的第一天，云集了独立音乐、灵魂乐、电子流行音乐、民谣和当代说唱等领域的知名表演者和新兴艺术家。女性艺术家——独奏或与乐队一起表演——尤其有代表性，包括 CHVRCHES、Violet Grohl、Olivia Dean、CMAT、Grace Ives、Anna Luna 和 Darianna Everett。

paras.en: Some 72,000 people attended the rock-filled day, according to promoter Ocesa. They also caught sets from James Blake, Mumford & Sons, Yung Lean, The Kooks, Jamie xx and Durand Jones & The Indications, among others.
paras.zh: 据发起人 Ocesa 称，约有 72,000 人参加了这一充满岩石的活动。他们还观看了 James Blake、Mumford & Sons、Yung Lean、The Kooks、Jamie xx 和 Durand Jones & The Inspirations 等公司的作品。

paras.en: The enthusiastic crowd kept the energy high throughout the marathon day of music, which stretched into the early hours of Saturday (Nov. 21) at Curva 4, the Formula 1 venue in Mexico City.
paras.zh: 在墨西哥城一级方程式赛车场 Curva 4 举行的音乐马拉松日中，热情的人群一直保持着高昂的能量，一直持续到周六（11 月 21 日）凌晨。

paras.en: Saturday’s lineup included Twenty One Pilots, The Offspring, Balu Brigada, Pierce the Veil, Underworld, Sébastien Tellier and Peaches and more. On Sunday (Nov. 21), The Strokes will be headlining the festival. Other performing acts will include The xx, Lola Young, Lil Yachty, The Black Crowes, Santigold, Manic Street Preachers, Tricky and more.
paras.zh: 周六的演出阵容包括二十一名飞行员、The Offspring、Balu Brigada、Pierce the Veil、Underworld、Sébastien Tellier 和 Peaches 等。周日（11 月 21 日），The Strokes 将成为音乐节的主角。其他表演团体包括 The xx、Lola Young、Lil Yachty、The Black Crowes、Santigold、Manic Street Preachers、Tricky 等。

paras.en: Here are five of the best moments from day one of Corona Capital 2026.
paras.zh: 以下是 Corona Capital 2026 第一天以来的五个最佳时刻。

paras.en: - The Triumphant Return of Gorillaz Gorillaz, Damon Albarn and Jamie Hewlett’s famous collective, returned to Mexico City after eight years for a memorable performance, with guitarist Johnny Marr and Argentine rapper Trueno joining as special guests. Albarn, the former Blur frontman, also praised Mexico’s “revolutionary spirit” and gave a shout-out to President Claudia Sheinbaum. Gorillaz headlined the festival’s opening day with a set focused mainly on their 2026 album The Mountain and the hits that have made the group one of pop’s biggest acts. Marr, former guitarist for The Smiths, joined the band for “The Empty Dream Machine” and “Casablanca.” Trueno came out for “THE MANIFESTO” and freestyled on “Clint Eastwood,” which closed the set. Mexican singer Luisa Almaguer also joined Gorillaz for “Latin Simone (Que Pasa Contigo),” originally recorded with the late Cuban star Ibrahim Ferrer for the band’s self-titled debut album.
paras.zh: - Gorillaz 凯旋归来 Gorillaz、达蒙·阿尔本 (Damon Albarn) 和杰米·休利特 (Jamie Hewlett) 组成的著名乐队时隔八年重返墨西哥城，进行了一场令人难忘的演出，吉他手约翰尼·马尔 (Johnny Marr) 和阿根廷说唱歌手特鲁诺 (Trueno) 作为特邀嘉宾加入。前 Blur 主唱阿尔巴恩也赞扬了墨西哥的“革命精神”，并向总统克劳迪娅·谢因鲍姆大声喊叫。 Gorillaz 的演出成为了音乐节开幕日的头条新闻，主要聚焦于他们 2026 年的专辑《The Mountain》以及使该乐队成为流行音乐界最伟大艺人之一的热门歌曲。马尔是史密斯乐队的前吉他手，加入乐队制作了“The Empty Dream Machine”和“Casablanca”。特鲁诺在《THE MANIFESTO》中出场，并在《克林特·伊斯特伍德》中即兴表演，结束了演出。墨西哥歌手路易莎·阿尔马格尔 (Luisa Almaguer) 也与 Gorillaz 一起录制了《拉丁西蒙 (Que Pasa Contigo)》，该歌曲最初是与已故古巴明星易卜拉欣·费雷 (Ibrahim Ferrer) 一起录制的乐队首张同名专辑。

paras.en: - CHVRCHES Bring Out New Songs The Scottish trio, led by vocalist Lauren Mayberry, surprised Mexican fans with new songs set to appear on their upcoming album, All The King’s Men. New singles “Roses” and “Evil,” which will be featured on the LP due in January, stood out for their memorable melodies and expansive synths. Classics like “Forever” and “Miracle” made for emotional moments with longtime fans.
paras.zh: - CHVRCHES 推出新歌 由主唱 Lauren Mayberry 领衔的苏格兰三人组合为墨西哥歌迷带来了他们即将发行的专辑《All The King's Men》中的新歌。新单曲“Roses”和“Evil”将于一月份收录在唱片中，它们以其令人难忘的旋律和广阔的合成器而脱颖而出。 《永远》和《奇迹》等经典歌曲为老粉丝带来了激动人心的时刻。

paras.en: - Violet Grohl Makes a Powerful Debut Violet Grohl, daughter of Dave Grohl — the Foo Fighters frontman and former Nirvana drummer — made her debut on Friday at the same Mexican festival her famous father has previously conquered. Backed by her rock band, the singer-songwriter showed she’s carrying on the family name with a direct, high-energy set featuring songs like “Bug In The Cake,” “THUM,” “Last Day I Loved You” and “Cool Buzz.”
paras.zh: - 维奥莱特·格罗尔 (Violet Grohl) 首次亮相在她的摇滚乐队的支持下，这位歌手兼作曲家通过一首直接、充满活力的歌曲展示了她继承了家族的名字，其中包括《Bug In The Cake》、《THUM》、《Last Day I Loved You》和《Cool Buzz》等歌曲。

paras.en: - Yung Lean, A Contemporary Rap Icon Swedish rapper Yung Lean, who won over the internet and a generation of listeners with his cloud rap and contemporary hip-hop sound, was also one of the day’s most anticipated acts. He took the main stage to show why he’s considered one of today’s standout artists in the genre, performing songs including “Ghostown,” “Kyoto,” “Forever Yung,” “Pikachu,” “Yoshi City” and “STORM II,” as well as his remix of Charli xcx’s “360.”
paras.zh: - Yung Lean，当代说唱偶像 瑞典说唱歌手 Yung Lean 以其云说唱和当代嘻哈音乐赢得了互联网和一代听众的青睐，也是当天最受期待的表演之一。他登上主舞台，展示了为什么他被认为是当今该流派中的杰出艺术家之一，表演的歌曲包括《Ghosttown》、《Kyoto》、《Forever Yung》、《皮卡丘》、《Yoshi City》和《STORM II》，以及他对 Charli xcx 的《360》的混音版。

paras.en: - Durand Jones & The Indications Bring Classic Soul Back to Life The U.S. band Durand Jones & The Indications also made its debut at the popular Mexican festival, drawing thousands to the NIVEA stage with a blend of contemporary R&B and soul. The group brought a sexy, danceable vibe to the evening with its upbeat, retro-soul sound, getting the crowd moving to songs like “Circles,” “The Way That I Do,” “Love Will Work It Out” and “Flower Moon.”
paras.zh: - Durand Jones & The Inspirations 让经典灵魂乐重获新生 美国乐队 Durand Jones & The Inspirations 也在这个颇受欢迎的墨西哥音乐节上首次亮相，以融合当代 R&B 和灵魂乐的风格吸引了数千人来到 NIVEA 舞台。该乐队以其乐观、复古灵魂乐的声音为当晚带来了性感、适合跳舞的氛围，让观众随着《Circles》、《The Way That I Do》、《Love Will Work It Out》和《Flower Moon》等歌曲而动起来。

articles.title: Miley Cyrus Marries Maxx Morando in Poolside Ceremony Led by the Flaming Lips’ Wayne Coyne
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Miley Cyrus married Maxx Morando on Saturday (Nov. 21) in a poolside ceremony in Palm Springs, Calif., with the Flaming Lips’ Wayne Coyne officiating, one month after the couple sang “Let’s Get Married” together on the Hollywood Bowl stage.
paras.zh: 周六（11 月 21 日），麦莉·赛勒斯 (Miley Cyrus) 与马克斯·莫兰多 (Maxx Morando) 在加利福尼亚州棕榈泉举行的池畔婚礼上结婚，由 Flaming Lips 乐队成员韦恩·科因 (Wayne Coyne) 主持，一个月前，这对夫妇在好莱坞露天剧场 (Hollywood Bowl) 舞台上共同演唱了《让我们结婚吧》(Let’s Get Married)。

paras.en: Coyne, who worked with Cyrus on her 2015 album Miley Cyrus & Her Dead Petz and joined her onstage at the Hollywood Bowl in October, led the vows as Cyrus, 33, and Morando, 28, stood beneath an arch of white flowers in front of family and friends, according to photos published by People. Cyrus wore a long-sleeved white satin gown with a high neck, open back and small train, and was photographed wiping away tears during the vows, while Morando wore a black suit.
paras.zh: 根据《人物》杂志发布的照片​​，科因曾与赛勒斯合作制作了她 2015 年的专辑《Miley Cyrus & Her Dead Petz》，并于 10 月在好莱坞露天剧场 (Hollywood Bowl) 与她一起登台，33 岁的赛勒斯和 28 岁的莫兰多站在家人和朋友面前的白花拱门下，共同宣誓。赛勒斯穿着一件高领、露背和小裾长袖白色缎面礼服，被拍到在宣誓时擦眼泪，而莫兰多则穿着黑色西装。

paras.en: Among the guests were her mother, Tish Cyrus, and husband Dominic Purcell; her sister Noah Cyrus; and her father, Billy Ray Cyrus, along with Elizabeth Hurley. The celebrations began the night before with a rehearsal dinner, glimpsed in Instagram photos posted by Cyrus’ stepsister Lily-Rose Purcell that showed tables dressed with dark red flowers and small candles, and a menu topped with an “M+M” monogram.
paras.zh: 客人中有她的母亲蒂什·赛勒斯 (Tish Cyrus) 和丈夫多米尼克·珀塞尔 (Dominic Purcell)。她的妹妹诺亚·赛勒斯；和她的父亲比利·雷·赛勒斯以及伊丽莎白·赫尔利。庆祝活动从前一天晚上的彩排晚宴开始，赛勒斯的继姐妹莉莉-罗丝·珀塞尔 (Lily-Rose Purcell) 在 Instagram 上发布了照片，照片中桌子上摆满了深红色的鲜花和小蜡烛，菜单上还印有“M+M”字母组合。

paras.en: The wedding caps a year in which the relationship moved from the edges of Cyrus’ public life to the center of her work. “Let’s Get Married,” which Morando co-wrote and co-produced, appears on Bass Persuades, her 10th studio album and her first released simply as Miley. Its black-and-white video, directed by Mert Alas and shot at West Hollywood’s Chateau Marmont, casts Morando opposite her — a dress rehearsal, as it turned out, for the real thing two months later.
paras.zh: 这场婚礼标志着这一年的结束，这段关系从赛勒斯公共生活的边缘转移到了她工作的中心。莫兰多与他人共同创作并联合制作的《Let’s Get Married》收录在她的第十张录音室专辑《Bass Persuades》中，这也是她第一张以 Miley 身份发行的专辑。这段黑白视频由默特·阿拉斯 (Mert Alas) 执导，在西好莱坞的马尔蒙城堡 (Chateau Marmont) 拍摄，莫兰多 (Morando) 站在她的对面——事实证明，这是两个月后真正的彩排。

paras.en: That album also brought Cyrus back to the top of the Billboard 200, debuting at No. 1 on the chart dated Oct. 3 with 61,000 equivalent album units, according to Luminate. It gave her a sixth No. 1 album and her first since Bangerz in 2013.
paras.zh: 根据 Luminate 的数据，这张专辑还让 Cyrus 重回 Billboard 200 榜首，并在 10 月 3 日的排行榜上以 61,000 份同等专辑销量排名第一。它为她带来了第六张排名第一的专辑，也是她自 2013 年 Bangerz 以来的第一张专辑。

paras.en: It marks a striking shift for a couple who spent years largely out of view. Morando, the drummer for Los Angeles rock band Liily, was first linked to Cyrus in late 2021, when the pair attended a Gucci event together. The two had been set up on a blind date — “Well, it was blind for me and not really for him,” she told British Vogue in 2023 — and he later joined her at the 2024 Grammy Awards, where “Flowers” won record of the year. Morando proposed in October 2025 in a garden on the grounds of their hotel in Kyoto, Japan, telling Wonderland he held out “until the very last moment of the very last day” to keep it a surprise. The engagement went public in early December 2025, when Cyrus wore the ring to the Dec. 1 premiere of Avatar: Fire and Ash in Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 对于这对多年来几乎不在人们视线中的夫妇来说，这标志着一个惊人的转变。洛杉矶摇滚乐队 Liily 的鼓手莫兰多 (Morando) 于 2021 年底首次与赛勒斯 (Cyrus) 产生联系，当时两人一起参加了一场 Gucci 活动。两人被安排相亲——“嗯，这对我来说是盲目的，但对他来说却不是，”她在 2023 年告诉英国版《Vogue》——后来他和她一起参加了 2024 年格莱美奖，其中《Flowers》赢得了年度唱片。莫兰多于 2025 年 10 月在日本京都酒店的花园里求婚，他告诉 Wonderland，他“一直坚持到最后一天的最后一刻”，以保持惊喜。订婚于 2025 年 12 月初公开，当时赛勒斯戴着这枚戒指出席 12 月 1 日在洛杉矶举行的《阿凡达：火与灰》首映式。

paras.en: It is Cyrus’ second marriage, following her December 2018 wedding to Liam Hemsworth, from whom she separated the following August. Speaking at a press conference for Avatar: Fire and Ash, she described her relationship with Morando as “about starting again,” reflecting “the consciousness of a more grown and adult person of what I want this time around.”
paras.zh: 这是赛勒斯的第二次婚姻，此前她于 2018 年 12 月与利亚姆·海姆斯沃斯 (Liam Hemsworth) 结婚，并于次年 8 月与利亚姆·海姆斯沃斯 (Liam Hemsworth) 分居。在《阿凡达：火与灰》的新闻发布会上，她将自己与莫兰多的关系描述为“关于重新开始”，反映了“一个更加成熟和成熟的人对我这次想要的东西的意识”。

paras.en: Billboard has reached out to Cyrus’ representatives for comment.
paras.zh: 《公告牌》已联系赛勒斯的代表征求意见。

articles.title: Britney Spears Apologizes to Her Family on Instagram: ‘I Just Miss Them Like Crazy’
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Britney Spears posted a public apology to her family on Saturday (Nov. 21), writing on Instagram that she regretted revisiting past conflicts in public.
paras.zh: 周六（11 月 21 日），布兰妮·斯皮尔斯在 Instagram 上向家人公开道歉，并写道，她对在公开场合重提过去的冲突感到遗憾。

paras.en: “I’m so very sorry for bringing up past issues, but I think I did because I realized I needed to protect my heart,” Spears wrote. “It’s the way I love, and when I love you, I really love you.”
paras.zh: 斯皮尔斯写道：“我对提起过去的问题感到非常抱歉，但我认为我这样做是因为我意识到我需要保护我的心。” “这就是我爱的方式，当我爱你时，我真的很爱你。”

paras.en: She described her own conduct as “childish and embarrassing,” adding: “Thoughts on the past, I’m obviously human, and there actually might be something to those things I said psychology-wise; either way, I’m sorry to my family for bringing up those memories.”
paras.zh: 她形容自己的行为“幼稚且令人尴尬”，并补充道：“回想过去，我显然也是人，我说的那些话实际上可能有心理学上的道理；无论如何，我很抱歉我的家人提起了这些记忆。”

paras.en: Spears said the conversation had never taken place directly. “I’ve never actually spoken to them face to face on it,” she wrote. “I just miss them like crazy! And I’m very sorry!” She also called herself “blessed to have such a beautiful family.”
paras.zh: 斯皮尔斯表示，这次谈话从未直接进行过。 “我从未真正与他们面对面交谈过，”她写道。 “我只是疯狂地想念他们！我很抱歉！”她还称自己“很幸运拥有如此美好的家庭”。

paras.en: Spears is the eldest child of Jamie and Lynne Spears, who are divorced. She has a brother, Bryan, and a sister, Jamie Lynn Spears.
paras.zh: 斯皮尔斯是杰米·斯皮尔斯和林恩·斯皮尔斯离婚的长子。她有一个兄弟布莱恩和一个妹妹杰米·林恩·斯皮尔斯。

paras.en: The relationship has been publicly strained for years. Spears spent 13 years under a conservatorship, established in February 2008 with her father as conservator, which gave others control over her finances, career and personal decisions. After an explosive court hearing in June 2021 in which she testified against the arrangement, a Los Angeles judge suspended Jamie Spears that September and terminated the conservatorship on Nov. 12, 2021.
paras.zh: 多年来，两国关系在公开场合一直处于紧张状态。斯皮尔斯在 2008 年 2 月设立的监管机构中度过了 13 年，她的父亲担任监管人，这让其他人可以控制她的财务、职业和个人决定。 2021 年 6 月，在一次爆炸性的法庭听证会上，杰米·斯皮尔斯 (Jamie Spears) 作证反对这一安排，之后，洛杉矶法官于当年 9 月暂停了杰米·斯皮尔斯 (Jamie Spears) 的职务，并于 2021 年 11 月 12 日终止了监管。

paras.en: In the years since, Spears has repeatedly addressed the fallout. “Honestly my family embarrassed me and hurt me deeply,” she wrote in December 2021, a month after the termination. Her 2023 memoir The Woman in Me detailed her account of the arrangement, including her view that it “stripped me of my womanhood, made me into a child,” and addressed tensions with her sister.
paras.zh: 此后的几年里，斯皮尔斯多次谈到了这一后果。 “老实说，我的家人让我感到尴尬，并深深伤害了我，”她在 2021 年 12 月（终止妊娠一个月后）写道。她在 2023 年出版的回忆录《我体内的女人》详细描述了她对这一安排的描述，包括她认为这“剥夺了我的女性气质，让我变成了一个孩子”，并解决了她与姐姐之间的紧张关系。

paras.en: The sisters’ relationship had already become public: Spears sent Jamie Lynn a cease and desist letter in early 2022 over claims in her sibling’s memoir Things I Should Have Said, published two months after the conservatorship ended. The pair appeared to move toward reconciliation in mid-2023, when Spears posted about visiting the set of Jamie Lynn’s film Zoey 102.
paras.zh: 姐妹俩的关系已经公开：斯皮尔斯于 2022 年初向杰米·林恩 (Jamie Lynn) 发出了一封停止信，原因是她的姐姐在监管结束两个月后出版的回忆录《我应该说的话》(Things I Should Have Said) 中提出了指控。 2023 年年中，斯皮尔斯发布了关于参观杰米·林恩 (Jamie Lynn) 的电影《佐伊 102》(Zoey 102) 片场的消息，两人似乎走向和解。

paras.en: Spears has continued releasing music since the conservatorship ended, including “Hold Me Closer” with Elton John in 2022 and “Mind Your Business” with will.i.am in 2023. Earlier this month, a 25th anniversary edition of her self-titled third album arrived with 11 bonus tracks, five of them previously unreleased.
paras.zh: 自保护期结束以来，斯皮尔斯继续发行音乐，包括 2022 年与埃尔顿·约翰 (Elton John) 合作的《Hold Me Closer》和 2023 年与 will.i.am 合作的《Mind Your Business》。本月早些时候，她的同名第三张专辑的 25 周年纪念版上市，其中包含 11 首额外曲目，其中 5 首之前未发行。

articles.title: Luca Guadagnino Says His ‘American Psycho’ Movie Not Moving Forward
articles.author: Lexi Carson

paras.en: Luca Guadagnino‘s adaptation of American Psycho is no longer moving forward.
paras.zh: 卢卡·瓜达尼诺 (Luca Guadagnino) 改编的《美国精神病人》不再继续上映。

paras.en: While appearing on Deadline‘s Crew Call podcast with Anthony D’Alessandro, Guadagnino confirmed that his new adaptation of Bret Easton Ellis’ bestselling novel is no longer happening.
paras.zh: 在与安东尼·达历山德罗一起出现在 Deadline 的 Crew Call 播客中时，瓜达尼诺确认他对布雷特·伊斯顿·埃利斯畅销小说的新改编不再发生。

paras.en: “Scott Z. Burns wrote a fantastic script. Unfortunately for me, as we speak, it’s not happening,” Guadagnino said.
paras.zh: “斯科特·Z·伯恩斯写了一个很棒的剧本。不幸的是，对我来说，就在我们说话的时候，这并没有发生，”瓜达尼诺说。

paras.en: The Call Me by Your Name filmmaker did not elaborate on why the project is no longer moving forward. Lionsgate did not respond to The Hollywood Reporter’s request for comment.
paras.zh: 《请以你的名字呼唤我》的电影制片人没有详细说明为什么该项目不再继续推进。狮门影业没有回应《好莱坞报道》的置评请求。

paras.en: The project was first announced in October 2024, with Frenesy Films producing. At the time, it was described as a new interpretation of Ellis’ novel rather than a remake of the original film.
paras.zh: 该项目于 2024 年 10 月首次宣布，由 Frenesy Films 制作。当时，它被描述为对埃利斯小说的新诠释，而不是对原版电影的翻拍。

paras.en: “We are thrilled to add another elite filmmaker to our upcoming slate,” Lionsgate Motion Picture Group chair Adam Fogelson said in a statement at the time. “Luca is a brilliant artist, and the perfect visionary to create a whole new interpretation of this potent and classic IP.”
paras.zh: 狮门影业集团主席亚当·福格尔森当时在一份声明中表示：“我们很高兴在我们即将推出的名单中加入另一位精英电影制作人。” “卢卡是一位才华横溢的艺术家，也是对这个强大而经典的 IP 进行全新诠释的完美远见者。”

paras.en: The original 2000 film starred Christian Bale as Patrick Bateman, an investment banker living a secret life as a serial killer. Its supporting cast included Jared Leto, Willem Dafoe, Chloë Sevigny and Reese Witherspoon.
paras.zh: 2000 年的原版电影由克里斯蒂安·贝尔 (Christian Bale) 饰演帕特里克·贝特曼 (Patrick Bateman)，他是一名投资银行家，过着连环杀手的秘密生活。其配角包括杰瑞德·莱托、威廉·达福、科洛·塞维尼和瑞茜·威瑟斯彭。

paras.en: When asked about the possibility of another actor taking on the role, Bale told THR in March, “Whoever wants to give it a shot, give it a pop. I loved making it with [director] Mary Harron so many years back, fantastic memories of it all. Bold choice of anyone to try to do a — I don’t know if they’re doing a remake or what, I don’t know anything else about it. But all the best to ’em; I like brave people.”
paras.zh: 当被问及是否有其他演员出演这个角色时，贝尔在三月份告诉《好莱坞报道》，“无论谁想尝试一下，就放手一搏。多年前我就喜欢和[导演]玛丽·哈伦一起制作这个角色，这一切都是美好的回忆。任何人尝试做这个角色都是大胆的选择——我不知道他们是在翻拍还是什么，我对此一无所知。但祝他们一切顺利；我喜欢勇敢的人。”

paras.en: Up next, Guadagnino’s Artificial, starring Andrew Garfield, follows the rise of OpenAI and the 2023 firing and rehiring of CEO Sam Altman. The film is set to hit theaters on Christmas Day from Neon.
paras.zh: 接下来，由安德鲁·加菲尔德 (Andrew Garfield) 主演的 Guadagnino 的《Artificial》讲述了 OpenAI 的崛起以及 2023 年首席执行官山姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 的解雇和重新聘用。这部电影将于圣诞节在 Neon 影院上映。

articles.title: Russell Brand Selling “Free Russell” Merch Via His Wellness Business While in Prison
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Russell Brand is selling merchandise calling for his freedom while he’s behind bars after being sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison after being found guilty of rape and sexual assault.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔·布兰德 (Russell Brand) 因强奸和性侵犯罪被判 10 年零 6 个月监禁，在狱中出售呼吁自由的商品。

paras.en: It is unclear how long the items have been available for purchase on Reborn, however the earliest reviews on the varying products date to Nov. 16 (he was sentenced Nov. 9). Brand recently received backlash for sharing a message from prison, delivered by his wife, Laura Brand, on his YouTube channel where he claimed he was innocent.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚这些物品在 Reborn 上可以购买多久，但对不同产品的最早评论可以追溯到 11 月 16 日（他于 11 月 9 日被判刑）。布兰德最近因在他的 YouTube 频道上分享妻子劳拉·布兰德 (Laura Brand) 在狱中发表的一条信息而遭到强烈反对，他声称自己是无辜的。

paras.en: “So Russell has asked me to read something to you today,” the actor’s wife said at the start of the video, before looking to a notebook to read her husband’s message. “Beloved brothers and sisters in Christ, God bless you for your support. As you know, I am not guilty for the offenses I have been jailed for, so something strange is happening.”
paras.zh: “所以拉塞尔今天让我读一些东西给你听，”演员的妻子在视频开始时说道，然后看着笔记本阅读她丈夫的信息。 “亲爱的基督里的兄弟姐妹们，愿上帝保佑你们的支持。如你们所知，我对自己入狱的罪行并无罪，所以奇怪的事情发生了。”

paras.en: Brand was sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison after being found guilty of rape and sexual assault. The trial lasted four weeks at Southwark Crown Court, with the jury finding him guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault (he was found not guilty on two other rape charges and not guilty of attempted indecent assault).
paras.zh: 布兰德因强奸和性侵犯罪被判入狱 10 年零 6 个月。南华克皇家法院的审判持续了四个星期，陪审团裁定他犯有一项强奸罪和三项性侵犯罪（他被判对另外两项强奸罪无罪，并且在未遂猥亵罪中被判无罪）。

paras.en: The actor has three items featuring “Free Russell” available for purchase on the website for Reborn, his wellness business. Every item is available for $34.99; a shirt with the words “Free Russell Brand“; a hat with the same text; and another shirt that reads “Free Russell” with an image of himself.
paras.zh: 这位演员在他的健康业务 Reborn 的网站上出售了三件以“Free Russell”为主题的商品。每件商品售价 34.99 美元；一件印有“Free Russell Brand”字样的衬衫；带有相同文字的帽子；还有另一件衬衫，上面写着“释放拉塞尔”，上面有他自己的照片。

paras.en: Upon visiting the Reborn website, images of the merch are displayed on its homepage with text that reads, “Stand with Russell against injustice” and “silenced for speaking out.” After clicking on the “Free Russell” section of the site, the items are labeled as “fundraiser apparel,” with a descriptor that additionally reads, “Silenced for speaking out against injustuce and corruption.”
paras.zh: 访问 Reborn 网站后，其主页上会显示商品图片，并附有文字，“与拉塞尔站在一起反对不公正”和“因直言不讳而被沉默”。点击网站的“释放拉塞尔”部分后，这些物品被标记为“筹款服装”，并附有描述符，另外还写着“因公开反对不公正和腐败而被压制”。

paras.en: After the YouTube video was shared, Google, the parent company of YouTube, told BBC News it was “aware of the new content and our teams are investigating,” adding, “We suspended Russell Brand’s channel from the YouTube Partner Program in September 2023. The channel has not been able to monetise on YouTube since then.”
paras.zh: YouTube 视频被分享后，YouTube 的母公司谷歌告诉 BBC 新闻，它“已获悉新内容，我们的团队正在调查”，并补充道，“我们于 2023 年 9 月暂停了拉塞尔·布兰德 (Russell Brand) 频道的 YouTube 合作伙伴计划。从那时起，该频道就无法在 YouTube 上获利。”

paras.en: BBC News also reported that Google declined a request from the Ministry of Justice to remove the video, saying none of its rules had been broken.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司新闻还报道称，谷歌拒绝了司法部删除该视频的请求，称其没有违反任何规定。

paras.en: His message, delivered by his wife in the YouTube video, drew criticism, with Britain’s Justice Secretary Alex Norris calling the broadcast of a statement from Brand while he is behind bars “completely unacceptable.”
paras.zh: 他的妻子在 YouTube 视频中传达的信息引起了批评，英国司法大臣亚历克斯·诺里斯 (Alex Norris) 称在布兰德身陷囹圄期间播出布兰德的声明“完全不可接受”。

paras.en: “Prisoners are rightly banned from making statements that cause distress to victims,” Norris wrote on X. “This is being urgently investigated, and I expect action to be taken if he is found to have broken the rules.”
paras.zh: 诺里斯在 X 上写道：“囚犯被禁止发表会给受害者带来痛苦的言论，这是正确的。”“这件事正在紧急调查中，如果发现他违反了规定，我预计将采取行动。”

articles.title: Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando Are Married
articles.author: Lexi Carson

paras.en: Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando are married.
paras.zh: 麦莉·赛勒斯和麦克斯·莫兰多结婚了。

paras.en: The couple tied the knot Saturday in Palm Springs, California, according to Entertainment Tonight. TMZ first reported that Cyrus, 33, and Morando, 28, were expected to wed over the weekend.
paras.zh: 据《今夜娱乐》报道，这对夫妇周六在加利福尼亚州棕榈泉喜结连理。 TMZ 首先报道称，33 岁的赛勒斯和 28 岁的莫兰多预计将在周末结婚。

paras.en: On Friday, the Grammy winner’s stepsister Lily-Rose Purcell shared photos on her Instagram Stories from the couple’s rehearsal dinner. One photo showed the dinner tables decorated with crimson flowers, along with a menu featuring “M+M,” the couple’s initials, printed at the top.
paras.zh: 周五，这位格莱美奖得主的继姐妹莉莉-罗丝·珀塞尔在她的 Instagram Stories 上分享了这对夫妇排练晚宴的照片。一张照片显示，餐桌上装饰着深红色的花朵，菜单顶部印有“M+M”（这对夫妇的名字首字母）。

paras.en: The “Flowers” singer and Morando, also a musician, met on a blind date in 2021, she told British Vogue in 2023. The pair have also worked together, collaborating on her albums Endless Summer Vacation and Something Beautiful.
paras.zh: 她在 2023 年告诉英国《Vogue》杂志，这位《Flowers》歌手和同为音乐家的 Morando 在 2021 年相亲时相识。两人还合作过她的专辑《Endless Summer Vacation》和《Something Beautiful》。

paras.en: The couple’s engagement was confirmed in December 2025 after Cyrus debuted a shiny gold band on her left ring finger while posing for photos with Morando at the premiere of Avatar: Fire and Ash, for which she contributed the song “Dream as One.” People confirmed the engagement the following day.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月，赛勒斯在《阿凡达：火与灰》首映式上与莫兰多合影时，在左手无名指上佩戴了一枚闪亮的金色戒指，并为这首歌曲创作了歌曲《Dream as One》，这对夫妇的订婚得以确认。人们第二天就确认了订婚。

paras.en: More than two weeks after the news of their engagement broke, Us Weekly reported that the couple had “talked about eloping” instead of having a traditional wedding.
paras.zh: 在他们订婚的消息传出两周多后，《美国周刊》报道称，这对夫妇“讨论过私奔”，而不是举行传统的婚礼。

paras.en: “Miley is really happy right now and in such a good, calm place,” an insider told the publication. “She’s not super into the idea of doing another wedding.”
paras.zh: 一位内部人士告诉该刊物：“麦莉现在真的很高兴，而且在一个如此美好、平静的地方。” “她不太愿意再举办一场婚礼。”

paras.en: Cyrus was previously married to Hunger Games actor Liam Hemsworth, whom she met while filming the 2010 film adaptation of Nicholas Sparks’s novel, The Last Song. After a decade-long, on-again, off-again relationship, the pair married in 2018 and divorced in 2020.
paras.zh: 赛勒斯此前曾与《饥饿游戏》演员利亚姆·海姆斯沃斯结婚，两人是在 2010 年拍摄改编自尼古拉斯·斯帕克斯小说的电影《最后一首歌》时相识的。经过长达十年时断时续的关系，两人于 2018 年结婚，并于 2020 年离婚。
